title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (Philippines) | Fully Remote



Aria Properties is hiring a fully remote Business Development Representative in the Philippines to turn skip-traced property owner leads into booked meetings and signed management contracts. Pay is $500 a month base plus bonuses, $675 at target, Monday to Friday on a US Eastern schedule.



About Aria Properties



Aria Properties is a boutique, full-service property management, revenue management and real estate investment company. We do not want to be the biggest operator in the market. We want to manage high-quality properties that owners are proud of and guests love, with low turnover and lean systems.



This is our dedicated business development hire. You will work a list of skip-traced property owner leads, turn cold contacts into real conversations, and book meetings that lead to new management and revenue management contracts, starting in the Pocono Mountains market and expanding into other markets.



What you’ll do



You own the path from cold contact to booked meeting, and you hand a well-prepared prospect to the Aria team.



Qualify each lead before any outreach: self-managed or already using a manager, property type and rate range, location, and visible pain signals such as dated photos, an uneven booking calendar or no direct-booking presence.

Sort leads into priority tiers and give the best-fit owners the full outreach sequence.

Run a structured, multi-touch sequence across text, phone and
. Every touch has one goal: a short conversation, not a pitch.

Personalize each message around something real about the owner’s property, so outreach never reads as a blast.

Prepare for every meeting with comparable-property data and a revenue gap view, so the owner sees what better management or pricing could mean for them.

Pitch two offers: full property management, and stand-alone revenue management (pricing) for owners who want to keep self-managing.

Track your own numbers (dials, conversations, meetings set, contracts signed) and keep the CRM current the same day.

Report weekly on what is working and what to adjust.

Build relationships in owner communities: join and actively take part in short-term rental investor and owner groups on
 and WhatsApp. Observe and learn what owners ask about and struggle with, then add real value with helpful advice on behalf of Aria Properties. The goal is long-term relationships that lead owners to switch to our management or to our pricing service.

Our quality standard



Three quality contracts matter more to us than ten average ones. A good-fit property has:



Thoughtful design and well-chosen furnishings

Strong amenities guests actively look for

Privacy, such as a secluded lot or space away from neighbors

A real connection to nature, such as woods, water, views or mountain surroundings

You will be trained on what a strong property looks like, with examples from our current portfolio. If a lead does not fit this standard, you note it and move on.



Pay and bonuses



Base pay is $500 per month in US dollars, guaranteed. Bonuses are earned on top, so a strong month reaches $675.



Each quality property management contract signed: $50

5 revenue management clients signed: $25

10 revenue management clients signed: $50

Example: 3 quality management contracts ($150) plus 5 revenue management clients ($25) on a $500 base is $675 for the month.



A contract counts when the owner signs and the property meets our quality standard. Bonuses are paid monthly with base pay.



What success looks like



Day 30: 3 quality property management contracts signed from the lead list

Day 60: 20 or more qualified owners actively moving through outreach, with weekly numbers reported

Day 90: A steady weekly outreach routine that runs without daily direction, a fully current CRM, and a consistent flow of booked meetings

Who we’re looking for



We hire for traits that predict success in this work, and we will train you on our market and tools.



Coachable: you take feedback and visibly adjust.

Curious: you ask real questions about an owner’s situation before you talk.

A record of follow-through: in sales, hospitality, real estate, customer service or anywhere else.

Consistent: you do the daily outreach whether or not you feel like it.

Resilient: a brush-off does not derail your day.

Experience in short-term rentals, real estate, hotels, hospitality or phone-based sales is a strong plus. You need excellent spoken and written English, comfort with phone calls, and a reliable computer and internet connection.



Schedule and location



Fully remote, Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. US Eastern time (some days may run to 6 p.m.). That is 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. in the Philippines while US daylight saving time is in effect, and one hour later the rest of the year. Please apply only if a night schedule already works for you.



How to apply



Send two things:



Your detailed CV or resume, clearly showing your education (school, degree, dates) and your work experience (employer, title, dates, what you did and achieved).

A Loom video of under 7 minutes, unedited, covering the points below in order:

Introduce yourself and briefly walk us through your education and work experience.

What has been your most rewarding professional experience so far, and why?

What has been your most challenging professional experience so far, and how did you handle it?

Why do you want to work in business development and relationship building?

Why do you want to work in hospitality and real estate, and/or for Aria Properties?

Describe something you have sold or represented, as if to someone hearing about it for the first time.

Tell us about a time you kept a client or customer happy over a long period.

We review the video for clear English, warmth and composure, because you will speak with property owners and existing clients every day. Applications without a CV and a video will not be considered.



Please upload your CV and Loom video link using this form: 



Thanks,

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer for UK Marketing Agency - Home Service Niche
description:
We’re looking for a media buyer who can turn a plumbing and heating company’s ad budget into booked appointments, and show us the numbers to prove it.



You’ll own Meta campaigns for our (plumbing, solar, roofing & home renovation) clients from start to finish: strategy, creative, launch, and optimising. Your ads are the first thing every lead touches.



The role is paid per client, per month. You start with one client account. So do great work and you’ll get more.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Build our clients'
 and Instagram campaigns in Ads Manager: the campaigns, the ad sets and the lead forms.

- Design image ads and edit short video ads

- Pick the angles and offers we test

- Write the ad copy and video scripts

- Track cost per lead, cost per appointment and cost per acquisition

- Kill what isn’t working fast and scale what is

- Send us a short update on results and next steps on a weekly basis



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- You’ve run Meta campaigns specifically for home-service based businesses (plumbers, solar installers, roofers, kitchen & bathroom renovators, etc) and can screenshare real results

- You’re confident in your ability to run high-converting campaigns at a medium to large sized monthly ad budget (£1,000-£3000/month | $1330-$4000/month)

- You understand the whole funnel, not just the ad: lead → appointment → sale

- You write copy that sounds like a person, not an ad

- You can create the landing page or instant form

- You make decisions from data, not gut feelings or emotions

- Strong written English.

- You solve problems without needing your hand held



PAY: £100-£200 GBP ($132-$265 USD) per client account, per month, paid at the end of each month.



BONUS POINTS IF:



- You know your way around GoHighLevel.

- You know Meta's ad rules well enough to keep an account out of trouble.

- You've run ads for UK companies before.

- You're organised and you speak up early. If something's going wrong, we hear it from you first.

- You're funny



WHY JOIN US?



We're a small, fast-moving agency in London. We find customers for home improvement companies, like plumbers, roofers, kitchen & bathroom renovators and solar fitters.



We judge a campaign by booked jobs, never by clicks.



We're small enough that good work gets noticed. The better you are, the more you'll own. If you’re exceptional, we won’t make you wait years before you get more responsibility.



You’ll run real campaigns across multiple clients, learn what actually works in home services, and take on more accounts as we grow.



We treat everyone on our team with respect and kindness. We value integrity, persistence, and innovative thinking.



If all you want is the highest hourly rate going, this probably isn't the role for you. If you want true ownership, honest feedback and the chance to become one of the best home service media buyers out there and scale with us, you'll fit right in.



HOW TO APPLY



No CV needed – we want to get to know YOU.



Send us a short video, 3 to 5 minutes long, with:



- A quick introduction and why you want this role

- A bit about you. Personal, casual, funny, whatever comes naturally.

- Your screen in Ads Manager, walking us through one campaign you ran: the goal, the results, what it spent, what each lead cost, and one change that improved it

- A real ad you made, with a breakdown of why it works

- How you would approach the first 30 days working on a new client account in the home service industry



We care more about how you talk and think than how you look on paper. Applications without a video won't be considered. Pre-made videos, generic applications and copy-pasted messages won't be considered either. Your video should cover the five points above, made for this job.



Upload your video to Loom, YouTube or Google Drive, and paste the link in your application. Check that anyone with the link can watch it.

title: Remote Bookkeeper - AU Client
description:
Hours: 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Rate: $9 AUD per hour



About Us:

Lifeworks Occupational Therapy is a West-Australian based allied health service that offers individualised and innovative care for people with complex, persistent health conditions and disability, such as mental health and chronic pain. We believe that everyone deserves to live life well, and our aim is to give people with chronic or complex health conditions the knowledge, skills and power to move forward with confidence, and overcome barriers, so they can live their best possible life. 

We have grown from a one-person practice with our owner and founder, to a dynamic team of over 15 therapy and administrative staff. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a meticulous and reliable Bookkeeper to join our team. Our company values work-life harmony and provides the flexibility of remote work.



We’re offering: 

Remote Work

Flexible hours. Work Monday to Friday, 4-5 hours a day, your choice of hours, during WA business hours, 8am-5pm.

WA is in the same Time Zone as the Philippines.

Immediate start 

Supportive team environment

Opportunities for professional growth and development

Competitive hourly rate of $9 AUD/hour



Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Medical/Allied health billing/invoicing

Managing accounts receivable and accounts payable

Managing payroll using Xero and/or Employment Hero

Managing aged receivables

Managing a KPI dashboard using Sheets

Managing cash flow projections

Reconciling bank statements

Providing bookkeeping/finance support to our reception/admin team as required to ensure efficient office workflow

Managing funding requests and submitting payment requests within various Health and Disability systems, Inlcuding NDIS, Medicare, Workers’ Compensation and Private Health Insurance

The ideal candidate will have experience and skills, relevant in the Australian context, as follows: 

Cert IV Accounting and Bookkeeping

Previous bookkeeping experience 

Experience in maintaining financial records

Familiarity with financial regulations and legislation

Proficiency in using accounting software (Xero)

Competent with the Google Suite, including Sheets

Excellent numerical skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy

Ability to manage time effectively and meet deadlines

Good understanding of accounts payable/receivable and payroll procedures

Able to work independently, be flexible and willing to take on responsibilities

Ability to work to deadlines, continually improve and embrace change, staying connected with the evolving world of technology

Familiarity with Australian Health and Disability systems is beneficial, but not essential. This is something we can support you to learn.



How to Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a brief cover letter outlining their relevant experience and why they are a good fit for this role. For more information go to: 

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Inbound Lead Response & Appointment Setter
description:
Remote | Warm Inbound Leads | Account-Based Compensation



Benefits Include:

- Paid 13th Month

- 1 paid PTO day earned per month

- Paid PH holidays

- Paid birthday off

- Work anniversary PTO bonus

- SSS contribution after one year

- Pag-IBIG contribution after one year

- Paid weekly via Wise

- We cover the Wise fees

- 100% remote

- Flexible working environment

- Software and tools provided

- Training, scripts, and client information provided

- Opportunities for increased compensation as additional client accounts are assigned

- Opportunities for bonuses based on performance

- Opportunity to grow into a larger lead-response, sales, or appointment-setting role as Murray Marketing Services expands



Because this role requires ongoing lead coverage, PTO and holidays will be coordinated in advance so we can arrange backup coverage.



Your normal account-based compensation will not be reduced simply because you use approved PTO.



About Murray Marketing Services



Murray Marketing Services is a growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency founded in 2021 and headquartered in Knoxville, Tennessee.



We partner primarily with service-based businesses throughout the United States and help them grow through Google Ads, Meta Ads, website design, landing pages, SEO, CRM and automation, organic social media, and other digital marketing strategies.



Our team is fully remote.



We're launching a new service designed to help our clients convert more of the leads we're already generating for them, and we're looking for an Inbound Lead Response & Appointment Setter to help us build and grow this service.



This is an important position because speed matters.

When someone fills out a lead form requesting information from one of our clients, we don't want that lead sitting untouched for hours or days.

We want someone calling them within minutes.



Why Join Murray Marketing Services?



We're looking for someone who wants more than a temporary freelance project. We want to build a long-term relationship with someone who can grow alongside the company.



About the Role



This is NOT traditional cold calling.

The majority of people you contact will have already:

- Seen one of our clients' advertisements

- Filled out a website or landing-page form

- Requested information

- Asked for a quote

- Requested an estimate

- Asked to schedule an appointment

- Otherwise expressed interest in the client's services



Your job is to contact them quickly, have a real conversation, determine what they need, and help move them toward the next step.



Depending on the client, that may mean:

Booking the appointment directly, or

Qualifying the lead and providing the client with a detailed handoff.



For example, if someone fills out a form requesting a roofing estimate, you may call them, confirm what type of project they need help with, collect additional information, and schedule an estimate.



For another client, scheduling may be more complicated. In that case, you may qualify the prospect, gather the necessary information, and let the client's team complete the scheduling.



Core Responsibilities



Rapid Lead Response

- Receive immediate notifications when new leads arrive

- Attempt to call new leads as quickly as possible

- Our goal is for new leads to receive their first call attempt within 5 minutes whenever possible

- Respond even faster when circumstances allow

- Make sure leads do not sit untouched

- Prioritize newly submitted leads over older follow-up activity



Speed to lead is one of the most important responsibilities of this position.



Lead Qualification

- Speak with prospective customers professionally and conversationally

- Follow client-specific qualification questions

- Determine what service the prospect is interested in

- Gather relevant information about their needs

- Confirm location/service area when necessary

- Identify obvious unqualified or spam leads

- Record clear notes for each conversation



You will receive information and training for each business you represent.



You are not expected to magically know every client's industry on Day 1.



Appointment Setting



Whenever the client's process allows it:

- Schedule appointments directly

- Schedule estimates or consultations

- Use the client's approved calendar

- Confirm appointment information with the prospect

- Make sure all required details are entered accurately

- Send approved appointment confirmations when applicable



Our preferred outcome is to move a qualified lead all the way to a scheduled next step whenever possible.



Lead Follow-Up



Calling once is not enough.



You will be responsible for following an approved follow-up process for leads that don't initially answer.



This may include:

- Multiple call attempts

- SMS messages

- Voi
s

- Follow-up on different days/times

- Updating the lead status after each attempt



You must be comfortable being persistent without being annoying or unprofessional.



CRM Management



Most leads will be managed through GoHighLevel.



You will:

- Update lead statuses

- Record call outcomes

- Add detailed notes

- Record qualification information

- Update appointment status

- Complete assigned follow-up tasks

- Keep the CRM clean and organized

- Make it easy for our team and clients to understand exactly what happened with every lead



Previous GoHighLevel experience is a major plus, but we can train the right person.



Client-Specific Processes



You may eventually work with multiple businesses across different industries.



Each business may have different:

- Services

- Qualification questions

- Service areas

- Pricing expectations

- Scheduling processes

- Calendars

- Scripts

- Common customer questions



We will provide client-specific documentation and training.



Your responsibility is to learn and follow each process carefully while still sounding natural on the phone.



Availability & Coverage



This is an unusual role because lead response speed matters more than traditional scheduled working hours.



You will not necessarily be sitting at your computer continuously for the entire coverage window.



Instead, you must be able to receive lead notifications and respond quickly when a new lead comes in.



Initial Live Coverage Target

Monday-Friday: approximately 8:00 AM-8:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Saturday: approximately 9:00 AM-5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time



We will initially have limited or automated coverage outside these times.



As the service grows, we expect to hire additional appointment setters so coverage can be divided between multiple people.



Important:

You must have a lifestyle and schedule that realistically allows you to respond to notifications during your agreed coverage window.



This probably is not a good fit if you already work another full-time job during the same hours and would not be able to step away to contact a new lead.



You may have other work or freelance clients, but they cannot interfere with your ability to meet Murray Marketing Services' agreed lead-response expectations.



Expected Lead Volume



We are launching this service gradually.



We expect to begin with only a handful of client accounts and grow from there.



Lead volume will vary significantly between clients, but this is not expected to begin at more than 20 new leads every day.



As additional clients adopt the service and lead volume increases, we will add additional appointment setters rather than expecting one person to manage an unreasonable workload.



Compensation

This position is compensated per active client account rather than by the hour.



Starting Compensation

$150 USD per active client account per month

As more client accounts are assigned to you, your compensation increases.



For example:

- 4 accounts = $600/month

- 5 accounts = $750/month

- 10 accounts = $1,500/month

- 15 accounts = $2,250/month

- 18 accounts = $2,700/month



We expect to begin with a smaller number of accounts and expand as more of our clients adopt the service.



Minimum Compensation



Once you have completed training and begin providing live lead coverage, we will provide a minimum compensation of $600/month, even if fewer than four active accounts are initially assigned.



As soon as your account-based compensation exceeds $600, you will be compensated based on your actual assigned accounts.



Compensation is calculated based on your assigned accounts.



Performance Bonuses



Additional bonuses may be offered based on factors such as:

- Fast average lead response times

- Strong contact rates

- Appointment booking rates

- Accurate CRM management

- Reliability

- Client results

- Overall performance



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has:

- Excellent spoken English

- A clear and easily understood speaking voice

- Strong conversational skills

- Confidence speaking with U.S.-based consumers

- Previous appointment-setting, sales, call-center, customer-service, receptionist, or phone-support experience

- Strong listening skills

- Ability to ask good follow-up questions

- Ability to follow scripts without sounding robotic

- Professional phone etiquette

- Strong attention to detail

- Persistence

- Reliability

- Ability to work independently

- Strong written English

- Comfort using technology and CRM software

- Reliable internet connection

- Reliable computer

- Reliable headset/microphone

- A quiet environment for phone calls

- Reliable mobile notifications so new leads are not missed



Previous Experience We'd Love to See



Any of the following would be valuable:

- Appointment setting

- Inbound sales

- Lead qualification

- Customer service

- Call center work

- Inside sales

- Receptionist/front-desk work

- Medical appointment scheduling

- Home-service appointment setting

- GoHighLevel

- HubSpot

- Salesforce

- Other CRM platforms

- U.S.-based customer communication



You do not need experience in every category.



The Right Personality



We are looking for someone who is:



Friendly

Prospects should feel like they're speaking with a real person who wants to help them.



Confident

You need to be comfortable guiding a conversation and asking for the appointment.



Persistent

Many leads will not answer the first call.

That doesn't mean we give up.



Organized

You may eventually be handling leads for several different businesses at once.



Fast

A lead that comes in now should not receive a call four hours from now because you forgot about the notification.



Resourceful

If something doesn't make sense, investigate it, check the client documentation, use available resources, and ask intelligent questions.



Trustworthy

You will have access to client leads, customer information, phone numbers, calendars, and CRM systems. We need someone who takes that responsibility seriously.



What Success Looks Like



We will track performance using metrics such as:



Speed to Lead

How quickly are new leads receiving their first contact attempt?



Our target is generally within 5 minutes during coverage hours.



Contact Rate

What percentage of leads are we actually speaking with?



Qualification Rate

How many leads are legitimate prospects who need the client's service?



Appointment Booking Rate

When scheduling is available, what percentage of qualified leads are successfully booked?



Follow-Up Completion

Are leads receiving the required follow-up attempts?



CRM Accuracy

Can anyone reviewing the CRM immediately understand what happened with each lead?



Reliability

Are lead notifications consistently being handled quickly?



We care about results, not just artificially increasing the number of phone calls made.



Tools You'll Use



Depending on the client, tools may include:

- GoHighLevel

- Calling software

- SMS

- Google Workspace

- Google Calendar

- Client scheduling platforms

- Google Sheets

- Asana

- Internal SOPs and training videos



Murray Marketing Services will provide access to the software required for the role.



Training



We will provide:

- Company onboarding

- GoHighLevel training where necessary

- Client-specific information

- Scripts

- Qualification questions

- Scheduling instructions

- Follow-up processes

- Training videos

- SOPs

- Examples of good calls and conversations as the program develops



However, we are looking for someone who already feels comfortable speaking with customers on the phone.



We can teach you our process.



We cannot teach someone to enjoy talking to people.



Independent Contractor Position



This position is offered on an independent contractor basis.



Compensation is based primarily on the number of active client accounts assigned rather than traditional hourly employment.



The contractor is responsible for their own taxes and legal obligations applicable to independent-contractor income.



How to Apply



Please submit:

1. Your resume

2. A brief introduction about yourself

3. Your previous experience with appointment setting, sales, customer service, or phone-based work

4. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

5. Any experience you have with GoHighLevel or another CRM

6. Details about any current jobs or clients you work with and the hours associated with them



Required Voice Recording

Please include a 60-90 second Loom recording answering:



"Please introduce yourself, tell us about your experience speaking with customers or leads, and explain why you think you'd be a strong fit for this position."



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Because this position is almost entirely phone-based, communication quality is one of the most important factors in our hiring decision.

title: Procurement, Proposal & Business Development Specialist (SAM.gov, SAP Ariba)
description:
ABOUT WOUESSI

Wouessi is a technology services company with offices in Toronto, Canada and Manassas, Virginia, offering software, AI, cloud and web development services. We are building our government and corporate sales pipeline. We have submitted government proposals and are working toward our first government contract award. You will work directly with our Founder and CEO.



HOW YOUR TIME SPLITS

About 60% procurement and proposals, 40% business development. This is not a tender-only role: we need you to open doors and grow the pipeline beyond public tenders.



YOUR PRIORITIES

1. Proposals: review RFPs and RFQs, build compliance matrices, draft responses with AI, track amendments and Q&A deadlines.

2. Qualify opportunities: find IT opportunities under USD 100K on government and corporate portals, check eligibility, write a short bid/no-bid recommendation.

3. Supplier profiles: audit Wouessi's profiles, track renewal dates, prepare updates for approval.

4. Business development:

- Run targeted outreach campaigns 
 and LinkedIn) to municipalities, nonprofits, mid-size companies and IT prime contractors, using approved messaging

- Build teaming and subcontracting relationships with primes that already hold government contracts

- Follow up on every lead, past contact and proposal until there is a clear yes or no

- Identify events, supplier-diversity programs and partner networks where Wouessi should show up, and prepare the CEO for them

- Book qualified meetings for the CEO and prepare a short brief before each one

5. Pipeline: keep the CRM current and send a short daily update.

When a deadline is close, proposals come first. We never trade quality for volume.



PLATFORMS


, SAP Ariba, CanadaBuys, MERX, Bonfire, bids&tenders, eVA, UNGM and corporate supplier portals. Experience with 
 or SAP Ariba is a strong advantage. You do not need to know every platform: you will learn the ones you need during onboarding. A teammate already scans tenders daily; you source additional opportunities and own the proposals for the ones you find.



HOW DECISIONS WORK

The CEO d
 whether to bid and approves every submission in writing. You submit only where the platform allows delegated access; otherwise the CEO submits.



TARGETS (cumulative)

Day 30: 8 opportunities qualified, 2 proposals submitted, 60 prospects researched, 1 outreach campaign launched, 2 prime or partner conversations opened, 1 qualified meeting held, supplier profiles audited

Day 60: 16 qualified, 5 proposals, 120 prospects, 2 campaigns, 5 prime/partner conversations, 3 qualified meetings held

Day 90: 24 qualified, 8 proposals, 180 prospects, 3 campaigns, 8 prime/partner conversations, 6 qualified meetings held



WEEKLY RHYTHM (after month one)

- 1 proposal submitted, when there is a suitable opportunity

- 3 opportunities qualified

- 75 personalized outreach touches

- All open leads followed up

- 1 new prime or partner contact



These are planning targets. Contract awards are not a condition of the trial. A qualified meeting = held with a decision-maker, about a documented need, recorded in the CRM. Success at Day 90 = at least one proposal reaches clarification, shortlist or documented buyer feedback.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 1 year in procurement, proposal coordination or B2B sales support

- B2B business development or outbound sales experience, with evidence of meetings or deals you generated

- RFP, RFQ or proposal writing experience

- Experience with at least one procurement platform

- Strong written English (French is a plus)

- Daily use of ChatGPT, Claude or similar, with careful fact-checking

- Reliable laptop, internet and power backup

- Overlap 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Toronto time (Eastern), Monday to Friday (Philippine evening/night)



NON-NEGOTIABLE

- Never invent or exaggerate clients, contracts, certifications, past performance, values or capabilities

- Never upload RFP attachments, client data or company information to unapproved AI tools

- Use only your own named portal accounts; never share passwords

- All outreach uses approved messaging, follows Canadian and US anti-spam rules, and honours every unsubscribe



WHAT WOUESSI PROVIDES

Company
, CRM access, capability statements, proposal templates, our bid/no-bid checklist, named portal access where authorized, and direct access to the CEO with a weekly pipeline review.



ENGAGEMENT AND PAY

- Full-time independent contractor under a written agreement, 40 hours/week

- USD 600/month base, paid monthly

- USD 20 per qualified meeting held, under written criteria

- 10% of collected first-year gross margin on eligible commercial deals you source, under a written commission schedule. Commission on government contracts applies only where legally permitted.

- Paid 30-day initial engagement; continuation based on performance and mutual fit

- Growth path to Proposal Manager or Business Development Manager for the right person



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your application with "Wouessi Pipeline", then answer:

1. Which procurement platforms have you used, and what exactly did you do on each?

2. Describe a proposal or RFQ response you prepared, your role, and the outcome (no confidential details).

3. Write a 4-line introduction
 to a city IT manager about website accessibility improvements. Then tell us how you would find and approach 3 IT prime contractors to partner with Wouessi.

4. How do you use AI to draft proposals, and how do you make sure every claim is accurate?

5. Can you work 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Eastern, Monday to Friday?



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid 2-hour assessment on a sample RFQ (not a live bid). Pass mark 80/100; any invented claim fails automatically. You report to Rodrigue (Rod) Fouafou, Founder and CEO.

title: Kajabi Course & Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
We are an Australian education business in the hair and beauty industry and are currently moving our online education platform from an existing white-label learning management system across to Kajabi.



We are looking for a proactive and organised Kajabi & Digital Marketing Coordinator to initially help us complete the migration and then become an ongoing part of our team, helping manage and grow our online education platform and community.



This is a hands-on execution role. Our Australian team will handle the education, filming, video editing, campaign direction and overall creative strategy. We need someone who can take the assets and direction we provide and efficiently manage the implementation.



Initial Kajabi Migration



Your first major project will be helping us move our existing education platform into Kajabi, including:



Building and formatting courses, modules and lessons in Kajabi

Uploading existing educational content and resources

Migrating existing members/customers into Kajabi

Organising member access, products, offers, tags and course structures

Helping configure email automations and customer journeys

Testing the new platform to ensure everything works correctly

Helping us create a clean, professional member experience



Ongoing Responsibilities



Once the migration is complete, the role will expand into:



Managing and updating our Kajabi platform

Managing and growing the Kajabi community

Uploading new courses, lessons and educational resources

Scheduling and publishing social media content

Creating simple branded graphics using Canva

Writing captions, emails and supporting marketing copy

Repurposing the content/assets provided by our team

SEO optimisation of website, course and educational content

Keyword research and basic SEO reporting

Assisting with Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising

Building and monitoring digital marketing campaigns

 marketing and Kajabi automations

Monitoring analytics and reporting on what is performing

Helping identify opportunities to improve engagement, memberships and course sales



You will NOT be responsible for:



Our team will continue to handle:



Education and course expertise

Filming

Professional video editing

Main promotional videos, teasers and trailers

Overall brand and campaign direction



You will receive finished assets and direction from us and help turn these into organised, consistent marketing and platform activity.



All major content, advertising and campaigns will be approved by our team before publishing.



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has previous experience using Kajabi — highly preferred

Understands online courses and membership businesses

Has digital marketing experience

Understands social media management

Has practical SEO knowledge

Has experience with Meta Ads or similar paid advertising

Is comfortable creating graphics in Canva

Has excellent written English

Is highly organised and detail-oriented

Can work independently rather than waiting for instructions on every task

Is comfortable learning our brand and suggesting improvements

Can manage multiple ongoing tasks and deadlines



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team, not simply completing the Kajabi migration and leaving.



Hours



Approximately 20 hours per week initially, with flexibility around when the work is completed.



We are based in Australia, so some availability overlapping Australian business hours would be helpful, but you do not need to work Australian hours exclusively.



Salary



USD $7–$9/hour depending on experience.



For the right person, there is opportunity for increased hours, responsibilities and compensation as the business and platform grow.



Important application instruction



I would put this at the very bottom:



To apply, please start your application with the words "KAJABI HEDUCATION" so we know you have read the full job description.



Please also include:



A link or description of a Kajabi platform you have previously worked on.

Your experience migrating courses or memberships between platforms.

Your experience with Meta Ads and SEO.

Your Canva/design experience.

Your desired hourly rate.

How many hours per week you are currently available.

title: HVAC Estimator / Quantity Take-Off Estimator
description:
Mechanical / Underfloor Heating | Remote – Philippines



Anglian UFH Ltd is a UK-based specialist underfloor heating contractor providing design, supply, installation and commissioning services for residential and commercial construction projects.



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Construction Estimator / Quantity Take-Off Estimator based in the Philippines to support our UK team.



The role will initially focus on preparing quantity take-offs from construction drawings and specifications, entering information into our existing Excel pricing system and preparing draft quotations for review.



Main Responsibilities:



- Review construction drawings, specifications and tender information.

- Identify the underfloor heating scope of works.

- Carry out quantity take-offs from PDF and CAD drawings.

- Measure floor areas and identify different floor build-ups and UFH system types.

- Identify quantities of manifolds, controls and other associated components.

- Enter take-off information into Anglian UFH's existing Excel pricing sheets.

- Check calculations and ensure information has been entered accurately.

- Prepare draft quotations using our quotation templates.

- Identify discrepancies, missing information or unclear requirements within tender documents.

- Raise queries with the Anglian UFH office or direct with our clients where drawings or specifications conflict.

- Maintain accurate tender and quotation records using our company CRM.

- Work closely with the Anglian UFH sales team in the UK.



Types of Projects:



Projects include:



- Residential developments

- Apartments

- Care homes

- Schools

- Commercial buildings

- Public sector projects

- Large residential schemes



The role is specifically focused on underfloor heating packages. Full training will be provided on Anglian UFH systems, products and pricing procedures.



Required Experience:



We are ideally looking for someone with previous experience in one or more of the following:



- Construction estimating

- Quantity surveying

- Mechanical or MEP estimating

- HVAC estimating

- Plumbing / heating estimating

- Quantity take-offs



Applicants should be comfortable reading and interpreting construction drawings and mechanical specifications.



Experience working with UK, Australian or other international construction companies would be an advantage.



Skills Required:



- Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

- Ability to read construction drawings and specifications.

- Good numerical ability and attention to detail.

- Strong written & spoken English.

- Ability to work independently and raise questions to clients via phone and
 when information is unclear.

- Organised approach to managing multiple quotations and deadlines.

- Comfortable working with PDF drawings, take-off software and our company CRM for data entry and workflow management.



Experience with estimating take-off software & PDF / DWG Viewers is essential.



What We Are Looking For:



Accuracy is more important to us than simply completing estimates quickly.



We want someone who will question information when something does not look correct rather than make assumptions.



For example, if a drawing shows six manifolds but the project schedule shows seven, we would expect this discrepancy to be highlighted to our client before the quotation is completed.



Working Arrangement:



- Fully remote position.

- Based in the Philippines.

- Initially part-time or full-time depending on the successful candidate.

- Long-term opportunity available.

- Working hours can be discussed, although overlap with UK working hours will be required.

- Training on Anglian UFH systems and our pricing procedures will be provided.

- Regular communication with Anglian UFH office as and when required (via teams video call).



Recruitment Process:



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid estimating exercise using a previous Anglian UFH project.



This will involve:



1. Reviewing a set of construction drawings.

2. Completing a basic quantity take-off.

3. Entering the information into a provided Excel pricing sheet.

4. Highlighting any queries or information that appears unclear.





The exercise is intended to assess accuracy, drawing interpretation, Excel ability and attention to detail.



To Apply:



Please provide:



- Your CV.

- Details of your construction estimating experience.

- Examples of the types of projects or trades you have previously estimated.

- The take-off / estimating software you have used.

- Your experience using Microsoft Excel & Word.

- Your availability to start.



Please also include a short explanation of what you would do if information shown on a construction drawing conflicted with the project specification, or the specification appears incomplete, unclear or wrong. 



**Please include the words UFH Estimator" at the top of your application.**

title: Remote Sales Rep: Call and Close Small Businesses
description:
ABOUT VNTRA

VNTRA is a web design company based in South Carolina. We build custom, mobile-friendly websites for local businesses like roofers, landscapers, contractors and restaurants, and we can have a site live within 48 hours of getting the client's content.



THE ROLE

This is a full-cycle outbound sales role. You call business owners from lead lists we provide, have the conversation, and close the sale on that same call. There is no appointment setting and no handoff. You own the sale from "hello" to payment.



This is an eat-what-you-kill role. There is no base pay. You earn on every deal you close, and there is no cap.



WHAT YOU'RE SELLING

Every website includes up to 3 pages, 2 rounds of revisions, a mobile-first design, tap-to-call, a quote request form, the client's reviews and photos, and a map. Owners pick one of two options:



- Pay in full: $500 total. $250 to start, $250 when the site goes live. Optional maintenance at $35/month.

- Monthly plan: $99 to start, then $79/month for 12 months, with hosting, security and monthly updates included.



HOW YOU GET PAID

- $50 for every pay-in-full close, paid 14 days after the client's site launches and they're satisfied.

- $25 for every monthly plan close, paid once the client's first monthly payment clears.

- No cap. Consistent performers earn higher commission as volume grows.

- $4/hourly base pay @ 20hrs per week. 



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- Researched lead lists with phone numbers

- A sales guide covering the offer, pricing and common questions

- A business phone number with call recording

- Payment links ready to send on the call

- Everything after the sale: The owner handles the build, onboarding, launch and support



WHAT YOU NEED

- Outbound phone sales experience, ideally with closing on the call

- Comfort talking with small business owners, including skeptical ones

- Honesty. We never promise rankings, jobs or results, and you won't either.

- Reliable internet, a headset and a quiet place to call from

- Availability during weekday business hours, Eastern time

- Openness to weekly call reviews and feedback



WHERE WE ARE

We're early. During the first few weeks, the pitch is being refined based on real calls, so you'll have direct input into what we say and how we say it.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply and include a link to a 60-second voice recording (Google Drive, Vocaroo or similar) of you introducing yourself as if you were calling a business owner. Add a few lines about your sales experience. Applications without a recording won't be reviewed.

title: Podcast Relationship & Sponsorship Assistant
description:
# Podcast Guest Relations & Sponsorship Development Assistant



**Company:** Unshackled Moms Alliance / Truly Gutsy Parent Coaching



**Location:** Remote



**Position:** Part-Time, Long-Term



**Hours:** 3–5 hours per week initially, with potential for additional hours as the podcast grows



**Compensation:** $5.50–$7.00 USD per hour, depending on experience, plus sponsorship commissions



**Start Date:** November 2026



## About Us



Unshackled Moms Alliance is a growing podcast dedicated to honest, meaningful conversations about the experiences that shape our lives.



Our interviews explore relationships, family dynamics, grief, personal growth, faith, emotional baggage, overcoming adversity, and finding the courage to move forward.



Our philosophy is simple: **There is always room at our table.**



We believe every person has a story worth hearing, and we are committed to creating conversations that help people feel seen, valued, encouraged, and empowered.



We are looking for a proactive, organized, and relationship-focused Virtual Assistant to help expand our podcast through guest development and sponsorship outreach.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, researching interesting people and organizations, and contributing to the growth of a purpose-driven business.



## Key Responsibilities



### Podcast Guest Relations



- Research and identify compelling podcast guests whose experiences align with our mission and audience.

- Evaluate potential guests for credibility, relevance, and audience value.

- Prepare thoughtful, personalized guest invitations.

- Manage guest communications, scheduling, confirmations, and follow-ups.

- Maintain an organized database of prospective, contacted, scheduled, and completed guests.

- Identify opportunities for guest cross-promotion and audience growth.

- Proactively identify and resolve scheduling or communication issues.



### Sponsorship Development



- Research businesses, brands, and organizations that align with our podcast's audience and values.

- Identify appropriate decision-makers and contact information.

- Prepare personalized sponsorship inquiries and proposals.

- Follow up professionally with potential sponsors.

- Maintain an organized sponsorship pipeline.

- Track conversations, opportunities, agreements, and renewals.

- Coordinate sponsorship details with the podcast host and bookkeeping team.



### Organization and Communication



- Maintain accurate guest and sponsorship tracking systems.

- Provide a concise weekly progress report.

- Communicate regularly with the podcast host and existing operations team.

- Manage assigned responsibilities independently and meet agreed-upon deadlines.

- Identify opportunities for improvement and offer practical recommendations.



## Qualifications



**Required:**



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong research and communication skills.

- Experience with outreach, lead generation, relationship management, or business development.

- Excellent organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple conversations and follow-ups.

- Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.

- Professional, dependable, proactive, and resourceful.

- Respectful of diverse backgrounds, beliefs, and life experiences.

- Comfortable handling sensitive topics with professionalism and discretion.



**Preferred:**



- Experience with podcast guest booking or podcast management.

- Sponsorship outreach or partnership development experience.

- Experience with CRM software or lead-tracking systems.

- Familiarity with Google Workspace, Google Sheets, HubSpot, or similar tools.

- Experience with podcast scheduling and guest coordination.



We value initiative, sound judgment, and genuine relationship-building more than simply checking tasks off a list.



## Working Hours and Compensation



This position will begin at approximately **3–5 hours per week**, with flexible scheduling.



Some availability for communication during U.S. Pacific business hours is preferred.



We plan to reassess the position's hours and responsibilities after January 1, 2027.



Hourly compensation is $5.50–$7.00 USD, depending on experience.



Additional sponsorship commissions are available:



- **10%** on qualifying sponsorships you originate and develop.

- **5%** on qualifying sponsorships originated by the podcast host that you help nurture and close.

- **5%** on qualifying sponsorship renewals you manage.



Commissions are calculated on sponsorship payments actually received and are subject to a written agreement.



We are seeking someone interested in a long-term professional relationship with opportunities to grow alongside our podcast.



## What to Expect During Our Selection Process



Qualified applicants will be evaluated based on relevant experience, communication skills, initiative, and their ability to build meaningful professional relationships.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to participate in an interview and complete a brief, paid practical assessment involving podcast guest research or sponsorship outreach.



## Application Questions



Please begin your application response with the words **"I read the whole post."**



Then answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your experience with podcast guest management, outreach, lead generation, sponsorships, sales, or relationship management.



2. If you
ed a potential podcast sponsor and they did not respond, what would your follow-up process look like?



3. Which part of this position interests you most: guest relationships, sponsorship outreach, or both? Why?



4. Tell us about a time when you had to keep track of several people, projects, or conversations at different stages. How did you stay organized?



5. What hourly rate are you seeking, and how many hours per week are you available?



We appreciate thoughtful, specific responses that demonstrate your experience and approach to professional relationship-building.



**We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through, and genuinely enjoys helping meaningful stories reach more people.**

About the Role



Staff Connect Australia is looking for an experienced Marketing & Account Manager to support a portfolio of Australian businesses.



We're looking for someone who can do more than just create social media posts. We need a hands-on marketer who can manage day-to-day marketing activities, communicate confidently with clients and stakeholders, and make sure projects and campaigns are delivered on time.

Social Media & Content Creation



- Plan, create and schedule content for
 and Instagram.

 Marketing



- Create, schedule and manage
 marketing campaigns (EDMs).

 copy and prepare promotional newsletters.

Website & SEO

Brand Management & Reporting

- Coordinate creative materials, photos, videos and other marketing assets.

- Monitor campaign performance and prepare marketing reports.

What We're Looking For



- At least 3 years of experience in digital marketing, marketing management or account management.

- Experience managing multiple brands, clients or marketing accounts.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong communication and relationship management skills.

- Experience managing
 and Instagram business accounts.

- Proficiency in Canva and basic video editing.

- Experience creating and managing
 marketing campaigns.

- Familiarity with website content management and basic SEO.

- Strong organisational and time management skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage priorities and meet deadlines.

- A proactive attitude and strong attention to detail.



Experience With These Tools Is an Advantage



- Canva

- Meta Business Suite

- Mailchimp or similar
 marketing platforms

- WordPress or similar website platforms

- Google Analytics (GA4)

- Google Business Profile

- HubSpot

- CapCut or Adobe Creative Cloud

- Google Ads and Meta Ads



You don't need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be comfortable learning new systems and working across different marketing platforms.



Bonus Points If You Have



- Experience working with Australian clients or businesses.

- Previous experience in a marketing agency or client-facing role.

- Experience in hospitality, tourism, accommodation, property or lifestyle marketing.

- Experience coordinating marketing campaigns across multiple brands.

- A portfolio showing social media content,
 campaigns or other marketing projects you've worked on.



What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?



We're looking for someone who:



- Takes ownership of their work and follows through on commitments.

- Communicates clearly and professionally with clients and team members.

- Can manage multiple projects without constant supervision.

- Is comfortable both planning campaigns and doing the actual marketing work.

- Pays attention to detail and knows when to ask questions.

- Brings ideas to the table rather than simply waiting for instructions.

- Enjoys working with a team and building strong professional relationships.



Why Join Staff Connect Australia?



You'll have the opportunity to work with established Australian businesses, gain experience across different industries and take ownership of meaningful marketing projects.



You'll also be supported by SCA's wider marketing team, including experienced marketing and creative professionals.



We value people who are reliable, proactive, willing to learn and genuinely care about the quality of their work.



How to Apply



If you think you'd be a great fit, we'd love to hear from you!



Please send us:



- Your updated CV or resume.

- A link to your portfolio or samples of previous marketing work.

- A short introduction explaining your experience managing marketing activities and client relationships.

- Details of the marketing tools and platforms you've worked with.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Call Center Partnership – US Sales Closing for Make-Money Offers
description:
Needs to hire 2 Freelancers

Summary

Hi, I'm looking for a call center partner for an established direct-response sales operation targeting the US market. (one-call-close)



We sell aggressive, niche “make money” offers with an average order value of around $1,000. Our business is already generating sales through its existing sales funnel, and we're now introducing phone-based closing to improve conversions and scale revenue. Our leads are exclusively from the US, primarily an older demographic.



All the leads are already warm, since they’ve all already purchased our main product; as closers, you’ll be selling the second one (upsell).



We're flexible on compensation and open to discussing either an hourly rate per agent or a commission-based model tied to sales generated. We're looking for a team with experienced English-speaking closers who have a strong track record selling to US customers, ideally in direct response, high-ticket offers, or financial opportunity niches.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Job Description: Social Media Manager

Business: Maddy Lifts Coaching

Role type: Part-time / Freelance / Virtual Assistant

Platforms: Instagram and

About Maddy Lifts Coaching

Maddy Lifts Coaching is a personal training and sports nutrition coaching business focused on helping clients build strength, improve their relationship with food, develop sustainable habits and achieve their individual goals.



I'm looking for a creative, organised and proactive Social Media Manager to help manage and grow the business's presence across Instagram and
.



This role will involve supporting content creation, planning, scheduling and engagement, helping ensure the brand consistently delivers valuable, engaging and educational content to its audience.



I'm looking for someone who understands social media and can bring ideas to the table while maintaining my personal brand, coaching philosophy and authentic voice.

Key responsibilities

1. Content creation

- Create engaging Instagram posts, carousels, Stories and Reels.

- Repurpose existing content, including coaching insights, educational information, client wins and videos, into engaging social media content.

- Edit short-form videos and create visually appealing graphics using tools such as Canva.

- Write engaging captions that align with my brand voice and encourage audience interaction.

- Turn my ideas, voice notes and coaching knowledge into polished, ready-to-publish content.

- Ensure content reflects the brand's values, tone and coaching philosophy.

2. Content planning and scheduling

- Develop and maintain a monthly content calendar for Instagram and
.

- Plan content around relevant topics, business goals, promotions and upcoming launches.

- Schedule posts and Stories in advance to maintain consistency.

- Ensure content is organised, prepared and published on time.

- Identify opportunities to improve the content strategy and suggest new ideas.

3. Community engagement

- Monitor comments and messages across Instagram and
.

- Respond to basic enquiries and comments in a way that aligns with the brand's voice.

- Engage with the audience to build relationships and encourage community participation.

- Identify potential coaching enquiries and flag them for me to respond to personally.

- Escalate sensitive questions or enquiries requiring my professional expertise.

4. Business promotion and launches

- Assist with promoting coaching services, programs, challenges and upcoming launches.

- Create content that communicates the value of my services and encourages potential clients to enquire.

- Help plan promotional campaigns and ensure content is published according to the launch schedule.

- Repurpose existing content to support promotions without making the page feel overly sales-focused.

5. Analytics and reporting

- Monitor basic performance metrics, including reach, engagement, shares, saves and follower growth.

- Provide regular updates on what content is performing well.

- Identify patterns and opportunities to improve future content.

- Recommend content ideas based on audience engagement and performance.

Skills and experience

Ideally, you'll have:

- Experience managing Instagram and
 business accounts.

- Strong written communication and copywriting skills.

- Experience creating social media graphics and editing short-form videos.

- Familiarity with Canva and social media scheduling tools.

- An understanding of social media engagement and content strategy.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.

- Creativity, initiative and the ability to generate ideas.

- The ability to understand and maintain an existing brand voice.

- An interest in fitness, strength training, nutrition or health and wellness.

Experience working with personal brands, coaches or fitness businesses would be an advantage.

What I'm looking for in the right person

I'm looking for someone who is proactive, creative and reliable.



I want someone who can take my ideas and coaching knowledge and turn them into quality content without needing every detail explained or every post directed by me.



I'm happy to provide the expertise, ideas, videos, opinions and overall direction. I want someone who can help bring those ideas to life, organise them into a consistent content strategy and manage the execution.



The ideal person will:

- Bring fresh content ideas and creative suggestions.

- Understand the difference between educational, engaging and promotional content.

- Be comfortable working independently while communicating regularly.

- Maintain consistency and organisation.

- Understand that this is a personal brand built around my coaching expertise and personality.

- Be open to feedback and willing to refine content as the brand evolves.

What success looks like

Success in this role would mean:

- Consistent, high-quality content across Instagram and
.

- Less time spent by me planning, creating, editing and scheduling posts.

- A more organised and strategic approach to social media.

- Increased audience engagement and brand awareness.

- Content that communicates my coaching values and attracts the right potential clients.

- Better promotion of coaching services, programs and launches.



*Will have a 2 week trial before fully signing off*

title: Executive Assistant to the Cofounder
description:
Role Overview

Supporting Kristi with Blossomdale and Villa Copa



Compensation: Approximately USD 1,000 per month.



Schedule: Agreed working hours with consistent overlap with Kristi's working day and the US team.



We are hiring an experienced Executive Assistant to support Kristi, cofounder of oCommerce. Your main focus will be helping her with the day-to-day coordination of Blossomdale and Villa Copa, together with employee scheduling.



You will organize priorities, coordinate people and vendors, keep schedules accurate, and follow tasks through to completion. You should anticipate coverage gaps and operational problems, resolve routine issues within your authority, and bring Kristi clear recommendations when a decision needs her input. This role suits someone who enjoys practical business administration and can keep several activities moving with limited supervision.



Key Responsibilities

Maintain Kristi's daily and weekly priorities for Blossomdale and Villa Copa, with clear task owners, deadlines, and outstanding decisions.

Prepare and maintain employee schedules using staffing needs, employee availability, and approved leave; identify coverage gaps and conflicts early.

Coordinate shift changes and coverage arrangements, communicate updates clearly, and confirm that affected employees understand their schedules.

Follow up with employees, vendors, suppliers, and other partners until agreed tasks and service requests are completed.

Coordinate routine business administration, vendor arrangements, quotes, orders, and operational requests for Blossomdale and Villa Copa.

Keep calendars, documents, staff availability, and relevant operational records accurate and easy for Kristi to review.

Collect timesheets and supporting expense or invoice records where needed, and flag discrepancies to the appropriate person.

Resolve routine coordination issues within agreed authority; present material problems with the facts, available options, and a recommendation.

Support Kristi's inbox, meetings, and other administrative requests as needed, while handling business and employee information discreetly.

Your first 90 days — First 30 days: Learn Kristi's priorities, how Blossomdale and Villa Copa operate, relevant staff roles, scheduling needs, and approval boundaries.

Days 31-60: Take ownership of recurring schedules, business trackers, vendor follow-up, and routine administration.

Days 61-90: Demonstrate reliable coverage coordination, accurate records, and consistent completion of tasks with fewer reminders from Kristi.



Qualifications & Skills

At least 5 years of relevant executive-assistant experience, including at least 2 years directly supporting a founder, business owner, or senior executive.

Hands-on experience coordinating employee schedules, availability, coverage, or similar operational administration.

Excellent written and spoken English for communicating with employees, vendors, and US-based leadership.

Demonstrated ability to organize competing operational priorities, anticipate gaps, and complete tasks with limited supervision.

Strong working skills in Google Workspace, calendars, spreadsheets, and project-management or scheduling tools.

A reliable computer, internet connection, quiet call environment, and practical backup arrangements for interruptions.

Preferred experience: Experience supporting small businesses, coordinating on-site teams remotely, and handling vendor or service arrangements is an advantage.



What we're looking for

You keep track of the details that help a business run reliably and follow up until people have completed what they committed to.

You are discreet and dependable, communicate schedule changes clearly, and bring practical options when something goes wrong.



What we offer

A fully remote, full-time role for someone based in the Philippines.

Approximately USD 1,000 per month, with final compensation and working hours agreed during hiring.

Direct work with Kristi, with practical responsibility for coordinating Blossomdale, Villa Copa, and employee schedules.



Our hiring process

Application review, including your resume, video introduction, and written responses.

A conversation about your executive-support experience, business coordination, employee scheduling, judgment, and availability.

A short scheduling, prioritization, and correspondence exercise, with the scope and expected time shared in advance.

Final conversation with Kristi and reference checks before an offer.

title: Accounts Payable & Receivable Officer Remote WFH
description:
We are a growing freight forwarding company specialising in sea and air freight transport solutions looking for an experienced Accounts Payable and Receivable Officer to join our team. 



The role is to manage and optimize the accounts payable / receivable process, ensuring timely invoice processing and maintaining accurate financial records in Excel, Xero and Cargowise.  High attention to detail is essential, as you will be ensuring financials are accurate and up to date. You will be responsible for monitoring and reporting on outstanding debts, collection issues in collaboration with customers and internal teams, while developing strategies to minimize overdue accounts. 



This role is ideal for a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in a remote environment and values process improvement and accuracy. We are looking for someone who is reliable, disciplined, proactive, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work as part of a supportive and professional team.



Key Responsibilities:

Invoicing and Billing:

•	Accurately enter supplier invoices into Excel, Xero and Cargowise

•	Ensure invoices comply with relevant tax requirements (e.g. GST treatment, ABN details)

•	Support continuous improvement initiatives within accounts payable and finance processes.



Receivables Management:

•	Monitor the accounts receivable ledger and reconcile customer accounts

•	Allocate incoming payments against invoices accurately and in a timely manner

•	Identify and resolve discrepancies between payments received and amounts invoiced



Debtor Management:

•	Follow up on overdue accounts via phone,
, and written correspondence

•	Reconciliation and Reporting



Administrative Support:

•	Maintain customer/client master data within Xero accounting system

•	Assist with month-end tasks, reporting, and reconciliation activities.



Requirements:

•	Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

•	Minimum of 2-3+ years’ experience in an Accounts Payable or similar finance role

•	Strong computer literacy and confidence using multiple systems

•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Microsoft 365 and SharePoint and Google suite

•	Proven experience using Xero (essential)

•	Strong time management and organizational skills

•	Experience with Australian GST regulations and compliance

•	Ability to work independently with limited supervision or direction

•	Reliable, disciplined, and proactive work ethic

•	High attention to detail and data accuracy in system work

•	Clear communicator with a professional, team-first attitude



Equipment Needed:

•	Desktop or Laptop under 3 years old

•	Core I5 or Ryzen 5 & above

•	Min 8GB RAM

title: USA Export Logistics Co-ordinator

title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Program Manager
description:

Agent84 and Skivys

You will lead recruitment, outreach, sampling, creator communication, content follow-up, and performance reporting. You will coordinate with our brand, influencer, fulfillment, and paid media teams while remaining accountable for the affiliate program's execution.

Build a clear affiliate growth plan for each brand, covering creator recruitment, product priorities, launches, sampling, and ongoing partnerships.

Manage personalized outreach, follow-ups, onboarding, and day-to-day creator relationships.

Coordinate sample requests and deliveries with fulfillment, track costs, and follow up on agreed content.

Develop repeat partnerships with productive creators and coordinate shoppable videos and relevant creator LIVE opportunities.

Days 31-60: Run a consistent recruitment, sampling, and activation process, with clear briefs and weekly reporting.

Days 61-90: Improve the rate at which sampled creators publish, develop repeat partnerships, and show progress against agreed sales and cost targets.



Qualifications & Skills

Direct experience managing affiliate programs for ecommerce sellers serving the US market.

Evidence of growing active creator participation and attributable sales, with a clear account of your personal contribution.

Experience managing the full process from outreach and samples through content publication, sales analysis, and repeat partnerships.

Excellent spoken and written English for building relationships with US creators and communicating with colleagues.

Strong spreadsheet skills, organization, commercial judgment, and a reliable remote-working setup.

Preferred experience: Experience with women's fashion, apparel, beauty, or lifestyle brands; an existing network of relevant US creators; and experience coordinating affiliate content for paid campaigns are advantages.



What we're looking for

You follow each partnership through to a useful outcome and can explain where creators drop out of the process.

You use sales, costs, and creator quality to d
 what deserves more investment.

What we offer

A fully remote, full-time role for someone based in the Philippines.

Approximately USD 1,000 per month, with final compensation and working hours agreed during hiring.

Ownership of affiliate programs for two apparel brands, working alongside established brand, creative, fulfillment, and marketing colleagues.

Application review, including your resume, video introduction, and evidence of relevant results.

title: Funnel Builder + Direct Response Copywriter (Fitness Coaches) | Full Time, Long-Term
description:
ABOUT US

Hi! I'm Josh, co-founder of Ripple Motions (
). We build and run Instagram funnels for online fitness coaches and physical therapists who coach online. We want one person who stays long term.



This is NOT just a copywriting role. You own the whole funnel, not just the copy.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Research the coach's audience before writing anything: comments on their videos, Reddit, reviews, the coach's own data and stories

- Map out the buyer's objections and d
 which part of the funnel answers each one

- Plan the funnel: Instagram comment -> DM -> opt-in -> freebie ->
 sequence -> sales page -> checkout

- Write all of it: DM flows, opt-in pages,
 sequences, sales pages

- Build it in our tools (ManyChat, Systeme, GHL, Flodesk). If you've used similar tools you'll pick these up fast

- Track the numbers at every step, find where people drop off, and test fixes one at a time

- Send us short, clear updates on what you found and what you'd change



YOU MUST HAVE

- 2+ years of direct response experience, including funnels,
 sequences or sales pages you wrote and built yourself, not just handed over copy

- Customer research and objection handling as part of your process

- CRO experience: you have read step-by-step funnel numbers, run A/B tests and raised conversion

- Excellent written English. You write plain, with no hype and no corporate-speak

- You can use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to draft, but the final copy must be in your own voice



NICE TO HAVE

- Coaching, fitness, health or info product clients

- ManyChat / Instagram DM funnels



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You write from your head without researching the buyer first

- You like fake scarcity, countdown timers or "transform your life" copy

- You only want short projects, or you already have a full-time job



WHAT WE OFFER

- $1,500 to $3,000/month depending on experience

- Monthly bonus when your client funnels hit their targets

- 13th month pay, 10 paid leave days, paid PH holidays

- Raise every year

- Long-term role working directly with the founders

- Room to grow into leading fulfillment as we add clients

- 40 hrs/week, Mon to Fri. You need to be online 9am to 1pm US Eastern (New York) time. That's 9pm to 1am Manila time, or 10pm to 2am from Nov 1 when US clocks change. The rest of your hours are flexible



HIRING PROCESS (EVERY STEP IS PAID)

1. Short test, about 1 hour: $30

2. Longer test, 3 to 4 hours: $50

3. Video call

4. 1 week paid trial on real client work



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word RIPPLE so we know you read this. Then send:

1. 2 or 3 funnels,
 sequences or sales pages you wrote (and built, if you did), with results if you have them

2. In a few sentences: a coach gets 300 comments, 50 opt-ins and 1 sale in a month. Where do you look first, and why?

3. Your expected monthly pay, when you can start, and confirm you can work 9am to 1pm US Eastern every weekday



Applications without the keyword won't be reviewed.
