title: Dental Recruiter
description:
Position Overview

RSMC Services is seeking a highly motivated Offshore Recruiter to support the recruitment of dental professionals for clients across the US. This role is responsible for sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates, ensuring a strong talent pipeline to meet the staffing needs of dental practices. The ideal candidate has experience in high-volume recruitment, strong communication skills, and proficiency in using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and sourcing tools. This is a fast-paced, performance-driven role that requires excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with onshore recruiters and hiring managers.



Job Description

• Source, screen, and assess candidates for open positions.

• Utilize various sourcing methods, including job boards, social media, and Boolean searches.

• Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.

• Maintain accurate records in the applicant tracking system (ATS).

• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for future hiring needs.

• Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.

• Collaborate with hiring teams to understand job requirements and deliver top-tier candidates.

• Track and report recruitment metrics for continuous process improvement.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Onshore Recruiter Manager

1. Sourcing & Candidate Pipeline

• Source and pre-screen qualified dental professionals (Dentists, Hygienists, Assistants, Front Office Staff).

• Maintain a high submission-to-interview ratio, ensuring high-quality candidates are sent to the onshore team.

• Build and maintain a pipeline of active pre-vetted candidates at any given time.

2. Speed & Efficiency

• Maintain a candidate turnaround time of 24-48 hours from sourcing to submission.

• Ensure 100% accuracy in applicant tracking systems (ATS), maintaining complete candidate profiles and documentation.

• Ensure timely coordination between candidates and hiring managers.

3. Placement & Hiring Performance

• Ensure high placement rate for submitted candidates.

• Ensure 80% of placed candidates remain in their roles beyond 90 days, improving retention for onshore clients.

• Reduce time-to-fill vacancies by meeting staffing demands efficiently.

4. Candidate & Client Experience

• Ensure 100% compliance with U.S. hiring policies, US labor laws, and credentialing requirements.

• Provide weekly recruitment reports with clear updates on sourcing, pipeline, and hiring progress.

5. Team Collaboration & Communication

• Maintain a response time of under 2 hours for all recruiter inquiries and hiring team requests.

• Attend and actively participate in weekly recruiter meetings and training sessions to enhance skills and market knowledge.

• Ensure smooth coordination with onshore recruiters, hiring managers, and clients.



Qualifications

• Experience: 2+ years of recruitment experience, preferably in healthcare, dental, or high-volume staffing (Must have healthcare working history)

• Candidate Sourcing: Strong ability to source, screen, and engage candidates using LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and Boolean searches.

• Recruitment Process Knowledge: Experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing to placement.

• Technology Proficiency: Proficiency in using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter, and recruitment CRM tools.

• Communication & Relationship Building: Excellent English communication skills to engage candidates and coordinate with onshore recruiters.

• Data Accuracy & ATS Management: Ability to maintain 100% accuracy in candidate data entry and status updates.

• Speed & Efficiency: Strong ability to meet daily and weekly hiring targets while maintaining high-quality candidate submissions.

• Collaboration & Teamwork: Ability to work effectively in a remote setting, coordinating with offshore and onshore teams.

• Results-Driven: Ability to meet submission, interview, and placement goals in a fast-paced environment.

• Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Ability to handle high-volume hiring needs while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

All core content, scripts, on-screen text, base graphics, and design direction will be provided. The primary responsibility is to execute the technical production, animate individual visual elements, coordinate audio and animation timing, and deliver a high-quality video alongside a fully editable PowerPoint presentation.

The ideal candidate will combine advanced PowerPoint animation skills with strong visual judgement, audio synchronisation capabilities, and meticulous attention to detail. They should be comfortable working independently with supplied assets and translating a written script into a clear, engaging sequence of visual events.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Advanced PowerPoint Animation

Enhance and prepare the supplied PowerPoint presentation for professional video production.

Separate and prepare graphic elements, illustrations, diagrams, and other visual assets where necessary to enable individual animation.

Create sophisticated animation sequences using PowerPoint's Animation Pane, motion paths, layered graphics, entrance and exit effects, and emphasis animations.

Progressively reveal diagrams, illustrations, text, and other visual components in alignment with the narration.

Control animation order, duration, delays, transitions, and sequencing to ensure a logical and engaging presentation flow.

Synchronise individual graphic movements and appearances with specific sections of the script and narration.

Maintain a consistent visual style across the entire presentation, ensuring that animations enhance understanding rather than distract from the content.

Preserve the editability and structure of the final PowerPoint file for future revisions.

B. Narration and Audio Synchronisation

Work with the supplied script, expected to contain approximately 2,000–3,000 words, and coordinate it with the presentation's visual sequence.

Integrate supplied narration or generate AI-based voiceovers if required and agreed as part of the production workflow.

Use AI voice-generation platforms such as ElevenLabs or comparable tools where necessary.

Divide narration into suitable segments to align with individual slides, visual elements, and animation sequences.

Fine-tune audio timing, pauses, animation triggers, and slide transitions to maintain accurate synchronisation.

Review audio clarity, consistency, playback, and transitions throughout the presentation.

C. Video Production and Export

Convert the completed animated presentation into a high-quality MP4 video.

Configure slide timings and playback settings to ensure the video runs smoothly without requiring manual interaction.

Review the exported video for animation errors, audio mismatches, unexpected pauses, clipped elements, inconsistent transitions, and other playback issues.

Make necessary adjustments to ensure the final video meets professional presentation and production standards.

Ensure the final output maintains a consistent pace and provides a clear, engaging viewing experience.

D. Graphic Preparation and Asset Management

Prepare, edit, and organise supplied graphics for use within the presentation.

Separate complex graphics into individual components when required for progressive animation.

Maintain organised source files and separately prepared graphic assets to support future editing and revisions.

Ensure that visual assets remain properly positioned, proportioned, and consistent across slides.

Deliver all agreed source files and assets in an organised, accessible format.

E. Quality Assurance and Project Delivery

Follow the supplied script, design direction, and production instructions accurately.

Conduct a complete review of the presentation and exported video before delivery.

Check animation timing, narration alignment, slide sequencing, visual consistency, and playback quality.

Resolve technical issues and make agreed refinements within the project scope.

Communicate progress, raise potential production challenges early, and manage the project independently to meet the agreed deadline.

Deliver the final files in the agreed formats and ensure they are ready for future editing or reuse.

3. Essential Skills and Experience

Candidates must demonstrate practical experience in the following areas:

Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint

Strong working knowledge of the Animation Pane, custom animations, motion paths, transitions, layered graphics, and detailed timing controls.

Ability to animate individual elements within complex slides rather than relying solely on basic slide transitions.

Ability to build animation sequences that progressively introduce information in a logical order.

Presentation-to-Video Production

Proven experience creating narrated PowerPoint presentations and exporting them successfully as high-quality MP4 videos.

Understanding of slide timings, playback settings, audio integration, and video quality control.

Ability to troubleshoot animation and playback issues during video export.

Audio and Animation Synchronisation

Experience aligning narration with individual slides, diagrams, text, and animated visual elements.

Strong understanding of timing, sequencing, pauses, transitions, and pacing.

Graphic Manipulation

Ability to prepare and separate supplied graphics into individual elements for animation.

Confidence working with layered visuals, diagrams, illustrations, and other presentation assets.

Attention to Detail and Execution

Strong visual judgement and a methodical approach to quality assurance.

Ability to follow a supplied script and design direction precisely.

Comfortable handling detailed, repetitive production work without compromising quality.

Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and deliver within an agreed project scope.

Portfolio Evidence

Candidates must be able to share relevant examples of animated PowerPoint presentations, narrated training materials, explainer videos, or comparable production work.

Candidates should clearly explain their individual contribution to the showcased projects.

4. Preferred Skills and Tools

The following are advantageous but are not mandatory:

Experience with InstaDoodle, Doodly, or similar whiteboard-animation platforms.

Familiarity with AI voice-generation tools such as ElevenLabs or comparable platforms.

Experience with Camtasia, Adobe Premiere Pro, or other video editing and production software.

Background in e-learning, instructional content, online courses, workshop recordings, training videos, or educational presentations.

Experience producing explainer videos or animated presentations involving complex diagrams and progressive visual explanations.

Familiarity with audio editing, narration segmentation, and basic sound quality optimisation.

Important: Advanced PowerPoint animation and successful presentation-to-video production are the primary selection criteria. Candidates should not be rejected solely because they have not used InstaDoodle or Doodly, provided they demonstrate strong transferable animation skills and a willingness to learn.

5. Project Scope and Deliverables

The successful candidate will be responsible for completing the following deliverables:

Editable PowerPoint presentation: A fully editable PPTX file containing the completed animation sequences, transitions, timing, and integrated narration as agreed.

Final MP4 video: A high-quality video export with correctly synchronised narration, animations, and slide transitions.

Prepared graphic assets: All separately prepared graphic components and other agreed assets required to maintain or revise the presentation.

Quality-checked final output: A reviewed presentation and video with no known unresolved issues relating to animation sequencing, audio synchronisation, or playback.

Organised source files: Source materials structured clearly enough to support future editing and updates.

The project is expected to cover approximately 40 slides and 120 graphic/audio elements. The final scope and specific deliverable requirements will be confirmed before production begins.

6. Project Budget and Engagement Conditions

This is a project-based engagement rather than an hourly employment arrangement.

Candidates should review the deliverables and estimated workload carefully before accepting the project.

Any additional work outside the agreed scope must be discussed and approved separately before commencement.

The candidate must be able to commit the time required to complete the project within the agreed timeline and quality expectations.

7. Potential Follow-On Work: InstaDoodle

Following successful completion of the initial project, there may be opportunities for additional work involving InstaDoodle or similar animation platforms.

Future projects may involve animating individual visual elements in accordance with supplied scripts and narration. Prior InstaDoodle experience is beneficial but not essential, as the platform is expected to be relatively straightforward to learn, with initial familiarisation estimated at approximately 30 minutes.

Any follow-on work will be scoped, scheduled, and agreed separately from the initial PowerPoint project. Recurring or part-time work may be considered depending on future project requirements and performance.

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically capable animation specialist who enjoys turning static information into clear, engaging visual presentations.

They will:

Have a portfolio demonstrating advanced PowerPoint animation or comparable presentation-based video production.

Be confident creating animations at the individual graphic-element level.

Understand how to translate narration into well-timed visual sequences.

Have successfully exported narrated presentations into polished video formats.

Be detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable working with client-provided materials.

Be able to deliver both editable source files and a professional final video.

Be comfortable working within a fixed project budget and agreed scope.

Be open to learning additional animation tools for potential future projects.

9. Screening and Application Requirements

Interested candidates should provide:

An updated CV highlighting relevant PowerPoint animation and video production experience.

A portfolio or links to at least two relevant examples, where available.

A brief explanation of their role in each example and which tools they used.

Confirmation of their experience exporting animated PowerPoint presentations to MP4.

Details of any experience with AI voice-generation tools and audio synchronisation.

Confirmation of their availability to undertake the initial project and complete up to 50 hours of work.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to discuss their production workflow, explain how they would approach the animation and narration requirements, and demonstrate relevant work during an interview.

10. Selection Priorities

Candidates will be assessed primarily on:

Demonstrated advanced PowerPoint animation skills.

Proven experience producing narrated presentations and exporting them to MP4.

Ability to synchronise audio with individual visual elements and animation sequences.

Portfolio quality, attention to detail, and understanding of visual pacing.

Ability to deliver editable source files and organised assets.

Availability, commitment to the fixed project scope, and potential suitability for future work.

Experience with a particular whiteboard-animation platform is secondary to proven production ability.

The objective is to identify a reliable, technically strong specialist who can take supplied content and turn it into a polished, fully editable animated presentation and professional narrated video.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours 



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business. 



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager 



Role Purpose 

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time. 



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events. 



What Success Looks Like 

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance. 



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts. 



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution. 



Primary Objectives 

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System 

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR 

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment 

Competitive Advantage 

 

Regular Work Activities 

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails) 

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking 

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy 

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates 

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track) 

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content) 

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs 

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates 

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates 

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals 

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP) 

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration 

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR 

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required 

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals) 

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement 

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets) 

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing) 

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type) 

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed 

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list) 

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches) 

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues) 

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers) 

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination) 

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests) 



Key Skills 

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth) 

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions) 

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation 

Organized project management across many ASINs 

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating) 

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes 

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops) 

 

People Contacts and Interactions 

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment) 

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes) 

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions) 

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment 



Role Requirements 

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred) 

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent) 

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents) 

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work 

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline 

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back 



How to Apply:

Click the link - 

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

title: Operations Coordinator (Scheduling & Customer Support) · ₱40K–50K + 13th Month · Day Shift · Australian Company
description:
₱40,000–50,000/month + 13th month pay · DAY shift, no graveyard · 2 days off in a row · a long-term role with an Australian company that's growing fast.



Apply here (about 20 minutes): 



No cover letter and no long interview loop. A short video application, then a PAID ₱500 practice shift. Everyone who applies hears back from us.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT



- Pay: ₱40,000–50,000/month based on experience, with a pay review after your 2-month probation, written into your contract

- 13th month pay, paid sick days and paid public holidays

- Day shift: most days 6am–3pm Manila time. No night shift.

- Friday and Saturday off, every week

- Fixed hours in your contract. No surprise schedule changes.

- A small, friendly team that trains you properly and grows its people



ABOUT US



Lee Mathematics Tuition is an online maths tutoring company based in Sydney, Australia. We look after about 280 families and 300 students across Australia, with more than 70 tutors, and we're growing every month. Our operations team is small, and we're adding a coordinator so the desk is properly covered from morning to evening, seven days a week.



WHAT THE JOB REALLY IS



You keep our lessons running. Every week, dozens of lessons need to move: a tutor gets sick, a student has an exam, a parent's schedule changes. You make sure each one lands safely. You find a cover tutor or a new time, update the calendar, and make sure the parent, the student and every tutor involved knows exactly what's happening, in their own time zone.



You also get new families started. When a family signs up, our system suggests tutors who fit. You get those tutors to confirm, agree an exact time with the parent, book the first lesson and make sure it actually happens, usually within 3–4 business days.



You'll work alongside a second coordinator who covers afternoons, evenings and Saturdays. You both learn the whole job and cover each other. Your shift owns the morning side: getting new families to their first lesson, daily account checks and payment follow-ups, and the Sunday and Monday desk on your own.



The honest hard parts:

- People don't always reply. Tutors go quiet, and parents reply at 10pm. You chase, politely, as many times as it takes.

- Australia has several time zones. A Perth parent, a Brisbane tutor and a Sydney calendar can all be part of one lesson. Getting this right every time is non-negotiable.

- Some parents are upset when they call. You stay warm, follow our rules, and never promise what you can't deliver.

- On some shifts you're the only one on. You make the call yourself, using our handbook, and write it down so the next person knows.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Answer parent and tutor messages, calls and
s, usually within 15 minutes

- Move, cover and book lessons in our calendar, and close every loop: old lesson removed, everyone told, times labelled

- Own each new family until their first lesson has happened

- Follow up payments with families (templated messages, with our accounts process behind you)

- Keep each family's record up to date and write a clear handover at the end of your shift



YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU ARE



- Accurate. Names, dates and times are right the first time. You double-check before you send.

- Someone who closes loops. You don't go quiet. Either "done" or "can't yet, because…, I'll update you by 3pm".

- Persistent and quick. You chase within minutes, and you ask three tutors at once instead of waiting on one.

- A fast learner. When we correct something once, it sticks.

- Warm, clear and confident in English, on the phone and in writing, with Australian parents.

- Good at judgement. You know when to d
 and when to ask.

- Comfortable with software: TutorBird, Asana, Slack, Aircall, Notion, WhatsApp, Gmail. We train you on our setup.



Nice to have: scheduling, dispatch, clinic, logistics or coordinator experience; phone support for Australian or US clients.



HOURS: SUNDAY TO THURSDAY (FRIDAY + SATURDAY OFF)



Manila time (Sydney time in brackets):

- Sunday: 6:30am–3:30pm (Sydney 9:30am–6:30pm)

- Monday: 9am–6pm (Sydney 12pm–9pm)

- Tuesday–Thursday: 6am–3pm (Sydney 9am–6pm)



45 hrs/week. These exact hours go into your contract. Your Sydney hours stay fixed; when Australian daylight saving ends in April, the Manila times move 1 hour later.



HOW TO APPLY: WE HIRE ON SKILL, NOT CVs



Apply here: 

(You can also click Apply on OnlineJobs, but the application at this link is what we review.)



1. Application (about 20 minutes, on a laptop with a camera). Your details and CV, a short "why this role" answer, then a short video interview recorded in your browser: 4 questions out loud (one about you, then 3 real situations from our desk). You get a moment to think before each one, and one re-record per question. It's fine to be a little nervous on camera. We're listening for how you think.

2. Paid practice shift (₱500). If your application is strong, you'll get an 80-minute simulated shift. Everyone who completes it is paid, whatever the result.

3. Interview with our team, including a role-played parent call, then references.



Please start your answer to "Why this role, and why you?" with the word SYDNEY, so we know you've read this far.

title: Real Estate Sales & Lead Generation Assistant
description:
Australian Real Estate Experience Required



(Only apply if you have previous experience working with an Australian Real Estate Agency)



We are an established Sydney-based real estate agency seeking an experienced Real Estate Sales Assistant to support our sales team with prospecting, database management, direct client contact, and new business generation.



The primary focus of this role is lead generation, database management, outbound calling, and client nurturing to help grow both our sales listings and property management portfolio.



**This is not an administration-only role. Applicants must be comfortable speaking directly with Australian clients and conducting outbound prospecting calls.**



Applicants must have prior experience working with Australian real estate agencies and systems.



 Key Responsibilities



• Prospect for potential vendors, buyers, landlords and investors

• Conduct outbound calls to database contacts, past clients and prospects

• Generate new business opportunities for both Sales and Property Management

• Maintain and manage the agency CRM database

• Follow up buyers, vendors, landlords and investors

• Nurture client relationships through regular communication

• Track and record all prospecting activity in CRM systems

• Research potential listing opportunities and market activity

• Support agents with database management and pipeline tracking

• Communicate professionally with Australian clients via phone, email and SMS



Essential Experience



Applicants must have previous experience working within Australian real estate.



Experience using the following systems is essential:



• 

• PriceFinder

• PropertyMe

• VaultRE CRM

• Realtair

• Australian real estate ID verification systems



 Mandatory Requirements



**Please do not apply if you do not meet ALL of the following requirements:**



• Previous experience working for an Australian real estate agency

• Direct outbound calling experience to Australian clients

• Experience prospecting for listings, appraisals or property management opportunities

• Fluent spoken and written English with a clear phone manner

• Stable internet connection and professional remote work setup

• Ability to work Sydney business hours



What We Offer



• Base Salary: PHP 45,000 – PHP 55,000 per month (depending on experience)

• Uncapped commission structure

• Potential to earn bonuses exceeding PHP 50,000+ per month for the right candidate

• Long-term remote position

• Stable role with an established Australian agency

• Opportunity for career growth and increased earnings

• Supportive and professional team environment



 Preferred Experience



• Experience supporting Australian real estate agents

• Experience generating listing opportunities and appraisals

• Experience managing sales databases and prospecting campaigns

• Experience communicating directly with Australian property owners and buyers



 Skills Required



• Excellent spoken and written English

• Strong confidence speaking with Australian clients over the phone

• Professional communication skills

• Strong organisational and database management skills

• Attention to detail

• Ability to work independently

• Strong prospecting and sales mindset



 Application Requirements



To apply, please include:



• Your resume detailing Australian real estate experience

• A short video introduction (2-3 minutes)

• Confirmation of experience using the systems listed above

• A brief summary of your outbound calling and prospecting experience

• Examples of listing appointments, appraisals or management leads you have helped generate



**Applications without Australian real estate experience will not be considered.**

title: SPINE 2D / ANIMATOR / GRAPHIC DESIGNER
description:
We are looking for a 2D artist who is also a strong Spine animator (or an artist + animator duo) to create all the art.



The game's math and code are finished and tested. Only art and animation remain, so you will see your work running in the real game quickly.



THE GAME

- Online slot, 6x5 board, cascading symbols, browser-based (PixiJS)

- Tone: action anime, epic and dark. Think boss fight from an anime series, not a generic mobile game



WHAT YOU WILL CREATE (5 phases, each approved and paid before the next)

1. Concept: moodboard, character design (front, profile, enraged state), style test for 3 symbols, background sketch

2. Statics: all symbols, backgrounds (base game and bonus), board frame, UI panels

3. Character in Spine: full rig + 10 animations (idle, hit, seal, rage, defeat, etc.)

4. Symbol animations (land, win, explode), 7 mechanic effects, bonus intro/summary, big win screens

Summary

We're a recruitment partner hiring on behalf of an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events.

That means chasing vendors for paperwork and following through until it's done, and also reaching out to influencers, posting to social, and producing clean graphics in Canva. You won't set strategy or creative direction — you'll be the person who makes sure what's been d

What you'll be doing

- Admin and vendor follow-up — sending contracts and welcome information to 20–25 vendors per event, collecting their documents, tracking who's outstanding, and chasing until everything is closed off. Nobody should have to check whether you followed up.

- Tracking and reporting — keeping the event tracker current, flagging what's overdue, and sending a short end-of-day summary so nothing depends on anyone's memory.

- Influencer and creator outreach — finding local creators who genuinely fit an event, drafting the approach, confirming attendance, chasing content and saving links. Relevance matters more than follower count.

- Social media — scheduling posts, setting up
 Events, keeping bios and pinned content current across Instagram and TikTok.

- Canva graphics — event promos, countdown posts, vendor features, Instagram-ready assets the owner can post without redesigning.

-
 and SMS campaigns — briefing design, scheduling sends, testing links, recording performance.

- Community outreach — researching local businesses, schools, clubs and community pages that could help promote an event, and contacting them.



What we're looking for

- Strong admin and organisation. You follow up relentlessly, politely, and without being asked, and you keep a record of what's been done.

- Comfortable with social media and influencers — you've managed accounts, reached out to creators, or run campaigns for a real business.

- Canva at a solid level. Not just templates — you can produce something a brand would actually post.

# Director of Operations — Remote | U.S.-Based Company



**Company:** PM Assembly



**Type of Work:** Full-Time



**Work Location:** Remote — Philippines



**Hours per Week:** 45 hours



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time



**Salary:** $12–$18 USD per hour ($2,080–$3,120 USD per month), depending on experience and qualifications



### About PM Assembly



PM Assembly is a growing U.S.-based company providing professional assembly and installation services nationwide across all 48 continental states.



We work directly with established brands, manufacturers, and customers, coordinating installation projects through our network of professional technicians across the country.



Our services include furniture assembly, saunas, pergolas, outdoor structures, fitness equipment, and other residential and commercial installations.



We're entering an exciting period of expansion and are looking for an experienced Director of Operations to help build the systems, team, and operational structure needed to support our growth.



### About the Role



We're looking for a highly capable, independent, and experienced operations leader to take ownership of our company's day-to-day operations.



This is a hands-on leadership position with significant responsibility and decision-making authority.



You'll work directly with the company owner, initially managing a team of approximately 2–3 account managers while developing the operational processes needed to support a much larger organization.



Our goal is to build a company that operates efficiently, consistently, and independently, with clear accountability across the team.



You'll have the opportunity to play a major role in shaping how the company operates as it grows.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Daily Operations Management**



- Oversee day-to-day operations and ensure projects are handled accurately and efficiently.

- Manage installation scheduling, project coordination, customer communications, and issue resolution through the account management team.

- Ensure daily priorities are completed and nothing important falls through the cracks.

- Identify operational bottlenecks and implement effective solutions.

- Handle escalated situations that require management-level decisions.



**2. Team Leadership and Management**



- Initially oversee approximately 2–3 account managers, with the responsibility to manage a growing team.

- Establish clear responsibilities, expectations, and performance standards.

- Monitor team productivity, quality of work, and accountability.

- Conduct team meetings, provide feedback, and address performance concerns.

- Create a positive, professional, and results-oriented work environment.



**3. Systems and Process Development**



- Develop and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Build efficient workflows for scheduling, project tracking, customer communication, and technician coordination.

- Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements.

- Implement systems that allow the company to handle increasing installation volume without sacrificing service quality.

- Ensure procedures are documented, consistently followed, and continuously improved.



**4. Hiring and Team Development**



- Identify staffing needs as the company grows.

- Participate in recruiting, interviewing, selecting, and onboarding new employees.

- Develop training processes that allow new team members to become productive quickly.

- Help establish a management structure that can support future expansion.



**5. Quality Control and Accountability**



- Ensure customers and business partners receive a consistently high level of service.

- Monitor installation progress, scheduling accuracy, and project completion.

- Review operational issues and develop solutions to prevent recurring problems.

- Track important performance indicators and report results to company ownership.

- Take responsibility for ensuring the operation runs smoothly.



**6. Business Growth and Operational Strategy**



- Work directly with the owner to prepare the company for increased installation volume.

- Evaluate operational capacity and determine when additional staff or resources are needed.

- Develop strategies to improve efficiency, scalability, and overall performance.

- Help build an organization capable of operating with minimal day-to-day involvement from the owner.



### Qualifications



- At least 4 years of experience in operations management, team leadership, or a comparable management role.

- Demonstrated experience managing employees and holding teams accountable.

- Experience creating or improving operational processes and workflows.

- Strong organizational, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Ability to communicate professionally with U.S.-based customers, business partners, and team members.

- Experience with project management software, CRM systems, spreadsheets, and business communication tools.

- Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable making independent decisions and taking responsibility for outcomes.

- Experience recruiting, onboarding, and training employees.



Experience in field services, installation services, logistics, scheduling, dispatch, or service-based businesses is a plus but not required.



### What We're Looking For



We're interested in someone who:



- Takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions.

- Can make decisions independently and knows when escalation is necessary.

- Has strong leadership skills and can manage people effectively.

- Thinks strategically while remaining involved in daily execution.

- Can build systems and processes rather than simply maintain existing ones.

- Is comfortable taking ownership of problems and seeing them through to resolution.

- Can adapt to a growing business where priorities and responsibilities evolve.

- Communicates clearly, professionally, and confidently.



### Compensation and Benefits



- $12–$18 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- Full-time, long-term remote position.

- Paid time off and company holidays in accordance with our company policy.

- Opportunity for compensation reviews based on performance and responsibilities.

- Direct collaboration with company ownership.

- Opportunity to play a significant role in building and scaling a growing U.S. company.



### Work Schedule



Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with a one-hour unpaid break.



Applicants must be comfortable working this schedule consistently from the Philippines, including the corresponding overnight hours.



### How to Apply



Please submit the following:



**1. Resume or CV**



Include your relevant professional experience, particularly previous operations management and leadership positions.



**2. Loom Introduction Video — Required**



Record a 1–2 minute introduction video using Loom ([
](
)).



In your video, please:



- Briefly introduce yourself.

- Describe your most relevant management experience.

- Share an example of an operational improvement or process you personally implemented.

- Explain what interests you about this position.



Include a shareable Loom link in your application and ensure the video is accessible.



**3. Written Application Questions**



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many employees have you directly managed in your previous positions?

2. Describe a situation where you identified an operational problem and implemented a solution. What was the outcome?

3. Have you ever created operational procedures or systems from scratch? Please provide an example.

4. What was your most recent management position, how long did you hold it, and why did you leave?

5. What are your professional goals over the next 3–5 years?

6. Are you available to work Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time?

7. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



We look forward to learning more about your experience and professional background.

title: Accountant
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Blue Harbour is a New Zealand and Australian consultancy that delivers modern project controls and AI-driven capital intelligence to our clients. We help the organisations that plan and deliver capital programmes make better decisions, faster.



We are a small team growing quickly, and we want our finances run properly from the start. You will work with our Operations Manager, Karrie Hinola, and our founder, Dave Braendler. You will own the books across New Zealand and, from 2027, Australia, and be the person we ask when a money question comes up.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

The core of the role is keeping our accounts accurate and our filings on time, so that the numbers we plan with are the numbers in the bank.



You will keep Xero current, close each month, and prepare and file our New Zealand GST and income tax returns through Xero and myIR. When our Australian entity is set up in 2027, you will take on its GST and BAS as well.



You will also help us keep our budget and forecast model honest as we hire, and advise on paying contractors across New Zealand, Australia and the Philippines. Questions are part of the job. Answering them, routine or not, is covered by the retainer.



REQUIREMENTS

* New Zealand and Australian accounting. Hands-on experience with both: NZ GST, income tax and provisional tax, and Australian GST, BAS and ATO requirements.

* Strong Xero skills. Bank reconciliations, coding, bills, multi-currency and month-end, done cleanly and on time. Xero certification is a plus.

* Filing you can be trusted with. You prepare and lodge returns accurately and before the deadline, and you keep a record of what was filed and when.

* Quick, reliable replies. You answer our questions within one business day and are available for a short call when one is needed.

* Clear communication. You explain the numbers in plain English, so someone without an accounting background can act on what you send.

* You flag problems early. If something looks wrong in the books or a deadline is at risk, we hear it from you first.



EXPERIENCE 

We care most about the clients you have kept in good order.



* Three or more years of bookkeeping or accounting for small businesses

*  At least three overseas client whose books you kept and returns you filed 

*  Month-end closes and simple management reports: a P&L and a cash position

*  Working from a budget or forecast model and explaining the gaps





IDEALLY

*  A degree in accounting or a CPA qualification

*  R&D tax incentive claims in New Zealand or Australia

*  NZ payroll and KiwiSaver

*  Paying contractors across borders and in several currencies



WHY THIS ROLE

*  Set up the finances of a growing business from early on, and shape how they are run

*  Steady, ongoing work across two countries, with a third entity coming

*  A small team that answers your questions quickly too

*  Grow the scope of the role as the business grows



HOW WE HIRE

Send a short note covering overseas clients (ideally Australian or New Zealand)  whose books you have kept in Xero, how long you have worked in Xero, and confirm the retainer range works for you. Shortlisted applicants have a video call, and we speak to two of your current clients. The first month is a trial on our own books. We pay attention to how quickly and clearly you reply along the way, because that is the job.

[Who We Are Looking For]

K-POP Content Creator & Video Editor (On-Camera Role)

We are not looking for a Video Editor who only edits footage provided by others.

We are looking for someone who genuinely loves K-POP and can take ownership of the entire content creation process:



**Trend Research → Idea Generation → Scriptwriting → B-roll Research → Shooting → Video Editing**



You will create both short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts and long-form content for YouTube.

Your goal is to create engaging content that attracts new audiences, grows the HiDuckoo brand, and ultimately contributes to sales.



[Responsibilities]

1. K-POP Content Planning

Follow current K-POP trends, including new artists, comebacks, fandom topics, memes, albums, merchandise, and social media trends, and turn them into engaging content ideas.

You should be able to independently research a topic, develop an idea, write a script, and plan the necessary B-roll.

2. HiDuckoo Behind-the-Scenes Content

Create interesting content from our actual e-commerce operations, including:

- Purchasing and receiving K-POP albums and merchandise

- New product arrivals

- Order processing

- Packing and shipping

- Warehouse and day-to-day operations

- HiDuckoo team behind-the-scenes

You should be able to turn ordinary business activities into content K-POP fans will enjoy watching.

3. Video Editing

Create and edit:

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok videos

- YouTube Shorts

- YouTube long-form videos

Use B-roll, subtitles, music, sound effects, transitions, hooks, storytelling, and pacing to create engaging videos that keep viewers watching.

4. On-Camera Content

For some content (refer to our 
 you will film yourself and appear on camera.

You do not need to appear in every video, but you must be comfortable speaking to viewers and having your face publicly featured on the company's social media channels.



[Required Qualifications]

- Strong video editing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software

- Ability to edit both short-form and long-form content

- Strong interest in K-POP and active understanding of current trends

- Ability to independently research and plan content

- Ability to research and use appropriate B-roll

- Comfortable filming yourself and appearing on camera



[Preferred Qualifications]

- Experience creating K-POP or social media content

- Experience running a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or K-POP fan account

- Understanding of hooks, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with Photoshop or Canva

- Experience in social media marketing or e-commerce

- Experience creating product or behind-the-scenes content

- Experience using AI tools such as Higgsfield, Seedance, ElevenLabs, Runway, CapCut AI, or similar tools in a content creation workflow



[Compensation & Benefits]

*Probationary Period: 6 Months

- Months 0–3: USD 250/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month, subject to satisfactory performance

The probationary period may be shortened for excellent performance.

*After Regularization:

- Base Salary: USD 300/month

- Guaranteed 13th Month Pay

- One-year contract renewal basis

- Performance-based incentives and salary increases

*Performance & Salary Growth

Content performance matters. Meaningful growth in social media followers and/or sales on the HiDuckoo online shopping mall will be considered for performance incentives and salary increases.

Outstanding results may lead to an earlier salary increase.

*Benefits

- 10 additional paid leave days after regularization

- One K-POP album from your favorite artist on your birthday after six months of employment

- Paid holidays on January 1st and Christmas Day

- Opportunity to work with an existing Filipino team of 5+ members

*Long Service Incentive

- 1 Year: PHP 17,000

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
Accounts Receivable Specialist



Job Overview: 

We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Accounts Receivable Specialist to support the financial operations of a residential property management portfolio. This role will handle resident payments, cash applications, account reconciliations, billing, and high-volume transactions while ensuring accurate financial records and timely payment processing.



The specialist will also assist with financial reporting, resolve payment discrepancies, monitor delinquent accounts, and coordinate collection efforts, including preparing necessary documentation for collection-related matters. Strong accounts receivable knowledge and proficiency in Microsoft Excel are essential, while experience with Yardi is a plus.





Key Responsibilities:

Handling cash applications, reconciliations, payment posting, and handling a high volume of transactions



Perform accounts receivable functions including depositing and recording payments, handling payment disputes, and collecting on returned payments.



Prepare, post, verify, and record customer payments and transactions related to accounts receivable.



Collaborate with the AR Manager to reconcile accounts receivable on a periodic basis.



Prepare financial reports through collection, analysis, and summarization of data.



Assist in generating monthly billing statements based on the general ledger.



Assist Accounting Manager in reconciling bank accounts each month.



Copy, file, and retrieve materials for Accounts Receivable as needed.



Create reports regarding the current status of resident accounts as requested.



Research customer discrepancies and past-due amounts with the assistance of the AR Manager and team.



Collaborate with collections agency to submit applicable paperwork and provide documentation for collection efforts.



Assist with the filing process for court-related issues including failure to pay rent, breach of lease, tenant holding over and money judgement cases.



Draft correspondence for standard past-due accounts and collections, identifies delinquent accounts by reviewing files, and contacts delinquent accountholders to request payment.





Required Skills & Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.



Previous experience in accounts receivable or accounting, preferably in property management.



Excellent verbal and written communication skills.



Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Office 365; experience with Yardi is a plus.



Knowledge of accounts receivable processes, including cash applications, payment posting, and account reconciliation.



Experience handling high-volume transactions, researching payment discrepancies, and following up on past-due accounts.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.



Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



Ability to maintain accurate financial records, handle confidential information, and interact professionally with residents.









Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Graphic Designer & Shopify Support VA
description:
Graphic Design & Customer Service Associate



About the Role

We are looking for a versatile and highly organized Graphic Design & Customer Service Associate to support both the creative and customer service functions of a growing business.

This is a hybrid role ideal for someone who has a strong foundation in graphic design, communicates exceptionally well in writing, and enjoys learning new systems and taking on different responsibilities.

You will support recurring graphic design requirements while also assisting with order processing, customer inquiries, and day-to-day administrative tasks. The role will evolve alongside the business, so adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn are essential.



Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Creative Support

Create and update recurring marketing and communications materials using established templates and brand guidelines.

Make design adjustments and prepare weekly or ongoing creative assets.

Work confidently with Adobe Creative Suite.

Use or learn Figma for existing designs and templates.

Maintain consistency across visual materials and ensure work follows established brand standards.

Collaborate with the graphic design team on creative requirements.

The client specifically identified Adobe Creative Suite as something they cannot currently train internally, while Figma and their other systems can be taught.



Customer Service & E-Commerce Support

Process customer and e-commerce orders through platforms including Shopify and other internal ordering systems.

Manage customer service tickets and general inquiries.

Assist customers with order status, stock availability, account credits, and other routine concerns.

Draft clear, professional, and thoughtful email responses.

Support administrative tasks related to order processing and customer service.

Coordinate internally through Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, video calls, and other business systems.

Customer interaction will initially be predominantly written rather than phone-based, making excellent written communication particularly important.



Must-Have Qualifications

Working knowledge and practical experience with Adobe Creative Suite.

Strong written English communication skills.

Ability to draft professional customer emails independently.

Good eye for detail and ability to follow established brand guidelines.

Comfortable learning and navigating multiple software platforms.

Reliable computer capable of handling multiple programs and creative applications.

Comfortable working remotely and communicating through Teams, WhatsApp, and video calls.

Strong critical thinking skills and ability to work independently.



Nice to Have

Experience with Figma.

Experience with Shopify or another e-commerce platform.

Previous customer service or administrative experience.

Experience managing customer support tickets.

Experience working in a remote or distributed team.

Previous e-commerce experience is not required; the client is comfortable training the right person on their systems.



Who We're Looking For

More than anything, we're looking for someone who is:

Professional, kind, and respectful

Clear and confident in their communication

Curious and genuinely willing to learn

Comfortable asking questions rather than making assumptions

Adaptable and able to take on different responsibilities as priorities change

Empathetic and thoughtful when communicating with customers

Positive and collaborative

Able to think independently and use AI as a supporting tool—not as a substitute for their own judgment

The client emphasized that rudeness, disrespect, negativity, and an unwillingness to learn are deal breakers. They value people who clarify when unsure, communicate confidently, and genuinely care about their work and customers.



What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate doesn't need to know every system on day one. Training will be progressive, with new responsibilities introduced as each area is mastered. What matters is having the creative foundation we can't teach, paired with the attitude and willingness to learn everything we can.

If you have a strong Adobe Creative Suite foundation, communicate exceptionally well, and enjoy being the kind of person who can wear different hats in a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: WORLD CLASS CONTENT CREATOR: I LOST IT ALL. I'M FILMING THE COMEBACK.
description:
I LOST IT ALL. I'M FILMING THE COMEBACK. I NEED THE PERSON WHO TURNS IT INTO AN AUDIENCE. Content Manager and Video Editor. Full-time, remote, Philippines. USD $1,000 to $1,300 a month plus a bonus of up to $200.



THE RAW MATERIAL I took a company to number 1 on the Australian Financial Review fastest-growing list.



A $55M property portfolio.

$200M of development projects.

$150M in client equity growth and profits.

A $40M net worth before I turned 35, with multiple companies and 30+ staff. Then I trusted the wrong person, got too ambitious and lost every cent. Now I'm rebuilding it in public. Legal restrictions most people never face. A divorce. A blended family heading to six kids. A new business from scratch. And a camera on all of it. That's the story. The reason people stay is what's under it: the investing, lending, property development and high-ticket sales I've actually done, and the strategy I use to plan every move back.



THE JOB I film everything. You turn every minute of it into a YouTube channel people binge and a feed they can't scroll past.



The podcast, the YouTube channel, 7am car rants, sales calls, whiteboard trainings, Looms, meetings and vlogs.

A full-time videographer and an on-camera team are coming.

A 40 minute training becomes a YouTube video, eight clips, a carousel, three posts and a quote card. Nothing gets used once.

A headline hits the news at 9am. My take is cut over it by lunch.

Short clips get strangers in. YouTube is where they d
 to trust me, so every clip sends them there.

Views don't pay the bills. Every piece gives real value and ends on one clear next step. You track each piece to a booked call, so we make more of what converts and drop what doesn't.



THE SERIES The Comeback is a daily vlog, Day 1 to Day 365. It's the front door to everything else.



One vertical video a day, filmed by me. You cut it, caption it and post it inside the day.

Real time. The wins, the mess and the strategy behind every move.

Your job is to make Day 1 and Day 300 equally hard to scroll past: the hook, the pacing, the thread that makes someone come back tomorrow.

Every episode ends on one next step. You choose it, test it and tell me which ones bring people in.

Weekend episodes are cut on Monday and scheduled.



WHAT YOU OWN EVERY WEEK



The edits. A Loom can go up as it is. A rant needs to hit hard. You d
 which is which without asking me.

The titles, thumbnails, descriptions and chapters.

The Comeback: one episode a day, cut and posted within the day.

Every link tagged, so a booked call traces back to the piece that caused it.

The posting on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X and
.

The best clips from every podcast episode. The podcast has its own editor for the episode itself.

The comments and DMs.

A weekly report on what worked and what flopped, and why. It leads with calls booked and clicks, then views.

The winners, handed to my ads editor to turn into paid ads.



WHAT YOU GET



A real story and a real audience to build, not a faceless brand.

A direct line to me. A 20 minute check-in every day, and no committee between you and a decision.

A name of your own. As the team grows around this, you run content. I plan for that to be you.

USD $1,000 to $1,300 a month depending on what you bring, plus a monthly bonus of up to $200 for on-time delivery and for calls booked from your content. Full-time, paid monthly.



YOU'RE THE ONE IF



You've cut long-form and short-form for real channels and can show me the views.

You know in the first two seconds if a hook is dead, and you'll tell me why.

You'd take a clip that books calls over a viral clip that doesn't.

You live in Claude, ChatGPT and whatever clipping tool dropped this week. You find clips in a transcript, draft hooks in batches and rewrite anything that sounds like a robot.

You can keep a daily series fresh for a year without it going stale.

You make the call and move.

You want your name on something that's going somewhere.

Fluent English, written and spoken. Manila hours, 9am to 6pm.



YOU'RE NOT IF



Your portfolio is template talking-head cuts.

You wait to be told what to do.

You still do it all by hand.



HOW TO APPLY There's a test. It takes about 90 minutes and it's the interview. Do it before I speak to anyone. No test, no call. Everything you need is in this Google Drive folder: [G DRIVE LINK] It holds a 46 minute screen recording of one of my trainings, five 3 minute side-angle phone clips of me recording it, a transcript and a news headline screenshot. The transcript has mistakes, so check names and terms before you caption anything. You don't need to do everything. I'd rather see 2 great clips than 6 rushed ones.



THE TEST



Clips. Pick the 5 best moments from the recording, with timestamps and one line on why for each. Edit 2 as vertical clips with captions: one punchy, one calm. Use a side angle in at least one.

Hooks. Write 3 different opening lines for your best clip, and tell me which you'd use. For that clip, write the one next step you'd end on and why.

The full video. Give me a YouTube title, 3 thumbnail ideas (a sketch or Canva mock is fine), a description with chapters, and a short plan for how you'd cut it, including where the side angles go.

Posts. Write one LinkedIn post and one X post from the training, in my voice. Then write a 30 second take on the headline and mock up the green screen: a frame of me over the headline, a highlight on the key line and big captions. A still image is enough.

Your AI. Record your screen (5 minutes max) showing how you used AI on the above: the tools, the prompts, what you kept and one thing you threw away. Use AI as much as you like. No screen recording, no score.



HOW TO SEND IT



One
 to 
 with a Google Drive link (anyone with the link can view).

Subject line: SASHA CONTENT. If it's wrong, I won't open it.

Send it within 72 hours of opening the folder.

I'll reply within 3 working days either way.

title: Senior Accountant / Controller (PTO, 13th Month, Bonuses)
description:
Most controller titles offered from the Philippines are a bookkeeping queue with a better name. This one is the real seat. You will be the financial authority for business groups with up to $30 million in revenue, and you will still do your own bank recs.



Who we are



We are a US accounting and tax firm. We have worked with business owners since 1991, and most of our accounting work is for multi-unit franchise groups: owners with ten, twenty or more stores, each in its own entity, closing on the franchise system's period calendar.



You would work directly with us. No agency in the middle, no account manager speaking for you, and nobody billing your hours to a client you are never allowed to talk to.



The seat



You are the controller for a group of our largest franchise clients. When an owner asks whether they can afford the next store, or what the bank will see in the covenant test, you are the person who knows. Not because you read a summary someone else prepared. Because you built the numbers.



What you own:



The close and the financial statements. Every period, on the franchise system's calendar, which for most of our clients means a 13-period year. Statements the owner can use, ready when promised.

Budgets and cash forecasts. You tell the owner what the next quarter looks like before it arrives.

Lender and covenant reporting. You run the covenant calculations and you know where each group stands against its loan terms before the bank does.

Internal controls. Over cash and payables, store by store. You find the gap before it becomes a loss.

Store purchases and sales. You read the closing documents, book the purchase price allocation, set up or retire the assets and intangibles, and produce the numbers a buyer or a lender will ask for.

The owner relationship. You are the owner's main financial contact. You explain the numbers on a call, plainly, and you send weekly reports to the clients who get them. Every week, without a reminder.



You still do the work



This is not an advisory role and it is not a management role. The person in this seat does bank reconciliations.

You reconcile the accounts yourself. Groups with dozens of bank accounts across dozens of entities. You find every difference and you prove it. You do not plug it, and you do not book a balancing entry to make it go away.

You book the hard entries yourself. Franchise fees and the intangibles they create, their amortization, and activity between related entities.

You review newer staff within 48 hours and send their work back with notes they can learn from.

You train. When a newer accountant asks how a client works, you show them that day.

You write it down. Every client you run has a current written procedure: how its bank feeds work and which entries are unusual to it.



If a controller title means you stopped touching reconciliations years ago, this is the wrong seat. We want someone who can explain a covenant test to an owner at ten in the morning and find a $312 difference in a bank rec at eleven.



The grunt work is going away. You help us retire it



We are rolling out AI tools over the coming months, and bank reconciliation matching is first on the list. The aim is to take the repetitive work off your desk so your hours go to the judgment calls.



You will help us test these tools on real clients. That means using them, telling us where they get things wrong, and checking every number they produce until we trust them. You do not need prior experience with AI. You need to want it, and you need to stay skeptical of it.



Hours



You work Philippine hours with a fixed overlap into the US Eastern morning, 7 to 11am Eastern. Owners call in that window and our team meets in it. We agree the rest of your day with you and then we keep to it.



Pay and Benefits



$4,500 USD per month

Plus 13th month pay. Uncommon in a contractor arrangement. We pay it anyway

Unlimited paid time off. The statutory floor in this country is five days a year. We do not count yours at all, and we expect you to spend it

Philippine daytime hours with one agreed US overlap window

Philippine public holidays observed. You work your country's calendar, not ours

Signing bonus to cover a second monitor, UPS, or generator

US CPA or EA sponsorship if you want it. We pay the fees and give you study time

That is the top of what this market pays a controller on US accounts, and we set it there on purpose. We want the best person available, and we do not want to lose them the moment somebody else makes an offer.



What you bring



At least eight years of accounting for US clients, with at least three of them owning the full close and financial reporting for a multi-entity group, as controller or in practice

Franchise or other multi-unit experience: many entities under one owner, with numbers that have to tie

Hands-on experience with store or business acquisitions and sales: closing documents, purchase price allocation, intangibles and amortization

Budgets, cash forecasts and loan covenant reporting you have built yourself

Bank reconciliations you have done yourself in the last twelve months

Experience reviewing other accountants' work and training newer staff

Thomson Reuters Accounting CS. If your command is in another professional package, say which and we will talk. QuickBooks Online and ShareFile are useful

A record of logging your time on every task, because some of our clients are billed on it

English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements to a US business owner on a live call

A stable home setup and the discipline to run your own day

A Philippine CPA or progress toward a US CPA is a plus. It is not required.



How we work



Read this part twice. We hire for it with the same weight as the technical skills above.

No task is beneath the seat. The controller does reconciliations. The title does not change that.

We change how we work, often. We are rebuilding the firm around automation, and processes that worked last year get replaced. When a new process arrives, you try it in good faith. If you think it is wrong, you say so in writing to the person who owns it, with your reasons, and then you follow the decision.

Your knowledge belongs on paper. Being the only person who knows how a client works is not job security here. It is a risk to the client, and we treat it as one.

Disagree with the work, never with the person. Problems go to the right person, privately, in a normal tone. We do not settle disagreements in the team chat.

You own your deadlines. If one is going to slip, you tell us before it slips, not after.

Verify, do not guess. A number you cannot support is not finished, however close the deadline is.



Your first 90 days



Days 1 to 30: You learn our systems and shadow the accountant who runs each client today through one full period close. By day 30 you have run one close yourself with review, bank recs included.

Days 31 to 60: You run your clients' closes and reconciliations yourself, weekly reports included. Every client you hold has a written procedure, written or updated by you. You have had a first financial review call with each owner.

Days 61 to 90: Each of your groups has a cash forecast and, where it has a loan, a covenant calculation you built. You are reviewing newer staff within 48 hours. You have tested our first AI reconciliation tool on at least one of your clients and told us what it gets wrong.



To apply



Apply through this form: 
/controller-application



It takes about 20 minutes, and your answers are the first thing we read.



Do not
 or apply through OLJ
