Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands. 



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: Growth Strategist + Social Media Poster
description:
Hi 



We're a small, growing team with **3 brands**: two financial services companies and one software product that connects to one of them. We're looking for someone who can **help us get more people using our services** and also keep our *
 and Instagram** running every day.



**This is a small add-on gig, not a full-time or part-time job.** It's perfect if you already have a main job or other clients and want steady extra work on the side. ⏰ **Max 10 hours per week.**



---



**💼 What you'll do**



**1. Growth strategy (core part of this role)**



🎯 **The goal:** We're not looking for more likes or followers. **We want more people actually using our services.**



**How you do it is up to you.** The only rule: **no running ads for now.**



What we expect from you:

- Find the best ways to reach people who need our services

- Plan and carry out marketing strategies that bring in real customers and sign-ups

- Identify the right channels, audiences and approaches for each brand

- Track what's working, what's not, and recommend what to do next

- Share clear, practical ideas and help put them into action



**2. Post and schedule on
 and Instagram**

- Post **one post per day** for our brands on *
 and Instagram only**

- Schedule posts ahead of time so everything goes out on time

- Attach our logo to each post



**Important: you will NOT create or edit posts.** 🙅 Every post will be ready for you: the design, caption, hashtags and logo. Please don't create your own posts, write your own captions or change anything. Your job here is simply to attach the logo, post it exactly as provided and schedule it. No social media design or writing experience needed for this part.



---



**✅ Who we're looking for**

- Experience or strong understanding of marketing and growth, especially getting customers, leads or sign-ups (not just followers)

- Strategic thinker who can explain ideas clearly

- Reliable and consistent: posting every day matters to us

- Good attention to detail (right logo, right brand, right time)

- Follows instructions carefully (posts go out exactly as provided)

- Good English communication skills

- Has a computer and stable internet

- Bonus: experience with financial services or software/SaaS marketing

- Bonus: knows Meta Business Suite (for scheduling on
 and Instagram)



---



**💰 Pay**

- **$100/month** (for up to 10 hours per week)

- **The rate is not negotiable.** Please apply only if you're okay with $100/month.

- As we grow, we may be open to a **bonus or raise based on your performance and results** later on.



**🎁 What we offer**

- Flexible schedule: work when it suits you, as long as posts go out on time

- A team that values and acts on your ideas

- Chance to grow with us as our brands grow 🌱



---



**📩 How to apply**

Send us a short message with:

1. A little about yourself 😊

2. Your marketing or growth experience. What results did you get? (customers, leads, sales)

3. **One idea for how a financial services brand could get more people to actually use its services without running ads**



We can't wait to meet you! 💙

title: Technical Support Specialist –Electrical Background Required
description:
WE ARE HIRING!

Technical Support Specialist

Electrical Background Required | Mandarin Preferred

100% Remote | Work From Home – Philippines

Company: MicromallNZ Ltd

Job Location: Philippines – Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Monthly Salary: PHP 25,000–35,000 gross, depending on technical experience and qualifications

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Working Hours: Starting at 7:00 AM-3:00 PM Philippine Time, with an 8-hour work schedule including a 1-hour break, subject to final agreement

About Our Company

MicromallNZ Ltd is an established renewable energy and technology company based in Auckland, New Zealand.

Founded in 2007, we specialise in the distribution, supply, installation and after-sales support of lithium batteries, solar inverters, solar energy systems and related electrical products.

We are an authorised Deye distributor and service centre, supporting homeowners, solar installers, electricians and businesses throughout New Zealand and the Pacific region.

As our business continues to grow, we are looking for a technically capable and customer-focused Technical Support Specialist based in the Philippines.

This role requires an electrical, electronics or renewable-energy background. The successful candidate will provide remote technical assistance for solar inverters, lithium batteries, battery chargers and related electrical products.

Key Responsibilities

1. Remote Technical Support

- Provide technical assistance to customers, electricians and solar installers through
, WhatsApp, phone calls and video calls.

- Diagnose faults involving solar inverters, lithium batteries, battery chargers, BMS communication and related electrical products.

- Guide customers through product setup, configuration, commissioning and troubleshooting procedures.

- Analyse error codes, alarm messages, system logs, photos, wiring diagrams and videos.

- Assist customers with inverter and battery settings.

- Provide safe and practical troubleshooting instructions based on product manuals and company procedures.

- Escalate complex cases to our senior technical team or product manufacturers when necessary.

2. Solar and Battery System Troubleshooting

- Support 12V, 24V and 48V lithium battery systems.

- Assist with grid-connected, off-grid and hybrid solar inverter systems.

- Help identify issues involving AC and DC wiring, voltage, current, communication cables, circuit protection and system configuration.

- Troubleshoot inverter-to-battery communication, including CAN and RS485 connections.

- Assist with battery charging, discharging, balancing and BMS-related issues.

- Review basic electrical diagrams and system configurations.

- Help customers collect voltage readings, error codes and other diagnostic information.

- Ensure all guidance follows product manuals and appropriate electrical-safety procedures.

This is a remote-support position. Any work requiring physical electrical installation or testing must be carried out by a suitably qualified person at the customer’s location.

3. Warranty and After-Sales Support

- Assess technical issues relating to warranty claims and product returns.

- Collect required evidence, including serial numbers, photos, videos, system logs and test results.

- Determine whether an issue relates to product configuration, installation, compatibility or a potential product fault.

- Coordinate warranty cases with customers, installers, the New Zealand team and suppliers.

- Arrange replacement parts, returns and repair requests when approved.

- Maintain accurate technical-support and warranty records.

- Follow up on unresolved cases until they are completed.

- Keep customers regularly informed about the progress of their cases.

4. Technical Documentation and Product Support

- Prepare clear technical instructions and troubleshooting guides.

- Document common faults and their solutions for future reference.

- Review and understand product manuals, datasheets and wiring diagrams.

- Assist with preparing FAQs, installation notes and internal technical procedures.

- Provide product-selection and compatibility guidance when required.

- Participate in product and technical training provided by MicromallNZ and our suppliers.

5. Customer Communication

- Write clear, professional and technically accurate English
s.

- Explain technical information in a way that customers can easily understand.

- Communicate patiently and professionally with customers experiencing product issues.

- Work closely with our customer-support, sales and warehouse teams.

- Mandarin Chinese communication skills would be an advantage, particularly when communicating with suppliers, but are not essential.

Qualifications and Requirements

Essential Requirements

- Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Renewable Energy, Mechatronics or a related technical field.

- Alternatively, substantial hands-on experience with electrical, solar, battery or power-electronics products may be considered.

- Sound understanding of basic electrical principles, including voltage, current, power, AC/DC systems and electrical safety.

- Ability to understand wiring diagrams, technical manuals and product datasheets.

- Familiarity with electrical testing equipment such as multimeters and clamp meters.

- Strong fault-finding, analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Ability to explain technical matters clearly and professionally.

- Good computer skills, including
, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

- Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with a remote international team.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-working environment.

- Responsible, organised, patient and willing to learn.

Preferred Qualifications

- One or more years of experience in solar, electrical, electronics, battery, inverter or technical-support work.

- Experience installing, commissioning or troubleshooting solar inverter and battery systems.

- Knowledge of lithium iron phosphate batteries, BMS systems and battery communication.

- Familiarity with hybrid, off-grid and grid-connected solar systems.

- Experience with Deye, Sunsynk or similar inverter brands.

- Experience supporting electricians, solar installers or end users remotely.

- Experience handling warranty claims and technical product returns.

- Experience working with customers in New Zealand, Australia or other English-speaking countries.

- Philippine electrical qualifications, such as Registered Electrical Engineer or Registered Master Electrician, would be an advantage but are not mandatory.

- Mandarin Chinese skills would be an advantage.

Fresh graduates with a relevant electrical or electronics qualification, strong English skills and good troubleshooting ability are welcome to apply.

Training Provided

MicromallNZ will provide training covering:

- Deye solar inverters and energy-storage systems.

- Lithium battery products and BMS operation.

- Inverter and battery configuration.

- Common fault codes and troubleshooting procedures.

- Remote diagnostic methods.

- Warranty and after-sales processes.

- Customer communication and case management.

- Internal technical documentation and support systems.

What We Offer

- Monthly salary of PHP 35,000–50,000, depending on qualifications, experience and recruitment-assessment performance.

- 100% remote working arrangement.

- Full-time opportunity with an established New Zealand company.

- Product and technical training.

- Exposure to modern solar, battery and renewable-energy technology.

- Long-term career-development opportunities.

- Supportive international working environment.

- Statutory benefits where applicable under the employment arrangement and relevant laws.

How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your updated CV or résumé in English.

2. A brief introduction describing your electrical, electronics, solar or technical-support experience.

3. Details of any solar inverters, lithium batteries or electrical products you have worked with.

4. Copies or details of relevant qualifications and licences.

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

6. Your earliest available starting date.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a basic technical assessment and attend an online interview.

 Subject: Application – Technical Support Specialist

Company: MicromallNZ Ltd

Website: 

Location: Auckland, New Zealand

We are looking for someone who has a solid electrical foundation, communicates clearly, enjoys solving technical problems and takes ownership of customer issues.

If you are interested in solar energy, battery technology and remote technical support, we would love to hear from you!

title: Executive Virtual Assistant – Client Booking, Social Media & Shopify

title: Part-Time Local SEO Specialist
description:
Agency: Blacksmith SEO & Digital | Remote — Philippines



Hours: 20 hours per week to start

Schedule: At least 6 of your 24 weekly hours must overlap with Pacific Time business hours, on an agreed schedule. The remaining hours can be worked flexibly around deadlines.



About the role

Blacksmith SEO & Digital is looking for a detail-oriented Local SEO Specialist to support local search campaigns, Google Business Profile management, citation maintenance, and reporting.



You should have practical experience with BrightLocal, Ahrefs, and Google reporting datasets. We’re looking for someone who can identify issues, make thoughtful recommendations, complete approved updates, and clearly explain the results.



What you’ll do

Manage Google Business Profiles: Help set up and optimise profiles, coordinate verification, and maintain accurate categories, services, descriptions, hours, contact information, photos, and service areas.



Make constructive profile edits: Investigate incorrect information, document proposed changes, and implement approved updates. Follow Google’s requirements for accurate business representation and profile eligibility.



Audit and maintain citations: Find and correct inconsistent business names, addresses, and phone numbers; identify duplicate listings; and build relevant local and industry citations.



Monitor Maps rankings: Use BrightLocal’s local rank tracking and geo-grid reports to assess visibility, identify gaps, and monitor competitors.



Research SEO opportunities: Use Ahrefs for local keyword research, competitor analysis, backlink reviews, and content opportunities.



Prepare reports: Bring together BrightLocal, Ahrefs, Google Business Profile, Search Console, and GA4 data. Explain performance changes, completed work, issues, and recommended next steps.



Support website optimisation: Recommend or implement improvements to service pages, location pages, titles, headings, internal links, and locally relevant content.



Keep work organised: Maintain task lists, citation records, change logs, and reporting schedules across multiple accounts.



What you’ll bring:

Demonstrable local SEO experience—not just general SEO knowledge.

Hands-on proficiency with BrightLocal and Ahrefs.

Strong understanding of Google Business Profile, Google Maps, citations, and business information consistency.

Confidence working with Google datasets, including Search Console, GA4, and Business Profile performance data.

Strong Google Sheets skills and familiarity with Looker Studio / Google Data Studio.

Clear written English and the ability to turn data into useful observations.

Good judgment, attention to detail, and confidence asking questions before making sensitive changes.

Ability to work independently, follow documented processes, and meet deadlines.

A reliable computer, stable internet connection, and availability for the required Pacific Time overlap.



Nice to have:

Experience supporting Canadian or US businesses.

Experience with ClickUp

Agency experience managing multiple client accounts.

Familiarity with WordPress, LocalBusiness schema, UTM tracking, and technical SEO fundamentals.

Experience with multi-location businesses, service-area businesses, and citation cleanup.

Other experience with technical SEO (not a deal breaker - just a nice-to-have)



How to apply



Please include:

Your résumé or professional profile.

A short explanation of how you use BrightLocal and Ahrefs.

One example of a local SEO project, including your contribution and results.

An anonymised report or dashboard sample.

title: Senior Civil Designer
description:
We are hiring a Senior Civil Designer to produce and quality-check the CAD and drafting side of our submittals, working from direction given by the Senior Civil Engineer and staff engineers.



Responsibilities

Prepare grading, drainage, erosion control, and utility sheets in Civil 3D from engineer markups and the project’s approved Design Basis Memo.

Build and maintain surfaces, profiles, sections, and sheet sets, and generate earthwork quantities for engineer review.

Prepare BMP exhibits, details, and callouts for WQMP/SWQMP packages according to the applicable regional manual.

Prepare erosion control and SWPPP BMP sheets. The designer prepares the sheets; a QSD prepares and signs the SWPPP.

Incorporate plan-check redlines and support the comment response matrix for each resubmittal.

Perform a drafting QC pass before every submittal using the firm checklist: callouts, standard drawing references, sheet index, scales, legends, general notes, and consistency across sheets.

Maintain CAD templates, blocks, the details library, and sheet-set standards.

Flag in writing any conflict between an engineer’s markup and the California Building Code or a jurisdiction’s standards. Escalate the conflict rather than resolving it independently.

Provide a daily written status update and keep questions and decisions documented in the project folder.

Support staff engineers by answering drafting and standards questions and explaining what each jurisdiction expects to see on a sheet, in sessions scheduled by mutual agreement.



Required Qualifications

Five or more years of civil and land development design experience, with a portfolio of California permit sets.

Advanced Civil 3D proficiency, including surfaces, profiles, corridors, sheet sets, and xrefs.

Working knowledge of California practice:

Grading: California Building Code Chapter 18 and Appendix J, and local grading ordinances.

Hydrology: county hydrology manual conventions.

Stormwater: regional WQMP/SWQMP requirements.

Erosion control: the Construction General Permit.

Standards: Greenbook, SDRSD, Caltrans, and city standard drawings.

Accessibility: CBC Chapter 11B.

Direct experience with plan-check cycles in Southern California jurisdictions.

Clear written English and reliable availability during the overlap hours.

Successful completion of a paid practical screening exercise.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with ADU and single-family residential grading packages.

Bluebeam Revu proficiency.

Familiarity with hydrology and hydraulic calculation tools.

title: Remote Tech Support Rep

Diagnose technical issues, identify root causes, and escalate complex problems to the development team.

Guide customers through technical processes using clear, easy-to-understand instructions.

Previous experience in technical support, IT help desk, SaaS support, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

title: Director of Client Accounting Services
description:
Pay: $6,000 to $7,000 USD a month

Schedule: Full time. Core hours 9am to 2pm US Eastern on working days.

Reports to: Senior Director, Operations. Works directly with the owner.



You are the person other accountants bring the problem to. The difference nobody can find. The intercompany balance that will not tie. The client who has run out of patience. You fix it, and then someone above you, who often knows less about it than you do, d
 what happens next. This job gives you the decisions.



About Monterra

Monterra is a US accounting and tax firm. We have served business owners since 1991. Most of our clients own many businesses at once: groups with ten, twenty or more locations, each its own company, with numbers that have to tie across all of them.



• Specialists. We have built the firm around owners of many businesses, so you spend your time on hard, interesting books instead of a long tail of one-off files.

• Thirty-five years, and growing. New multi-location groups signed with us this fall, and not one client has left us in the past year.

• We build our own tools. We wrote our own tax planning software, and we are rebuilding accounting the same way.

• Remote by design. The whole firm works remotely. You will not be the one person on a different clock in an office that forgot you exist.



The role

We have more good clients than we have people to serve them, so we are hiring one person to run our whole client accounting department: the team, the standards, the final review and the numbers. There is no partner to wait on. When you see a better way to run it, you have the authority to change it. We are rebuilding the department around automation, and you d
 what gets automated and write the procedure the team follows once it works.



What you will own

• The team: workloads, deadlines, coaching, hiring and performance for every accountant, in-house and outsourced

• Final technical review of every close and financial statement before it reaches a client

• One written method for every recurring task, plus a quality control program with monthly sample checks and an error log

• Hours against benchmark and realization for every client, reported to leadership on one page each month

• Onboarding each new client to a first clean close, and the client call when something goes wrong

• The automation rebuild, starting with bank reconciliation matching, and a second-in-command who can run the department without you



Requirements

We judge what you have done, not how long you did it. You must be able to show us:

• A team of accountants you ran for clients, and what changed because you ran it: closes that came in on time and errors that went down

• Your record as the final reviewer on other accountants' work: closes and financial statements for multi-entity groups

• A bank reconciliation you did yourself in the last twelve months

• A procedure you wrote that a team actually follows

• An outsourced or remote team you held to a standard, with numbers to prove it

• English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements, or a mistake in them, to a US business owner on a live call



Nice to have

• Franchise accounting, including 13-period calendars

• Thomson Reuters Accounting CS

• Accounting work you automated, and the hours it saved

You do not need a degree, a licence, a particular title or a set number of years.



Pay and perks

• $6,000 to $7,000 USD a month, paid in US dollars wherever you live

• Annual bonus tied to your team's performance.

• Work from anywhere. Fully remote, in any country.

• Run your own day outside the core hours.

• A short line to the top. Your proposals go to the Senior Director, Operations and the owner, and you get an answer.

• Your own bench. You choose and develop the person who will be your number two.

• Paid time off. Two weeks to start, plus all US holidays and the public holidays where you live.



Your first year

• First 30 days: You learn every client and meet every accountant. You start on the bank reconciliations for our largest client group.

• By day 90: The buck stops with you on every client close and you run the weekly workload review. Your review standard and onboarding checklists are in use. Your first monthly report is sent.

• By month 6: Every recurring task has one written method. Monthly quality checks are running. Our outsourced partner is held to the hours and quality we agreed, with data.

• By month 12: You own the department. At least one automated workflow is live under your procedures. Someone on your team can run the department for two weeks while you are away.



How we hire

We do not screen on job titles or count your years. We ask what you did, with numbers, and who can confirm it.

1. Application. About 35 minutes. Three short accounting tests and questions about your results. No cover letter.

2. Work test one. A month-end close review, a bank reconciliation and a written procedure, built from the work you would own here. About 2.5 hours.

3. Work test two. Your first weeks in the seat, in one data pack. About 2.5 hours.

4. Interview with the owner. We contact your references after the interview, not before.



Every application gets a reply. You will never wait weeks in silence wondering whether anyone read your work.



How to apply

Apply here: 
. There is one seat.

title: Lead Customer Service Representative (CSR) – Pest Control Operations
description:
# Lead Customer Service Representative (CSR) – Pest Control Operations



**Company:** Protek Pest and Lawn  

**Location:** Florida  

**Position:** Full-Time  

**Department:** Operations / Customer Service



## About Protek Pest and Lawn



Protek Pest and Lawn is a growing pest control and lawn care company committed to delivering exceptional customer service, efficient operations, and consistent results.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive **Lead Customer Service Representative** to help oversee our day-to-day pest control operations.



This is not your typical customer service position. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, understands the importance of accountability, and can help ensure our operations run efficiently.



## Position Overview



The Lead CSR will be responsible for overseeing the administrative and customer service side of our pest control operations, with a heavy emphasis on **FieldRoutes management, reporting, audits, scheduling efficiency, and operational accountability**.



This individual will help ensure that nothing falls through the cracks, from customer billing and technician performance to route optimization, service completion, and customer retention.



The ideal candidate doesn't just identify problems — they investigate them, find solutions, and follow through to ensure they're resolved.



## Key Responsibilities



### FieldRoutes Management & Reporting

- Serve as the primary administrative expert for FieldRoutes, our pest control management software.

- Generate, review, and analyze daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.

- Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and identify areas requiring improvement.

- Maintain accurate customer accounts, service schedules, billing information, and technician assignments.

- Identify discrepancies in FieldRoutes data and correct errors.

- Build and maintain standardized reporting and auditing procedures.

- Provide management with clear summaries of operational performance and outstanding issues.



### Operational Audits & Quality Control

- Conduct regular audits of customer accounts to ensure billing, pricing, and service frequencies are accurate.

- Identify missed, incomplete, or overdue services and coordinate resolutions.

- Audit technician routes for completed services, missing documentation, and discrepancies.

- Review service notes, callbacks, re-services, and customer complaints to identify trends.

- Monitor canceled accounts, past-due balances, and accounts at risk of cancellation.

- Verify that customer credits, discounts, and account adjustments are properly documented and authorized.

- Ensure operational processes and company policies are consistently followed.



### Scheduling & Route Efficiency

- Oversee scheduling accuracy and ensure customers are serviced according to their agreements.

- Monitor technician routes for efficiency, workload distribution, and scheduling conflicts.

- Identify route gaps, excessive drive time, and underutilized technician capacity.

- Coordinate with service managers and technicians to resolve scheduling issues.

- Help maximize technician productivity while maintaining service quality.



### Customer Service Leadership

- Provide guidance, training, and accountability for other customer service representatives.

- Ensure customer inquiries, complaints, and service requests are handled promptly and professionally.

- Monitor call handling, customer follow-ups, and outstanding customer service tasks.

- Establish and maintain consistent customer service procedures.

- Assist with escalated customer concerns and retention efforts.

- Ensure CSRs properly document customer interactions and follow established workflows.



### Billing, Accounts Receivable & Retention

- Audit recurring billing and identify failed payments or billing discrepancies.

- Monitor outstanding balances and coordinate collection follow-ups.

- Ensure new customers are properly entered into FieldRoutes with correct pricing, billing schedules, and service plans.

- Track cancellations and identify common reasons customers leave.

- Monitor customer retention and help implement processes to reduce preventable cancellations.

- Ensure service agreements and account information are accurate and complete.



### Process Improvement & Accountability

- Identify inefficiencies in current operational processes and recommend improvements.

- Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and audit systems.

- Track unresolved operational issues and ensure timely follow-through.

- Work closely with management to improve efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

- Help implement systems that allow the company to scale without sacrificing service quality.



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this position will be measured by the ability to maintain accurate records, identify operational issues, and drive measurable improvements.



Key metrics include:



- **Service Completion Rate:** Percentage of scheduled services completed on time.

- **Re-Service Rate:** Frequency of customer callbacks and repeat treatments.

- **Customer Retention:** Cancellation rates and preventable customer losses.

- **Billing Accuracy:** Reduction in billing errors and missed charges.

- **Accounts Receivable:** Past-due balances and failed-payment resolution.

- **Route Efficiency:** Technician productivity, route utilization, and scheduling accuracy.

- **Audit Completion:** Timely completion of required daily, weekly, and monthly audits.

- **Issue Resolution:** Speed and consistency in resolving identified problems.

- **Customer Service Performance:** Response times, follow-up completion, and customer satisfaction.



## Qualifications



**Required:**

- Experience in customer service, office management, or business operations.

- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

- Ability to analyze reports, identify discrepancies, and solve problems independently.

- Proficiency with spreadsheets, reporting tools, and business management software.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on tasks.

- Comfortable holding others accountable and communicating with management.



**Strongly Preferred:**

- Previous experience using **FieldRoutes** or similar pest control management software.

- Experience in the pest control, lawn care, HVAC, plumbing, or home services industry.

- Experience supervising or training customer service representatives.

- Familiarity with recurring billing, route scheduling, customer retention, and operational reporting.

- Experience developing SOPs, audit procedures, or performance dashboards.



## Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



- **Takes ownership:** Doesn't wait to be told what needs fixing.

- **Loves organization:** Enjoys creating systems, checklists, and processes.

- **Pays attention to details:** Notices mistakes and inconsistencies others might overlook.

- **Thinks analytically:** Can turn reports and data into actionable improvements.

- **Follows through:** Doesn't consider a problem resolved until it's actually fixed.

- **Holds high standards:** Is comfortable enforcing procedures and expectations.

- **Wants to grow:** Is excited to take on additional responsibility as the company expands.



## Why Join Protek?



- Opportunity to play an important leadership role in a growing company.

- Work directly with management to improve operations and build scalable systems.

- Meaningful responsibility and the ability to influence company performance.

- Opportunity for career advancement as the company expands.

- A team that values integrity, accountability, reliability, and doing things the right way.



## How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief explanation of your experience with FieldRoutes, operational reporting, customer service management, or process improvement.



**Bonus:** Tell us about a time you identified an operational problem, developed a solution, and helped improve a company's performance.

We need realistic beta testers to use the app naturally, capture high-quality screenshots of key features, and provide honest, constructive feedback.

1 Scan once or twice a week, 30-60 minute testing sessions a couple times a week or so (depends on changes made to app, that need testing)

High-quality screenshots (at least 8–12 staged compositions) showing real use of the core features.

Before vs After slider (with comparison photos) Ranking on how hard, easy features were to find and understand, 

AI Face Blur in action

Body Censor / Privacy protection for progress photos

Morph / Transformation timeline animation

Future Me visualization (current vs predicted physique)

Secure / Locked private gallery

Progress Tracking Dashboard (weight, measurements, timeline)

Daily Check-in / Logging screen



You may also include additional screenshots of other flows you discover.

Test Morph / Transformation feature.

Test AI Censoring (body privacy) and Face Blur – demonstrate privacy features

Test Future Me prediction.

Test Progress Tracking (logging weight, measurements, photos).

Test Private & Secure Storage (PIN/password setup and locked gallery).

Explore the full app and note anything that feels motivating, confusing, premium, or clunky.

title: Senior AI Systems Engineer — Autonomous Agents, Computer Control & Software Integration
description:
Senior AI Systems Engineer — Autonomous Agents, Computer Control & Software Integration



About the role



We are seeking an experienced AI engineer to build an autonomous AI system that learns how our business operates, makes decisions and carries out work independently, with artificial general intelligence (AGI) as the project’s goal.



You will integrate multiple AI providers, reusable libraries, SDKs, APIs and business applications, and build the custom orchestration layer that coordinates them. These components must share relevant context and task progress, select appropriate tools and complete workflows as one system.



Direct computer control is essential. The system must read the screen, control the mouse and keyboard, operate applications, browse websites, complete forms, upload documents, manage files and execute authorised commands.



Autonomy and continuous learning



The system must start work automatically from incoming
s, deadlines and business events. It must identify what is needed, plan actions, execute tasks, verify results and manage follow-ups without continuous human prompting.



It must capture every action and outcome, retain relevant experience, and use successes, mistakes and human corrections to make tested improvements in its knowledge, decisions and behaviour.



It must operate within agreed authority, recognise exceptions and request human input when required. Voice and chat will support instructions, conversations and updates.



Integration and orchestration



The engineer must combine established AI capabilities and custom software into one coordinated platform, integrating multiple providers’ models, computer-use tools, browser automation and tool-calling capabilities through supported APIs and SDKs.



The architecture must connect with
, calendars, document storage, databases and other business applications, while allowing models, tools and services to be added or replaced.



Candidates must identify the exact models, versions and integrations they propose and demonstrate their suitability.



Example workflow



An incoming broker
 triggers the system to check relevant records, identify and gather missing information, prepare supporting documents, complete any required website actions or uploads, send an authorised reply, update the case and track the next action.



What needs to be built



- Autonomous task planning, decision-making and execution.

- Direct computer control and browser automation.

- Business memory covering records, policies, documents and previous decisions.

- Integration of multiple AI providers, software platforms and business applications.

- A custom orchestration layer coordinating tasks and shared context.

- Automatic triggers, background processing, scheduling and follow-ups.

-
 handling, broker correspondence and attachment processing.

- Internet research, form completion and document uploads.

- Document generation, information extraction and record updates.

- Task tracking, outcome verification and prevention of duplicate actions.

- A feedback and evaluation process for tested improvements.

- Voice and chat interfaces.

- Permissions, secure credential handling, approval controls and activity records.

- Reliable hosting, monitoring, backups and failure recovery.



Your responsibilities



Own technical design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing maintenance.



Assess existing components before developing custom software. Measure task completion, accuracy, reliability and operating costs, and use those results to guide improvements.



Maintain source code, documentation and infrastructure access in company-controlled accounts. Document third-party dependencies, licensing requirements and ownership arrangements.



Required experience



Candidates must provide live, working examples of systems they have developed, demonstrating integration across multiple AI providers, software platforms and business applications.



Experience must include building custom autonomous agents that plan, execute and verify tasks across connected systems, including direct computer control, with minimal human intervention.



Candidates must also demonstrate:



- Strong software engineering skills in Python or TypeScript.

- API integration, authentication, databases and deployment.

- Persistent business memory and task state.

- Background workflows, retries and recovery from interrupted tasks.

- Evaluation and monitoring of AI performance.

- Secure access controls and protection of confidential information.

- Clear communication about technical choices, limitations and delivery dependencies.



How to apply



Please provide:



- Live demonstrations or accessible examples of relevant work. Confidential projects may be presented through an anonymised walkthrough.

- Your responsibilities and technical contribution to each example.

- The platforms integrated and workflows completed.

- Evidence of results, including what worked, what failed and improvements made.

- Your proposed approach to autonomous operation, computer control and continuous learning.

- Availability and expected salary or contract rate.



Shortlisted candidates will discuss their previous systems and complete a scoped technical assessment using sample data in a test environment. The assessment will cover a complete business workflow, including missing information, a failed or interrupted action, outcome verification and a decision requiring approval.

title: MCA Sales Rep: Warm Leads Supplied Daily, Commission Only ($400+ Per Funded Deal)
description:
Type of Work: Full Time

Wage / Salary: Commission only: 2% of funded amount (about $400 on an average $20K deal)

Hours per Week: 40+ (US business hours)



Job Overview



We’re a Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) brokerage looking for experienced reps who know the business funding world and can work the phones.



You don’t cold call. Every day we hand you thousands of warm merchant leads: business owners who have already shown interest in funding. Your job is simple: get them on the phone and move them toward submission.



What You’ll Do



Reach out to warm merchant leads by text and phone. That means texting your list 3–4 times a day and calling back to back.

Get merchants on the phone and confirm they’re still looking for funding

Collect what’s missing from the file:

Updated bank statements (last 3 months), or

Month-to-date (MTD) statements

If we already have their bank statements, just find out how much funding they’re looking for and line them up for submission

Prepare the file and hand it to underwriting

Follow up until every deal is funded or closed out

The goal is simple: get as many submissions in as possible. More submissions means more fundings, and more fundings means more money for you.



How You Get Paid



2% of the funded amount on every deal you bring in (that’s 20% of our commission)

Our average deal is $20,000, so you earn about $400 per funded deal

Bigger deals pay more. A $50,000 funding pays you $1,000.

No cap on earnings:

5 funded deals a month = $2,000

10 funded deals a month = $4,000

20 funded deals a month = $8,000

What We’re Looking For



MCA, business funding, or ISO experience required. You should already know bank statements, MTD, positions, and the underwriting process.

Clear, confident, fluent English on the phone

Comfortable texting and calling hundreds of merchants a day

Self-motivated and consistent. You show up and dial without being told.

Hungry to earn. This role rewards effort directly.

Reliable internet, a headset, and a quiet work area

Who Should NOT Apply



People looking for a guaranteed base salary

Anyone uncomfortable on the phone

People with no sales or MCA background

How to Apply



Start your application with the word “FUNDED” so we know you read this post. Then include:



Your MCA / business funding experience: which companies, how long, and your monthly submission or funding numbers

A short voice recording (1–2 minutes) of you calling a merchant who requested funding and asking for their bank statements

Your availability during US business hours

description:
Stable, recurring part-time video editing work for an art YouTube channel + social media. We make multicam painting process tutorials: satisfying, color-rich, music-synced. Hiring one editor, long-term.

Scope of work

Work is paid per project. One project is the full set of deliverables cut from a single filmed painting tutorial:

• 1 long-form YouTube edit ~10–15 min, from pre-synced multicam footage

• 2
 
 — 3–5 min, reframed to square

• 4 vertical Shorts/Reels

Rate is agreed per project and discussed with shortlisted applicants. Volume is currently around two projects a month, with room to grow.

Turnaround: long-form first cut within 5 business days; Shorts and cutdowns within 3 days.

Revisions: 3 consolidated rounds per deliverable included.

Required

• 3+ years editing professionally

• Expert-level Premiere Pro (not Final Cut, not DaVinci, not CapCut)

• Strong color grading

• Strong spoken and written English — we use
 for day-to-day messaging and have live calls when needed

• Google Drive

The style

Process videos (painting tutorial), no talking head. The artist is the subject, and the painting process is the focus.

• Satisfying and dynamic — the painting has rhythm. Pacing that breathes: fast when the pour demands it, slow when the detail does.

• Color-led — consistent grading across 3–4 camera angles.

• Music-synced — reveals and cuts land on the beat.

• Short-form with the same feel — satisfying and dynamic, focused on the art process, the beautiful details and reveal.

This is a specialist style. If your experience is mostly talking-head, gaming, or corporate video, this role likely isn’t the right fit. Reference videos — both long-form and short-form — will be shared with shortlisted applicants.

Portfolio required — applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed

Process

Submit your application ? complete paid edit test with real footage ? begin a trial period if selected. We’re hiring one editor for the long term, not a one-off project.

1. Your portfolio — 2–4 full long-form edits that best match the work described above, plus up to 5 short-form edits (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or similar). Send published links we can watch in a browser, not files to download. If you were not the only editor working on a project, specify exactly which parts of the video were completed by you.

2. In 2–3 sentences: what makes a video tutorial satisfying to watch?

3. Availability: your time zone, the hours per week you can commit, and whether the turnaround above is realistic for you.

Begin your reply with the word PHTHALO so we know you read this in full.

title: Offshore Corporate In House Attorney
description:
OCD Anxiety Centers



The Company You Will Join

OCD Anxiety Centers is passionate about bringing help and hope to individuals and families affected by 

anxiety and related disorders. We are an evidence-based behavioral health organization committed to 

using effective, research-supported treatments and staying current with the latest developments in 

clinical care.



We believe in doing meaningful work, supporting our clients, and maintaining high standards of 

integrity, accountability, teamwork, and excellence.



The Team You Will Work With

Our success depends on the trust and confidence we build with our employees, clients, and 

community. 



We value:

• Integrity and honest, open communication

• Accountability for our actions and responsibilities

• Teamwork and collaboration

• Excellence and continuous improvement

• Respect for others and diversity

• Passion for serving our clients and supporting company goals



Position Purpose

The Offshore Corporate In-House Attorney provides practical legal guidance and support to a fastgrowing behavioral health organization. This role helps the company manage contracts, regulatory and compliance matters, employment issues, risk, disputes, policies, and other legal needs. You will work with company leaders and assigned departments to deliver clear recommendations, maintain organized legal processes, and coordinate specialized matters with outside counsel.



Key Performance Indicators



Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

• Draft, review, negotiate, and coordinate contracts within agreed timelines and the assigned scope of 

work.

• Keep legal matter trackers, contract files, templates, and legal records organized and up to date.

• Provide timely, practical legal guidance and research to company leaders and departments.

• Help reduce unnecessary outside legal expenses by handling appropriate matters internally.

• Coordinate effectively with outside counsel when specialized or jurisdiction-specific support is 

needed.

• Support compliance, policy development, training, and audit readiness.

• Identify and promptly escalate high-risk or time-sensitive legal matters under the agreed escalation 

process.

• Provide clear recommendations, options, and next steps when legal risks arise.

• Maintain accurate documentation, written status updates, and timely handoffs during agreed working 

hours.





Your First 30 60 and 90 Days

Your first 90 days will focus on understanding the company's legal needs, establishing reliable processes, and delivering practical legal support. Your supervisor will confirm assigned priorities, communication expectations, working hours, turnaround standards, and escalation procedures during onboarding.



By Day 30

Understand the business and establish priorities

• Complete assigned onboarding and privacy and security training, meet with designated stakeholders, 

and document legal priorities, the assigned scope of work, decision makers, and escalation contacts.

• Establish or update a central tracker covering 100% of assigned active matters and agreed 

priority contracts made available, with an owner, risk level, next action, and known deadline for 

each. Identify and request missing information.

• Review available contract templates, legal files, policies, and outside counsel records; summarize 

immediate risks, approaching deadlines, and documentation gaps, and record available workload, 

turnaround, and spending baselines.

• Submit proposed standards for routine contract drafts and reviews, research requests, urgent 

matters, status updates, and handoffs during agreed working hours.

• Submit a prioritized action plan for the next 60 days, identifying proposed deliverables, target dates, 

dependencies, and recommended legal process improvements.



By Day 60

Deliver assigned work and strengthen legal processes

• Complete at least 90% of routine contract drafts, initial reviews, and legal research deliverables due during days 31 through 60 within agreed timelines. Document findings, open questions, and recommended next steps as appropriate.

• Record 100% of newly assigned legal matters in the central tracker and provide weekly updates on deadlines, progress, information needed, and decisions requiring leadership input.

• Draft or update at least three priority legal resources, such as contract templates, clause guides, contract playbooks, or legal intake procedures, and submit them for any required review.

• Use the approved intake, review, documentation, and handoff process for assigned work; identify 

incomplete requests and escalate time-sensitive issues under the agreed protocol.

• Organize assigned outside counsel matters with available scope, status, deadlines, and budget 

information. Identify missing information and opportunities for more efficient coordination or appropriate internal handling.





By Day 90

Demonstrate consistent delivery and continuous improvement

• Complete at least 95% of routine contract drafts, initial reviews, and legal research 

deliverables due during days 61 through 90 within agreed timelines, documenting reasons and 

next steps for exceptions.

• Keep 100% of assigned active matters current through at least weekly updates and deliver a 

monthly leadership report covering workload, turnaround, significant risks, approaching deadlines, 

and available outside counsel spending information.

• Complete 100% of attorney-owned process improvement deliverables due under the approved 

90-day plan, with dependencies and supervisor-approved changes to scope or deadlines 

documented before the affected due date.

• Complete at least two priority policy or legal process reviews and deliver one targeted legal 

briefing or training session addressing an identified business or operational risk.

• Present a next-quarter improvement plan with at least two specific opportunities to improve 

contract efficiency, strengthen documentation, reduce recurring legal risk, or manage outside counsel 

costs, with proposed measures, owners, and milestones.



Turnaround measures apply to the attorney's assigned draft, initial substantive review, or completed 

research deliverable. Report timeliness by work type. Routine work categories, required inputs, timing 

rules, and documented pauses will be defined during onboarding; urgent and complex matters will have 

separately agreed deadlines. Track final contract execution, counterparty responses, and decisions 

assigned to others separately.



Core Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

• Strong knowledge of corporate and business law.

• Sound legal judgment and problem-solving skills.

• Strong organization and attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Professional handling of confidential and sensitive information.

• Ability to work independently in a fast-moving organization.

• Strong follow-through and accountability.

• Ability to manage multiple legal matters and competing priorities.

• Ability to identify risks and communicate them clearly.

• A professional, collaborative approach when working with leadership and other departments.



Core Responsibilities

Contract and Legal Support

• Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, leases, vendor agreements, payer agreements, and 

employment-related documents within the assigned scope.

• Review contract terms and identify potential legal and business risks.

• Advise leaders on contract obligations, deadlines, confidentiality, termination rights, and risk 

allocation.

• Maintain legal templates, approved contract language, and contract playbooks.

• Help establish and maintain consistent legal review and approval processes.



Legal Compliance and Risk Management

• Provide legal guidance on corporate, employment, healthcare, regulatory, privacy, and operational 

matters within the assigned scope.

• Support compliance initiatives, internal policies, training, and legal readiness.

• Assist with dispute resolution and responses to legal concerns.

• Identify potential legal and compliance risks and recommend appropriate actions.

• Support audits, due diligence, and other legal or regulatory reviews.



Outside Counsel and Legal Matters

• Coordinate with outside counsel on litigation, state-specific legal matters, specialized advice, and 

major transactions.

• Track outside counsel matters, budgets, and legal expenses.

• Maintain organized legal matter logs and records.

• Provide leadership with clear updates on important legal matters and risks.



Systems Documentation and Reporting

• Maintain organized legal files, trackers, contracts, standard operating procedures, and reports.

• Keep documentation accurate, current, and easy to review.

• Maintain clear records of legal decisions, communications, and follow-up actions.

• Provide regular status updates to leadership according to agreed reporting expectations.



Cross Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with leadership and other departments to understand business needs and provide 

practical legal solutions.

• Clearly document legal handoffs and responsibilities, including outstanding questions, deadlines, and 

next steps.

• Communicate clearly with internal teams, outside counsel, and other stakeholders, with timely written 

updates during agreed working hours.

• Escalate unclear ownership, missing information, compliance concerns, or significant risks promptly.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience

• Five or more years of legal experience.

• Experience in one or more of the following areas: corporate law, healthcare law, employment law, 

contract law, regulatory or compliance matters, or business operations.



Skills and Expertise

Contract drafting and negotiation; legal research and analysis; risk assessment and management; 

corporate and employment law; healthcare compliance and regulatory matters; policy and procedure 

development; dispute resolution and legal support; outside counsel coordination; executive-level 

communication and judgment; strong written and verbal communication; and excellent organization and 

attention to detail.



Performance Growth

Your supervisor will review progress with you at 30, 60, and 90 days, including completed deliverables, 

turnaround performance, work quality, and any documented dependencies. Once the key performance 

indicators are consistently achieved, you and your supervisor will establish new performance goals that 

support continued growth, development, and excellence.

title: Account Executive - U.S. B2B IT Services
description:
Account Executive – U.S. B2B IT Services



ABOUT ALL I.T.

All I.T. provides nationwide onsite IT field services for multi-location companies and managed service providers across the United States and Canada. Our services include onsite IT support, smart hands, scheduled visits, technology rollouts, network installations, structured cabling, wireless projects, and white-label field support.



THE ROLE

We are hiring an experienced, full-cycle Account Executive with direct experience selling IT services or closely related enterprise IT solutions. You will generate outbound opportunities, qualify inbound leads, and manage prospects through discovery, proposal, follow-up, and signed agreement.



You will sell directly to U.S.-based CIOs, IT Directors, IT Managers, Infrastructure and Network leaders, and MSP owners and executives. You will also help revive dormant customer relationships and move existing opportunities forward, working with the CEO and Operations team.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, 40 working hours per week. Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Central Time, including a one-hour meal break. You must be able to work this schedule consistently. Central Time follows U.S. daylight saving time: 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time during CDT and 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM during CST.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research qualified MSPs, multi-location businesses and IT decision-makers, then build and work a targeted prospect list.

- Prospect through phone,
 and LinkedIn, using relevant, personalized outreach and consistent follow-through.

- Respond promptly to inbound leads, establish their actual service need, distinguish potential customers from technician/vendor sign-ups, and route them appropriately.

- Book, confirm and conduct qualified discovery meetings with decision-makers or stakeholders involved in vendor selection.

- Explain our onsite IT services in business terms, prepare accurate proposals, handle objections, and advance opportunities to signed agreements using approved pricing and terms.

- Follow through on procurement, vendor onboarding, billing details and agreement steps, escalating technical or contractual questions to the right person.

- Re-engage assigned dormant customers and stalled prospects with an account-specific approach informed by their history, timing and current needs.

- Keep HubSpot contacts, companies, deals, activities, meeting outcomes, pipeline stages and next steps accurate and current. Give clear pipeline and end-of-day updates.

- Coordinate a complete handoff to Operations and the account owner so that agreed work can move forward smoothly.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- At least 3 years of B2B sales experience, including direct selling to U.S. business customers.

- Proven, hands-on experience selling IT services, managed services/MSP offerings, outsourced IT support, IT field services, networking, structured cabling, infrastructure, or closely related enterprise IT solutions. General outbound sales experience alone does not meet this requirement.

- Direct experience selling to CIOs, IT Directors, IT Managers, Infrastructure or Network leaders, or MSP owners and executives. Be ready to explain the service sold, the buyer's need, and your own role in advancing and closing the opportunity.

- Full-cycle sales ownership: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposals, objection handling, follow-up and closing. Experience handling both outbound opportunities and inbound leads.

- Advanced, practical HubSpot experience, including pipeline management, tasks, sequences, templates, meetings and accurate CRM records.

- Strong spoken and written English for clear, professional conversations with U.S. IT leaders. You can explain technical services accurately and know when to bring in technical support.

- Effective phone,
 and LinkedIn prospecting, plus an established professional LinkedIn presence and network relevant to U.S. B2B sales.

- Reliable availability during the stated U.S. Central Time schedule and a professional remote-work setup with a suitable computer, headset, reliable internet and a backup arrangement.

- Willingness to keep your professional LinkedIn profile accurate, identify All I.T. as your employer during employment, and share approved company content.



HELPFUL ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE

- Selling white-label field support to MSPs or supporting multi-location IT rollouts.

- Reviving dormant customer accounts or moving stalled technical-service opportunities forward.

- Coordinating procurement, vendor onboarding and handoffs between sales and service delivery.

- Using Microsoft 365/Teams, RingCentral, Google Drive and approved AI-assisted research or sales tools.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

Qualified attended appointments, well-qualified pipeline, timely follow-through, signed agreements on approved terms, successful customer reactivation, and accurate CRM records and Operations handoffs. You should be comfortable explaining the outcomes of your work, not just reporting outreach volume.



COMPENSATION

PHP 75,000 to 90,000 per month base salary depending on experience, plus uncapped commission on closed business.



HOW TO APPLY

Send the following:

1. Your resume and LinkedIn profile, plus a short, tailored explanation of your direct IT sales experience. Name the IT services or solutions you personally sold, the markets you served, the buyer roles you worked with, and your responsibilities.

2. One example of a U.S. IT-services or enterprise IT opportunity you personally helped close. Include the customer type or approximate size, the technical offering, the buyer's title, how the opportunity started, the stages you owned, and the result. Clearly distinguish your work from the team's work. You may anonymize customer names and commercial details.

3. A brief example of how you revived a dormant account or progressed a stalled opportunity, including your next steps and the result. If you have not done this before, say so and explain how you would approach it.

4. A 2–3 minute unscripted video introducing yourself and explaining one relevant IT sales example. Focus on your experience, sales approach and communication.

5. Confirmation that you can consistently work the stated U.S. Central Time schedule.



Please keep examples specific and truthful. Do not send confidential customer documents or information.

title: Senior Accountant / Controller (PTO, 13th Month, Bonuses)
description:
Most controller titles offered from the Philippines are a bookkeeping queue with a better name. This one is the real seat. You will be the financial authority for business groups with up to $30 million in revenue, and you will still do your own bank recs.



Who we are



We are a US accounting and tax firm. We have worked with business owners since 1991, and most of our accounting work is for multi-unit franchise groups: owners with ten, twenty or more stores, each in its own entity, closing on the franchise system's period calendar.



You would work directly with us. No agency in the middle, no account manager speaking for you, and nobody billing your hours to a client you are never allowed to talk to.



The seat



You are the controller for a group of our largest franchise clients. When an owner asks whether they can afford the next store, or what the bank will see in the covenant test, you are the person who knows. Not because you read a summary someone else prepared. Because you built the numbers.



What you own:



The close and the financial statements. Every period, on the franchise system's calendar, which for most of our clients means a 13-period year. Statements the owner can use, ready when promised.

Budgets and cash forecasts. You tell the owner what the next quarter looks like before it arrives.

Lender and covenant reporting. You run the covenant calculations and you know where each group stands against its loan terms before the bank does.

Internal controls. Over cash and payables, store by store. You find the gap before it becomes a loss.

Store purchases and sales. You read the closing documents, book the purchase price allocation, set up or retire the assets and intangibles, and produce the numbers a buyer or a lender will ask for.

The owner relationship. You are the owner's main financial contact. You explain the numbers on a call, plainly, and you send weekly reports to the clients who get them. Every week, without a reminder.



You still do the work



This is not an advisory role and it is not a management role. The person in this seat does bank reconciliations.

You reconcile the accounts yourself. Groups with dozens of bank accounts across dozens of entities. You find every difference and you prove it. You do not plug it, and you do not book a balancing entry to make it go away.

You book the hard entries yourself. Franchise fees and the intangibles they create, their amortization, and activity between related entities.

You review newer staff within 48 hours and send their work back with notes they can learn from.

You train. When a newer accountant asks how a client works, you show them that day.

You write it down. Every client you run has a current written procedure: how its bank feeds work and which entries are unusual to it.



If a controller title means you stopped touching reconciliations years ago, this is the wrong seat. We want someone who can explain a covenant test to an owner at ten in the morning and find a $312 difference in a bank rec at eleven.



The grunt work is going away. You help us retire it



We are rolling out AI tools over the coming months, and bank reconciliation matching is first on the list. The aim is to take the repetitive work off your desk so your hours go to the judgment calls.



You will help us test these tools on real clients. That means using them, telling us where they get things wrong, and checking every number they produce until we trust them. You do not need prior experience with AI. You need to want it, and you need to stay skeptical of it.



Hours



You work Philippine hours with a fixed overlap into the US Eastern morning, 7 to 11am Eastern. Owners call in that window and our team meets in it. We agree the rest of your day with you and then we keep to it.



Pay and Benefits



$4,500 USD per month

Plus 13th month pay. Uncommon in a contractor arrangement. We pay it anyway

Unlimited paid time off. The statutory floor in this country is five days a year. We do not count yours at all, and we expect you to spend it

Philippine daytime hours with one agreed US overlap window

Philippine public holidays observed. You work your country's calendar, not ours

Signing bonus to cover a second monitor, UPS, or generator

US CPA or EA sponsorship if you want it. We pay the fees and give you study time

That is the top of what this market pays a controller on US accounts, and we set it there on purpose. We want the best person available, and we do not want to lose them the moment somebody else makes an offer.



What you bring



At least eight years of accounting for US clients, with at least three of them owning the full close and financial reporting for a multi-entity group, as controller or in practice

Franchise or other multi-unit experience: many entities under one owner, with numbers that have to tie

Hands-on experience with store or business acquisitions and sales: closing documents, purchase price allocation, intangibles and amortization

Budgets, cash forecasts and loan covenant reporting you have built yourself

Bank reconciliations you have done yourself in the last twelve months

Experience reviewing other accountants' work and training newer staff

Thomson Reuters Accounting CS. If your command is in another professional package, say which and we will talk. QuickBooks Online and ShareFile are useful

A record of logging your time on every task, because some of our clients are billed on it

English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements to a US business owner on a live call

A stable home setup and the discipline to run your own day

A Philippine CPA or progress toward a US CPA is a plus. It is not required.



How we work



Read this part twice. We hire for it with the same weight as the technical skills above.

No task is beneath the seat. The controller does reconciliations. The title does not change that.

We change how we work, often. We are rebuilding the firm around automation, and processes that worked last year get replaced. When a new process arrives, you try it in good faith. If you think it is wrong, you say so in writing to the person who owns it, with your reasons, and then you follow the decision.

Your knowledge belongs on paper. Being the only person who knows how a client works is not job security here. It is a risk to the client, and we treat it as one.

Disagree with the work, never with the person. Problems go to the right person, privately, in a normal tone. We do not settle disagreements in the team chat.

You own your deadlines. If one is going to slip, you tell us before it slips, not after.

Verify, do not guess. A number you cannot support is not finished, however close the deadline is.



Your first 90 days



Days 1 to 30: You learn our systems and shadow the accountant who runs each client today through one full period close. By day 30 you have run one close yourself with review, bank recs included.

Days 31 to 60: You run your clients' closes and reconciliations yourself, weekly reports included. Every client you hold has a written procedure, written or updated by you. You have had a first financial review call with each owner.

Days 61 to 90: Each of your groups has a cash forecast and, where it has a loan, a covenant calculation you built. You are reviewing newer staff within 48 hours. You have tested our first AI reconciliation tool on at least one of your clients and told us what it gets wrong.



To apply



Apply through this form: monterrahalden.com/controller-application



It takes about 20 minutes, and your answers are the first thing we read.



Do not email or apply through OLJ
