title: Virtual CRM Manager
description:
I’m Alexa Samuels, a residential real estate agent in Toronto. My business is built on relationships, thoughtful advice and doing what you say you’ll do. I’m looking for someone who takes an interest in people and wants to become a trusted part of the business.



The role will start at approximately four hours each weekday. As you learn the business and your work helps uncover more opportunities, there may be scope for more hours and responsibility in marketing, content and broader business support. Growth will depend on business needs, your strengths and how well we work together. The aim is a lasting working relationship and your career growth.



You’re welcome to ask questions about the role. You won’t be expected to know every system or every contact on day one. We’ll establish the routine together, and you’ll learn the relationships and my voice over time.



Position overview



Your first priority will be helping me stay connected with clients, prospects and people across my wider network. You’ll review the CRM, LinkedIn,
 and Instagram, connect what you find with existing notes, and flag meaningful reasons to get in touch.



Your work will produce:



• A short daily briefing of worthwhile outreach opportunities.

• Accurate CRM records and clear follow-up reminders.

• A list of useful information gaps and suggestions for resolving them.

• Practical improvements to how the relationship routine works.



What the work involves



Daily relationship briefing. Look for birthdays, new jobs, family milestones, relevant posts and overdue follow-ups. For each recommendation, include whom to contact, why now, relevant history, the source and date, and a suggested next step. Draft a short message when useful. A few thoughtful recommendations are more helpful than a long list of routine updates.



CRM and follow-through. Keep contact details, relationship notes and reminders organised. Record completed interactions from my updates, flag possible duplicates, and track what still needs a decision or response. The CRM should make it easy to pick up a relationship where it left off.



Missing information. Notice what would help us follow up more thoughtfully. Explain what is missing and suggest how to obtain it, then agree on the approach with me. Keep confirmed facts separate from assumptions.



Content support as the role develops. Once the daily routine is working well, there may be opportunities to help format approved copy, create simple Canva graphics and prepare or schedule content. LinkedIn,
 and Instagram are the starting platforms; YouTube may come later.



Skills and working together



You should have practical experience with LinkedIn,
 and Instagram, and be comfortable maintaining a CRM or contact database. Strong written English, attention to detail and natural, personal communication matter. You’ll need to recognise when a public comment fits and when a private message, a question or no action would be more appropriate.



Experience supporting an entrepreneur or small service business is helpful, as are Canva and content scheduling skills. Real estate experience is welcome but not essential. You’ll need your own computer and reliable internet; the working schedule will be agreed together.



You’ll take ownership of the agreed routine and bring recommendations forward without waiting to be prompted. All outgoing messages, comments and posts will be reviewed by me before they are sent or published. That review adds personal context you may not yet have and helps you learn the people and my voice.



You should be comfortable using AI to organise information, explore ideas or improve drafts. You’re responsible for checking facts, understanding context and editing the result before submitting it. A new job is a reason to congratulate someone; it doesn’t tell you they need a new house. Your judgement matters. Personal or client information may only be used with expressly approved tools and settings.



Qualities needed to be successful



Skills can be developed over time. The qualities that matter most in this working relationship are integrity, curiosity and eagerness to learn, and a genuine desire to add value.



Integrity. Be honest about what you know, what you’ve done and where you need help. If you make a mistake or a deadline is slipping, say so early. You’ll be trusted with personal information and relationships that matter, so discretion and open communication are essential.



Curiosity and eagerness to learn. Take an interest in the people behind the records. Ask why, seek context and be open to feedback. You’re encouraged to suggest a better approach or question something that doesn’t make sense. As the role develops, be willing to learn new skills and take on work that suits your strengths.



A genuine desire to add value. Care about whether your work is useful. Notice what needs attention, follow through and look for ways to make the business work better. Strong support can create room for more conversations and opportunities, and potentially more responsibility for you. The aim is to become someone the business can count on.



If this sounds like you, please send a brief introduction and your résumé or a link to your profile. Make the subject line of your application “CRM Manager – [Your Name Here]” and start the first line of your application with “grey hippopotamus” so that I know you read the complete job description. Questions about the role are welcome.



Thank you for your time!



Warm regards,

Alexa

title: Inbound Sales Closer (Calls + Texts) – US Moving Company – 8AM–12PM EST, 7 Days
description:
We're a US moving company, and we're hiring sales closers to answer calls and texts from customers who already asked us for a moving quote, and book them on the call.



We're hiring for two shifts. THIS post is for the 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Eastern shift.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We want a closer, not an order-taker.

• You assume the sale. You don't ask "Would you like to book?" You ask "Do you want the morning or the afternoon?"

• You create real urgency and get the customer booked on the call, not "I'll call you back."

• You speak great English: clear, natural, and easy for American customers to understand.

• You're conversational. You build rapport, ask good questions, and keep the conversation going.

• You sound like a real person. If you sound robotic or like you're reading a script, customers hang up, so this job is not a fit.



SCHEDULE

• 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Eastern Time, 7 days a week (28 hours/week)

• Philippine time: 9:00 PM – 1:00 AM

• During US daylight saving time (March to November) it moves one hour earlier in PH time: 8:00 PM – 12:00 AM



PAY

• $5 USD per hour = $140 USD per week base (about $600 USD/month)

• PLUS $25 USD for every move you book, once the move is completed and paid. No cap.

• Example: book 5 moves in a week = an extra $125 that week

• Paid weekly via PayPal. Independent contractor.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Answer inbound calls and texts from people who requested a moving quote. These are warm leads, not cold calls.

• Learn about their move, give them their price, and book the move on the call

• Follow up with customers who haven't booked yet

• Log every conversation in GoHighLevel (our CRM) and stay in touch with the team on Slack

• Full training provided: our price sheet, a call guide (not a word-for-word script), and step-by-step guides



WHAT YOU NEED

• At least 1 year of phone sales where YOU closed the sale (not just customer service or transferring calls)

• Great spoken and written English

• A laptop or desktop computer and a headset with a microphone

• Fast, stable internet AND a backup internet and power source (for brownouts)

• A quiet place to work with no background noise

• Available every day for this shift, 7 days a week

• GoHighLevel or other CRM experience is a plus



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip a step will not be reviewed)

1. Start your message with "MOVER 8AM" so we know you read the whole post.

2. In 3–5 sentences, tell us about your sales experience. What did you sell, and how did you close?

3. Send a 2-minute voice recording (Vocaroo or Google Drive link). Do NOT read from a script. We want to hear how you really talk.

   Part 1: Introduce yourself (about 30 seconds).

   Part 2: You just gave a customer their moving quote. They say: "Okay, that sounds good. Let me talk to my wife and I'll call you back." Show us exactly what you would say next.

4. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net).

5. Confirm you can work 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Eastern, 7 days a week.

title: Amazon Book Sourcing Specialist – Suppliers & Profitable Deals
description:
Velnor Commerce is hiring a part-time Book Sourcing Specialist to find reliable U.S. suppliers and profitable book deals for Amazon resale.



We need someone who can find suppliers, contact them directly, obtain inventory lists and pricing, negotiate deals, and evaluate profitability—not simply send us a list of websites.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Source new and used books from wholesalers, distributors, bookstores, library sales, and liquidation suppliers.

• Contact suppliers for inventory lists, prices, minimum orders, condition details, invoices, and shipping quotes.

• Research individual ISBNs using Keepa and SellerAmp.

• Assess demand, price history, competition, and realistic sell-through.

• Calculate estimated net profit after purchase costs, Amazon fees, prep, and shipping.

• Check editions, condition requirements, and potential selling restrictions before recommending purchases.

• Submit a clear spreadsheet with supplier contacts, ISBNs, costs, estimated profit, and supporting research.

• Help prepare small test orders for our approval.



REQUIREMENTS:

• Previous experience sourcing books for Amazon USA.

• Strong Keepa skills and understanding of Amazon FBA costs.

• Good written English and confidence communicating with U.S. suppliers.

• Accurate research, clear reporting, and realistic profit estimates.



We prefer repeatable sourcing opportunities with healthy margins. Mixed bulk lots must have enough inventory information to assess their value and risk.



PAY & HOURS:

• $4–$6 per hour, depending on relevant experience.

• Start with a paid trial of 10 hours per week.

• Potential for additional hours and long-term work based on results.

• Performance bonuses may be agreed based on verified, realized net profit.



TO APPLY:

3. Share one previous book-sourcing example with purchase cost, selling price, fees, and net profit. Confidential supplier details may be redacted.

Start your application with “BOOK SOURCING.”



All purchases require our approval. We value profitable, well-supported opportunities over large lists of unverified leads.

:

Velnor Commerce

title: Director of Cold Calling & Outreach
description:
Position: Director of Cold Calling & Outreach

Department: Sales & Business Development

Type: Full-Time 

Employment Type: Independent Contractor

Monthly Compensation: $1,500 USD + 5% commission on eligible paid services

Experience Required: 3+ years in sales

Education: Bachelor’s degree in any field

English Proficiency: C2 (Native or Proficient)



Compensation & Commission Structure



This is an independent contractor position with a fixed monthly payment and performance-based commissions.

Your compensation will consist of the following:



• Fixed compensation: $1,500 USD to be paid every two weeks ($ 750 + $ 750).

• Commission: 5% of all paid services requested by clients you personally acquire through your sales and outreach activities. To be paid at the end of each month.

• Commission eligibility period: Commissions apply to ALL paid services requested by clients you acquire during the first six months following the initial acquisition of each client.



Commissions are calculated on services that have actually been paid for by the client. Unpaid invoices, outstanding balances, and services for which payment has not been received do not qualify for commission until payment is collected.





Commission Eligibility After Termination



Continued employment and eligibility for residual commissions are subject to the company's performance review process.



At the end of the initial 90-day evaluation period, your performance will be reviewed against the objectives, benchmarks, and responsibilities outlined in this job posting.



If you do not pass the performance review and your contract is terminated as a result, you will not be eligible to receive residual commissions after the termination of your contract.



If you successfully pass the performance review and continue working with the company, you will remain eligible for commissions in accordance with the terms outlined above and your contractor agreement.



All compensation and commission arrangements will be documented in the independent contractor agreement.





The Opportunity



We are looking for a highly driven, results-oriented Director of Cold Calling & Outreach to build, manage, and scale a high-performing outbound sales team.



This is not a position for someone who needs constant supervision, waits to be told what to do, or makes excuses when results fall short. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, solves problems independently, and understands that their value is ultimately measured by the results they produce.



You will be responsible for executing outreach campaigns, recruiting and training two cold callers, improving our sales systems, and building a repeatable process that consistently generates new clients.



You will have the autonomy to improve our approach, test new strategies, refine scripts, and develop the systems necessary to increase performance. In return, we expect discipline, accountability, initiative, and measurable results.



Your job is simple to understand, but not necessarily easy to execute: build a sales operation that pays for itself and creates long-term value for the company.





Your Primary Objective: Become Profitable Within 90 Days



Your primary objective is to generate enough new business within your first three months to cover the combined compensation and commissions of yourself and your two subordinate cold callers.



You will have 90 days to demonstrate that you and your team can generate enough revenue to justify the cost of the operation (at least $5,000 US dollars in new sales per month).



At the end of this period, your performance will be evaluated based on how close you came to the financial target and the quality of the sales operation you built.



• If you achieve the target: You and your team will have demonstrated the results required for long-term employment with the company, subject to the agreed employment terms and company policies.

• If you fall short of the target: Your direct supervisor will conduct a detailed performance review to determine whether your performance, productivity, closing rate, and improvements to the sales process justify continued employment.



Falling short of the revenue target does not automatically mean failure. However, you must demonstrate measurable effort, progress, accountability, and the ability to improve.



We will evaluate your performance using objective metrics, not excuses or subjective impressions.





Why We Believe This Goal Is Achievable



We currently work with a third-party company specializing in cold calling, cold
ing, and outbound outreach. They have established several teams for us, each consisting of three individuals.



Each team consistently generates an average of $3,000–$5,000 USD in new sales per month.



This existing operation provides us with a real-world benchmark for what a three-person team can achieve.



You will be expected to compete with that benchmark, learn from what is already working, and identify opportunities to improve upon it.



We are not asking you to build a sales operation without any reference point. We already have an established model against which your team's performance can be measured.





Key Responsibilities



1. Execute Cold Outreach Campaigns



• Conduct cold calls, send cold
s, and perform other relevant outbound outreach activities.

• Maintain consistent daily activity levels and ensure that outreach is organized, targeted, and properly documented.

• Follow up with prospects systematically to maximize conversion opportunities.

• Track outreach performance, identify bottlenecks, and adjust your approach based on results.

• Maintain accurate records of leads, conversations, follow-ups, and outcomes.



2. Recruit Two Cold Callers



You will be responsible for identifying and presenting 10 qualified candidates for cold caller positions. The company will select two candidates from the pool you provide.



Candidates must be professionally sourced. Friends and family members are not eligible.

You will be expected to:



• Identify suitable candidates with strong communication skills and the potential to perform in a sales environment.

• Screen candidates for English proficiency, discipline, reliability, and coachability.

• Evaluate their suitability for cold calling and outbound sales.

• Present 10 qualified candidates for the company's consideration.

• Assist with onboarding once the two candidates have been selected.



Your ability to identify talent is part of your responsibility as a leader. Recruiting the right people will directly affect your team's performance.



3. Train, Manage, and Supervise Your Team



Once the two cold callers have been selected, you will be responsible for getting them up to speed and ensuring they perform consistently.



Your responsibilities will include:



• Training new hires on our services, target audience, sales process, and outreach methods.

• Teaching effective cold calling, objection handling, follow-up, and conversion techniques.

• Monitoring daily activity and individual performance.

• Providing constructive feedback and identifying areas for improvement.

• Establishing clear expectations, performance standards, and accountability.

• Helping your team improve its closing rate and overall productivity.



You are responsible not only for your own performance, but also for developing the people under your supervision.



4. Re-engage Existing Clients and Acquire New Clients



You will occasionally be assigned specific former clients or prospective clients to contact directly.

This may involve:



• Reconnecting with previous clients.

• Following up with dormant leads and opportunities.

• Reaching out to selected new prospects.

• Supporting targeted business development initiatives.



These assignments may be sporadic, but they must be handled professionally, promptly, and with appropriate follow-through.



5. Maintain Consistent Communication



You will be expected to maintain a reliable communication and reporting schedule.



• Weekly supervisor meeting: Meet with your direct supervisor at least once per week to review performance, discuss challenges, report progress, and establish priorities.

• Weekly team meeting: Meet with your two subordinate cold callers at least once per week to review results, provide feedback, address obstacles, and improve execution.

• Ongoing reporting: Maintain clear records of your activities, team performance, and progress toward the 90-day objective.



You will have considerable independence in how you manage your work. However, independence does not mean operating without accountability.





6. Build and Improve the Sales System



We do not want someone who simply repeats the same process every day. We want someone who continuously looks for ways to make that process better.



You will be responsible for developing, documenting, and improving our sales infrastructure, including:



• Cold calling and cold
ing scripts.

• Objection-handling frameworks and follow-up sequences.

• Training materials for new hires.

• Standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• Internal manuals and reference documents.

• Quality-control processes and performance tracking.

• Onboarding materials and repeatable training systems.



You should regularly evaluate what is working, what is not, and what can be improved.



Your goal is to create a process that becomes more effective, predictable, and scalable over time, rather than relying entirely on individual talent or improvisation.



Performance Evaluation



Your performance will be evaluated against the financial target and the operational benchmarks established for this role.



If the 90-day revenue objective is not achieved, your supervisor will carefully assess the following metrics:



Performance metric What we will evaluate

Daily calls Number of calls completed per day

Daily
s Number of outbound
s sent per day

Closing rate Percentage of qualified opportunities converted into sales

Revenue generated New sales generated and progress toward the financial target

Process improvements Measurable improvements to scripts, training, outreach, and conversion

Team development Your ability to train, supervise, and improve the performance of two cold callers



Your team's performance will be compared directly with the results of our existing third-party outreach operation, including its established teams and their three-person structure.



The purpose of this comparison is to establish a practical benchmark and determine whether your team is operating at the level we know is possible.



We care about results, but we also care about the systems and behaviors that produce those results. Activity without improvement is insufficient, and improvement without consistent execution is equally insufficient.





Requirements



To be considered for this position, you must meet all of the following requirements:



• Bachelor's degree: A completed bachelor's degree is required. Your major is irrelevant.

• Sales experience: At least three years of professional sales experience.

• English proficiency: C2-level English proficiency is mandatory. This role requires excellent spoken and written English for cold calls,
s, client communication, and team training.

• Leadership ability: The ability to train, supervise, and hold other people accountable for their performance.

• Recruiting ability: The ability to source, screen, and present qualified candidates for the two cold caller positions.

• Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Organization: The ability to track activities, manage priorities, and maintain accurate records.

• Results orientation: A demonstrated ability to work toward measurable goals and take responsibility for outcomes.



Applicants who do not meet the mandatory requirements should not apply.





Skills & Traits We Value



We operate with a hands-off management philosophy. We do not want to spend our time micromanaging people or repeatedly reminding them to complete their responsibilities.



We want people who take ownership of their work, identify problems before they become serious, and actively look for ways to improve.



The ideal candidate demonstrates the following:



• Self-motivation and discipline: You can maintain a high level of performance without constant supervision.

• Attention to detail: You notice inconsistencies, maintain accurate records, and follow through on commitments.

• Fast learning: You absorb information quickly, adapt to new situations, and apply feedback effectively.

• Coachability: You accept constructive criticism without becoming defensive and use it to improve your performance.

• Time management: You prioritize high-value activities and use your time effectively.

• Problem-solving: You look for solutions rather than waiting for someone else to resolve every obstacle.

• Personal accountability: You take responsibility for your decisions, actions, and results.

• Clear communication: You communicate progress, problems, expectations, and ideas consistently.

• Obsession with growth: You actively seek opportunities to improve your skills, your team's performance, and the systems you manage.



We value people who want to get better every day and who understand that professional growth requires continuous learning, execution, and honest evaluation.





Management Philosophy



We believe talented people perform best when they have clear objectives, the resources to execute, and the freedom to take ownership.



You will be given a defined goal and the autonomy to determine how best to achieve it within company guidelines.

In exchange, we expect you to:



• Take initiative without waiting for instructions.

• Make decisions based on evidence and results.

• Communicate problems early and propose solutions.

• Hold yourself and your team accountable.

• Continuously improve the systems under your responsibility.

• Focus on productive activities that contribute to the company's growth.



You should be comfortable working independently, making decisions, receiving direct feedback, and being evaluated on measurable performance.



If you need constant supervision to stay productive, this position is probably not the right fit.



If you enjoy building systems, developing people, and being held accountable for meaningful results, you may be exactly who we are looking for.





Application Process



To apply, you must submit all four of the following:



1. Your English Proficiency Level



State your current English proficiency level using the CEFR scale (A1–C2).



C2-level English is mandatory. Applicants who do not meet this requirement should not apply. Applications that fail to meet this requirement will not proceed.



2. An Audio Recording Explaining Why You Are the Right Candidate



Submit an audio recording explaining why you believe you are the right person for this position.



Use the recording to demonstrate your spoken English, communication skills, confidence, and ability to explain your professional value clearly.



We recommend discussing your sales experience, leadership abilities, approach to building a team, and how you would approach the 90-day objective.



Applications without an audio recording will not be considered.



3. Your Resume



Submit an up-to-date resume detailing your education, professional experience, sales achievements, and any relevant leadership or management experience.



Where possible, include measurable results from your previous positions.



4. Professional References



Provide references from previous professional positions who can speak to your performance, reliability, work ethic, and professional conduct.



Please include the reference's name, professional relationship to you, and appropriate contact information.



References will be manually verified if we d
 to proceed with your application to the second interview. Please ensure that your references are aware they may be contacted.



Incomplete applications may be disqualified.





Interview Process



Our hiring process consists of two interviews.



First interview: We will evaluate your background, qualifications, sales experience, communication skills, and suitability for the role.



Second interview: Only candidates who demonstrate a strong fit during the first interview will advance. At this stage, we may examine your experience in greater depth, discuss your approach to the 90-day objective, and verify your professional references.



We will not advance every applicant to the second interview. We intend to be selective and focus our time on candidates who demonstrate the strongest potential to succeed.





Final Word



This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of a sales operation, build a team, develop repeatable systems, and contribute directly to the company's growth.



It also comes with clear expectations and measurable accountability.



We are looking for someone who understands that leadership is not simply about assigning tasks to other people. It is about creating the conditions, systems, and standards that allow a team to consistently produce results.



If you have the experience, discipline, communication skills, and drive to build a successful outbound sales operation, we encourage you to apply.



Build the system. Develop the team. Produce the results.



If that sounds like the kind of responsibility you want, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About ALL I.T.

We provide nationwide onsite IT field services across the United States, supporting MSPs and businesses with multiple locations. Our accounting connects customer invoices, service tickets and subcontractor costs.

We’re looking for a hands-on accountant to manage daily accounting, own month-end and quarter-end close, and catch up several years of missing entries while keeping current records accurate.

Schedule

8 a.m.–5 p.m. U.S. Central Time, following Chicago daylight saving time. Philippine hours are 9 p.m.–6 a.m. during CDT and 10 p.m.–7 a.m. during CST.

Responsibilities

- Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, billing follow-up and payment batches for approval.

- Reconcile subcontractor/vendor bills, payments and credits against service tickets, customer invoices and supporting records.

- Maintain QuickBooks Online and complete bank and credit-card reconciliations.

- Own month-end and quarter-end close, including reconciliations, adjusting entries, P&L, balance-sheet and AP/AR aging reports.

- Catch up several years of missing accounting entries, including historical AP and technician costs, without duplicating existing transactions.

- Maintain job-level cost and margin reporting.

- Validate spreadsheet data and bulk imports, reconcile totals and prevent duplicate entries or payments.

- Prepare payroll summaries and year-end/1099 supporting information for our tax professionals.

- Use approved AI-assisted tools to improve efficiency, verify their output against source records and protect confidential information.

- Document procedures, unresolved discrepancies and approval checkpoints.

Requirements

title: Real estate transaction coordinator needed
description:
Job Description



We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Real Estate Transaction Coordinator to join our growing team.



The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing real estate transactions from contract execution through closing, ensuring all documents, deadlines, communications, and compliance requirements are handled accurately and efficiently.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, manage multiple transactions simultaneously, and communicate professionally with agents, buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, and other parties involved in the transaction.



Key Responsibilities



Manage real estate transactions from under contract to successful closing.



Review purchase agreements, amendments, disclosures, and other transaction documents for completeness and accuracy.



Ensure all transaction files comply with Georgia Real Estate Commission (GREC) requirements and brokerage policies.



Monitor critical deadlines, including due diligence, earnest money, financing contingencies, appraisals, and closing dates.



Coordinate communication between agents, clients, lenders, closing attorneys, title companies, and other involved parties.

Follow up with all parties to ensure timely completion of outstanding requirements.



Assist with short sale transactions, lender documentation, foreclosure-related deadlines, and closing coordination when applicable.



Provide regular transaction status updates to the Broker and assigned agents.



Identify potential transaction issues early and promptly escalate them to the Broker.



Ensure all required documents are properly executed, submitted, and maintained in the brokerage's files.



Qualifications & Requirements



Previous experience as a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator, Real Estate Administrative Assistant, or similar position preferred.



Strong understanding of Georgia real estate contracts, transaction procedures, and compliance requirements.



Familiarity with FMLS, GAMLS, DocuSign, ShowingTime, and transaction management platforms is a plus.



Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.



Ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines simultaneously.



Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and document management systems.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Professional, dependable, resourceful, and highly responsive.



Experience handling short sales, distressed properties, or foreclosure-related transactions is a plus.



What We're Looking For



We need someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, stays ahead of deadlines, follows through on assignments, and ensures that no important detail is overlooked.



Accuracy, accountability, confidentiality, communication, and consistency are essential for this position.

title: Virtual Assistant: Find and Message U.S. TikTok/Instagram Creators ($5/hr, Long-Term)
description:
Get paid to scroll TikTok and Instagram and message U.S. creators.



Tomo is an AI startup in San Francisco. We work with social media creators (UGC), and we need reliable virtual assistants to find the right ones and reach out to them.



What you'll do

- Set up a fresh TikTok/Instagram account and train its feed to show the U.S. creators we want

- Find creators, send each one a short message from our script, and log each one in our form

- Look for smaller creators (under 50,000 followers) who fit our brand and are easy to work with and coach

- Follow up with creators who reply until they book a call with us

- We review your list with you, so you get better fast



Hours and pay

- $5/hour, long-term (about $390 a month)

- About 3 hours a day, 6 days a week, with a target of about 100 new creators messaged a day

- Fully remote



Setup (important: you need a U.S. feed)

TikTok shows you creators from the country your phone is in, so you'll need a U.S. feed:

- A phone with no SIM card and location services off

- A U.S. VPN turned on before TikTok is installed

- Create the account, then confirm your For You page shows U.S. creators on day one



What makes a great creator (they don't need all of these, just some)

- Based in the US

- Repeats a format and gets better at it over time

- Conventionally attractive

- Really good speaking voice: clear, standard American English

- Posts consistently

- Does not call themselves a "UGC creator"

- Seems "willing to work with us" - not TOO creative

- Bonus: already into self-improvement (self help, getting stronger, giving advice). We'll train you on which niches fit and what our product does

- The more undiscovered, the better: a big gap between how good they could be and how few people have found them



You're a fit if you

- Write clear, natural English

- Already spend time on TikTok/Instagram and know good content when you see it

- Pay attention to detail and can take feedback

- Can work reliably 6 days a week



To apply, send us

- 3 U.S. creators you think are a great fit, with a line on why

- Whether you can set up a U.S. VPN

- How many hours a week you can work

- Whether you can start right away



We'll start with a short paid trial and keep the people whose lists are strongest.

title: Sales Closer — Residential Cleaning (Remote, Full-Time, USD Pay)

Sales Closer — Residential Cleaning

 (Remote, Full-Time, USD Pay)



At 5 Star Home Cleaning, we believe great salespeople are great listeners first. We’re an established U.S. residential cleaning company operating in Arizona, Montana, and California, and we’re hiring one full-time Sales Closer.

Your job isn’t to sell people a cleaning they don’t need — it’s to help them get the one they do. Every lead you speak with has already requested a quote, so you’re working warm inbound only.

Connect — build genuine rapport and make the homeowner feel heard.

Recommend — match their needs to the right service. Never oversell.

Guide & close — explain the value, work through concerns, confidently ask for the business, collect payment, and get the cleaning scheduled.

Compensation

Bonus: Each recurring client you sign up is rewarded $10-$30 

Uncapped earning potential — the more business you close, the more you earn.



Growth path

Three tiers: Junior, Intermediate, Senior. Hit your cash-collected target five times to advance, increasing both your hourly pay and commission. Growth is based on results, not seniority or office politics.



You’ll thrive here if you:

Listen more than you talk, and make people feel genuinely heard

Have phone sales experience converting conversations into paying customers

Are confident asking for the business

Are coachable, organized, dependable, and take ownership of results

Prefer a fixed salary over performance-based pay

 100% warm inbound leads, uncapped commission, a clear path from Junior to Senior, weekly sales coaching from leaders who’ve scaled a multi-location company, and a proven process with scripts, training, and support.



Requirements

Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and availability during U.S. business hours (Mountain/Pacific time).

title: Asset & Lease Manager
description:
Asset & Lease Manager

Own the administration of a multi-site U.S. retail lease portfolio: abstract leases, track critical dates, verify every landlord charge before it is paid, and recover overbilled CAM and tax charges.



Work Setup

Full-time, Monday–Friday, night shift

Must have a computer with a webcam

Reliable high-speed internet



What You'll Do

Abstract every executed lease and amendment (rent, escalations, CAM/tax/insurance terms, options, notice windows, exclusives, co-tenancy) into the lease database.

Maintain the critical date calendar (options, renewals, termination rights, TI deadlines, insurance renewals, estoppels) and give advance notice.

Route and file leases, amendments, estoppels, SNDAs and consents, and keep an indexed digital lease file.

Set up rent records at commencement and keep escalations, amendments and abatements current.

Validate every monthly billing (base rent, CAM, tax, insurance, percentage rent) against the lease before payment, and prepare the payment file for Accounting.

Manage the outsourced CAM and tax audit, review findings against the lease, and track approved claims through to credit or refund.

Screen year-end reconciliations on receipt and correct errors right away.

Track real estate tax bills and assessments, verify pro-rata shares, and flag protest candidates.

Issue and maintain certificates of insurance for every location to each lease's requirements.

Monitor landlord obligations and put landlords on notice when they are unmet.

Maintain W-9s, landlord and property manager records, and payment instructions, with verified controls on any banking changes.

Support franchisor and lender consent, estoppel and reporting requests.

Act as the day-to-day contact for property managers on statements, reconciliations, certificates and documents.

Prepare and file TI allowance draw packages and track them through to receipt.

Support back-charge claims and portfolio events such as closures, relocations, assignments and subleases.

Keep the lease database accurate, and produce recurring reports (critical dates, rent roll, occupancy cost, audit savings, insurance compliance).

Write and maintain SOPs, and help define, train and supervise a future associate role.



What We're Looking For

4+ years in U.S. retail or commercial lease administration, lease accounting or property accounting, ideally with multi-site portfolios

Ability to read and accurately abstract U.S. shopping-center leases, including CAM, tax and insurance pass-throughs, caps, exclusions, options and notice requirements

Working knowledge of CAM and real estate tax reconciliations, with the ability to spot improper charges and hold a position with landlords or audit firms

Experience managing certificates of insurance against lease-specific requirements

Advanced Excel

Excellent written and spoken English for direct, professional correspondence with U.S. landlords and property managers

Exceptional accuracy and follow-through, and comfort owning a deadline calendar where a missed date has real financial consequences

Preferred: a degree in Accounting, Finance, Real Estate, Business or Law

Preferred: experience with a lease administration platform, e-signature tools and an ERP/AP system

Preferred: experience supporting a growing portfolio (new openings, TI collection) or working with a U.S.-based team from offshore

title: Appointment Setter for US E-commerce Brand Partner (Part Time, US Hours) (3+ Years Cold Calling Sales
description:
About Us

MontBlack Inc. is a US e-commerce company based in Fort Worth, Texas. We partner with established consumer brands, many of them family owned, and run their sales on Amazon, Walmart and TikTok Shop. We are a small, remote team and we reward people who produce.



The Role

You will call brand owners and decision makers at US consumer product companies and book discovery calls with our sales team. You are not selling a service or quoting a price. Your job is to reach the owner, start a short conversation about how their products are selling online, and get a 20 minute call on the calendar. We handle the call, the proposal and the close.



What You Will Do

Make 80+ dials per shift from a prepared lead list.

Get past gatekeepers and reach the owner, president or head of sales.

Ask our qualifying questions and book only brands that meet our criteria.

Book discovery calls on our calendar and confirm them the day before.

Log every call, outcome and follow up in our CRM the same day.

Follow our call script, and report the objections you hear so we can improve it.

Send a short daily report: dials, conversations with decision makers, calls booked.



Pay

$5.00 to $7.00/hour base, based on experience.

Commission on every brand that signs from an appointment you booked. No cap.



Exclusive Brand Partnerships, based on the brand’s monthly Amazon revenue:

$10,000 to $24,999: $150

$25,000 to $49,999: $375

$50,000 to $249,999: $750

$250,000 and up: 1% of the brand’s Amazon sales through MontBlack in its first full month of selling. Example: $300,000 in first month sales earns you $3,000.

All partnership commissions are paid after the brand’s first full month of selling on Amazon closes and sales are confirmed by MontBlack.



Brand Management clients: 12.5% of one month of the client’s fee, setup fees excluded. Half paid 48 hours after the client’s first payment clears, half when the third payment clears. Example: a client paying $4,000/month earns you $500.



Commission applies only to agreements signed and confirmed by MontBlack, and is paid while you are in good standing. Brand tier is set by MontBlack based on verified sales data.

Shift length and pay are reviewed at 30 and 60 days, based on qualified calls held.



Requirements

At least 2 years of US B2B cold calling or appointment setting experience. This is required. Any service business or industry counts. E-commerce, Amazon, CPG or wholesale experience is a strong plus.

Clear, neutral English. You must sound natural and confident with American business owners, many of them older.

Comfortable with rejection and with gatekeepers.

Quiet workspace, noise cancelling headset, stable internet (25+ Mbps) and a backup internet or power source.

Comfortable with CRM tools, Google Calendar and VoIP dialers.

Available for the full shift every weekday, on US Central time.



Training Provided

We train you on our offers, our script and how Amazon brand sales work before your first dial.



How to Apply

Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.



Use the subject line: “MontBlack Brand Setter”

Tell us in 3 to 5 sentences about your B2B appointment setting experience: how many years, who you called, how many dials per day, and how many appointments per week you booked.

Attach a 90 second voice recording (Vocaroo or Google Drive link) of the call below. Read the first part as written. When the owner pushes back the second time, answer in your own words. That part is what we listen for most.



Receptionist: “Good morning, Hartwell Products.”

You: “Hi, good morning. This is [your name] with MontBlack. I’m calling for the owner, is Tom in today?”

Receptionist: “What is this regarding?”

You: “It’s about how your products are selling on Amazon. I’ll only need a minute of his time.”

Owner: “This is Tom.”

You: “Hi Tom, this is [your name] with MontBlack. I’ll be quick. We work with family owned brands to grow their sales on Amazon, Walmart and TikTok Shop. Are you happy with how your products are selling on Amazon right now?”

Owner: “We’re fine. We already have people selling it for us. Not interested.”

You: “I understand, Tom. I’m looking at your listing on Amazon right now, and there are 18 different sellers on it. The photos and the description haven’t been updated, and nobody is optimizing it. When that many sellers are on one listing, they compete on price and nobody takes care of the brand. That’s exactly what we fix. I’d like to show you what we’re seeing in a 20 minute call. Would Thursday at 10 AM or Friday at 2 PM work better?”

Owner: “Look, just send me an
 and I’ll take a look.”

You: (Answer in your own words. Keep him on the phone and try to book the call.)



Shortlisted applicants will do a short live role play call with us.

title: Roofing Appointment Setter / Cold Caller — Full Time
description:
RoofReach LLC is a growing U.S.-based roofing appointment-setting company looking for motivated, dependable, and experienced cold callers to join our remote team.



Your responsibility will be to contact homeowners in the United States, identify those interested in a roofing inspection, and schedule appointments with our partnered roofing contractors.



This is a 100% performance-based position. There is no hourly salary or guaranteed base pay. You will earn $20 USD for every appointment that is completed and meets our qualification requirements.



We provide homeowner leads and an appointment-setting process. We are looking for individuals who are confident on the phone, communicate clearly, and can consistently book quality appointments.



Compensation



$20 USD per completed, qualified roofing appointment.



No hourly pay or base salary.



No cap on the number of qualified appointments you can earn bonuses for.



Payment is earned once the roofing contractor has completed the appointment and the qualification requirements have been verified.



Example Earning Potential:



10 qualified appointments = $200



20 qualified appointments = $400



30 qualified appointments = $600



50 qualified appointments = $1,000



These are examples, not guaranteed earnings.



Appointment Qualification Requirements



To qualify for the $20 payment, the appointment must meet ALL of the following requirements:



1. Homeowner Must Be Present and Meet the Contractor



The homeowner must be at the property when the appointment is scheduled to take place.



The homeowner must meet with the roofing company representative.



Appointments where the homeowner is absent, cancels, or does not meet the contractor do not qualify for payment.



2. Roof Must Be Over 5 Years Old



The home's existing roof must be more than five years old.



The appointment setter must confirm the approximate age of the roof during the initial conversation.



Homes with roofs five years old or newer do not qualify.



3. Appointment Must Be Completed and Verified



The roofing contractor must complete the appointment.



The appointment must meet the qualification requirements before the $20 bonus is approved.



Daily Responsibilities



Make outbound calls to U.S. homeowners using provided leads.



Explain the benefits of a professional roofing inspection.



Identify homeowners with roofs older than five years.



Schedule appointments with partnered roofing companies.



Accurately record homeowner information and appointment details.



Follow appointment-setting scripts and quality standards.



Maintain professionalism and clear communication.



Requirements



Strong spoken English and communication skills.



Cold-calling or appointment-setting experience preferred.



Experience in roofing, solar, insurance, or home improvement is a plus.



Reliable computer, internet connection, and headset.



Ability to work during U.S. business hours.



Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable with performance-based compensation.



Why Work With RoofReach?



Work remotely from the Philippines.



Leads provided.



Unlimited earning potential based on qualified appointments.



Opportunity to grow with an expanding U.S. roofing appointment-setting business.



Clear appointment qualifications and commission structure.



How to Apply



Please send the following:



Your name and relevant cold-calling experience.



A short video recording introducing yourself in English.



Your experience with appointment setting, roofing, solar, or home improvement.



Confirmation that you understand and accept the commission-only compensation structure of $20 per completed, qualified appointment.



We are looking for appointment setters who focus on quality, not just quantity. If you are confident in your ability to book real appointments with qualified homeowners, we want to hear from you!



Apply today to join RoofReach LLC.

TOOLS

title: Senior Airbnb Operations Manager — Supervise 5 Luxury Rentals (Hostaway)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Airbnb Operations Manager to run our growing short-term rental business. This position starts part-time, 7 days a week, with the potential to grow into a full-time role.



We currently have five high-end short-term and mid-term rental properties in North Carolina and California. Our guests expect exceptional service, fast communication, and prompt issue resolution.



MUST HAVE: SUPERVISORY OR OPERATIONS MANAGER EXPERIENCE IN A SHORT-TERM RENTAL BUSINESS.



We need someone who treats this like their business. That means noticing problems before anyone tells you, following up without being asked, caring about every guest review and every dollar spent, and never assuming someone else will handle it. If a cleaner is late, a vendor overcharges, or a guest is unhappy, you act as if it's your money and your reputation on the line.



Experience only as a VA or assistant is not enough. You must have supervised people in an STR business before: other VAs, cleaners, handymen, contractors and other people on the ground. You will be responsible for operations end to end. You'll do hands-on work yourself, and you'll make sure everyone else does theirs. Assigning a task does not make it done. A task is yours until it is finished, documented and confirmed. If something falls through the cracks, it's yours to fix.



We strongly prefer candidates who have worked on Airbnb's support teams at Tier 2 or above (Resolutions, Escalations, Claims, Trust & Safety, Case Management or similar), either directly or through a partner company such as Telus, TDCX, IntouchCX, Foundever or Concentrix. This is not required.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



• Active hours: 2pm–7pm EST, 7 days a week

• Evening monitoring: 7pm–12am EST, 7 days a week. Check cameras and noise monitors once per hour, and take action when needed (contacting guests, vendors or police). These hours may become part of a full-time role.

• Guest emergencies are handled when they happen, even outside these hours

• Once the operation is running smoothly, we'll set regular days off together

• Pay: $5/hour for active hours (35 hours/week)

• Evening monitoring is paid at 1.5 hours per evening. When an i
 requires action, the actual time spent is paid, as long as it's logged in Asana.

• This must be your main job. If you have another job that could expand its hours, this role is not a fit.



We value organization, follow-through, urgency, and proactive communication more than speed.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Responding to guest inquiries and issues promptly, ideally within minutes

• Guest communication before, during, and after stays

• Screening every booking: checking guest reviews, spotting party risk and scam inquiries, and enforcing house rules

• Managing reservations in Hostaway

• Recruiting, screening and supervising cleaners in Turno, and keeping a primary cleaner and backups for every property

• Making sure every clean starts and finishes on time, is checked item by item, and that damage is photographed before the cleaner leaves

• Finding new vendors, getting written quotes, negotiating prices, and checking invoices for overbilling

• Getting repairs done the same day whenever possible, and confirming with the guest that the issue is resolved before the vendor leaves

• Managing Airbnb Resolution Center cases from initial submission through escalation, follow-up, and final resolution

• Managing damage claims from documentation and submission through final resolution and payment, including Waivo insurance for VRBO and direct bookings

• Escalating cases with Airbnb Support and following up persistently until the desired outcome is achieved

• Preparing and submitting requests for review removals when reviews violate Airbnb policies

• Tracking guest fees, refunds and charges until they are actually paid

• Purchasing supplies at the best available price, and sending receipts to our bookkeeper the same day

• Managing preventive and seasonal maintenance for each property

• Monitoring occupancy and pricing (PriceLabs), and keeping listings, photos and house manuals current

• Keeping meticulous records in Asana, with photos, quotes and invoices filed where they belong

• Communicating proactively with team members through Slack

• Identifying potential issues before they become problems

• When Airbnb work is quiet, supporting our founder's consulting practice, including social media management



REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



• Experience supervising people in a short-term rental business: VAs, cleaners and vendors

• Significant hands-on STR operations experience

• Experience finding vendors, comparing quotes and negotiating prices

• Daily, hands-on Hostaway experience

• Experience handling Airbnb Resolution Center cases and damage claims

• Meticulous record-keeping

• Excellent written English

• A habit of proactively updating team members and documenting work

• Persistence when managing unresolved issues



Bonus: experience with social media management or supporting a consulting or coaching business.



HONESTY



Absolute honesty is required. Shortlisted candidates complete a live Hostaway screen-share test and provide a Certificate of Employment and any training certificates for past roles, and we check that dates and employers match your resume.



Overstating your experience, inventing employers, or submitting AI-written answers will end your application immediately. Saying "I haven't done that" or "I don't know" will never count against you.



TO APPLY



Please begin your application with:



"I am applying for the Lagom Operations Manager role."



Answer the following questions yourself, without AI. Short and specific is better than long and polished. We want real examples with real details, not descriptions of how you would generally handle things.



1. List each relevant job: company name, your title, start and end dates, number of properties, and what you personally did. For Hostaway, describe what you actually do in it day to day. Please don't rate yourself on a scale.



2. Tell us about the team you supervised in a short-term rental business: how many people, their roles (VAs, cleaners, vendors), how long you supervised them, and who you reported to. Then tell us about one specific time someone on your team didn't do their job. What happened, what did you do, and how did it end?



3. What is the most complex Airbnb issue you personally handled from start to finish? Tell us what went wrong, what you did step by step, the dollar amount involved, and the final outcome. If it didn't go well, tell us that.



4. This role covers 2pm–7pm EST (2am–7am Philippine time) every day, plus hourly camera checks from 7pm–12am EST (7am–12pm Philippine time). Can you cover all of those hours, 7 days a week? Do you currently have any other job or regular commitment during that time?



5. Tell us about a time something in your personal life affected your work. When and how did you tell your employer?



6. If you have worked on Airbnb's support teams, tell us the company that employed you, your exact job title, the team or queue you worked in, and your start and end dates.



7. It's Saturday at 11pm EST. A camera shows about 15 people arriving at a property booked for 4 guests, and the guest isn't answering messages. What do you do, step by step, and when?



Applications that do not follow the instructions above will not be considered.

title: SEO Strategist
description:
HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this role, you must apply directly through our hiring portal using this link:





WHO WE ARE

Spark Marketing Agency is a fast growing digital marketing firm dedicated to scaling home service contractors across the US. We utilize data driven advertising, local SEO, and in house media production to build predictable revenue engines for our clients. Our commitment to operational excellence and real ROI over vanity metrics has allowed us to deliver measurable growth and keep our clients winning month after month. We are focused on turning ad spend into signed contracts while building a team of highly accountable, top tier professionals.



THE ROLE

You are the lead SEO strategist overseeing organic search performance across the entire agency, with a heavy emphasis on Local SEO and Google Business Profiles (GBP). You sit above our content writers and junior SEO teams and own rankings, traffic, and organic lead generation across 150+ contractor accounts.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Oversee all client SEO campaigns (on-page, off-page, technical, and local). Catch ranking drops before clients do. You own the outcome when a site loses visibility and know how to recover it.

* Set the agency standards for site architecture, local schema markup, keyword mapping, citation building, and GBP optimization.

* Train and coach junior SEOs and content creators. Review their optimization work weekly. Tell them what to change and why. Make them better every month.

* Run Spark's own SEO strategy to acquire new clients. This account directly funds the agency and gets your best work.

* Read Google Search Console and GA4 reports to diagnose what is actually broken technically or content-wise, not just what automated third-party audit tools say.

* Understand lead quality, not just traffic volume. You know the difference between ranking for a high-intent "plumber near me" keyword that books jobs and a national informational blog post that only inflates vanity traffic.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* Deep, proven mastery in Local SEO (Google Business Profile optimization, local service area pages, map pack rankings, and local link building). This is the absolute priority for this role.

* 3+ years managing SEO on the agency side, not client side.

* Real, proven experience driving organic leads for home services or contractor client accounts (plumbing, roofing, HVAC, remodeling, etc.). This is not negotiable. Ecommerce, info products, and SaaS experience do not transfer here.

* Track record of managing multiple client accounts simultaneously without letting smaller ones suffer.

* Deep comfort with technical SEO, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and WordPress architectures.

* Ability to audit site structures, identify indexing issues, and diagnose algorithmic penalties quickly.

* Prior experience training, reviewing, or managing other SEO specialists or writers.

* Clear, direct communication in writing and on calls. No scripts needed.

* Reliable internet and a computer that can handle a full workday.

* Commitment to working 9 a.m. PST to 6 p.m. PST (this is overnight in the Philippines and parts of Asia).



NICE TO HAVE

* Solid working knowledge of Google Ads and how paid and organic search integrate.

* Experience with GoHighLevel CRM and website builders.

* Prior work with programmatic SEO or advanced local landing page automation at scale.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

* Someone who only knows how to run automated SEO audit tools and blindly exports PDF reports for clients.

* Someone who relies on spammy, outdated link-building tactics (PBNs, exact match anchor text stuffing) that put our clients' domains at risk.

* Someone who needs daily check ins or constant hand holding.

* Someone who blames Google core updates or algorithm shifts and throws their hands up when rankings drop.



We want someone who owns the organic number.



LOGISTICS

Full time independent contractor role, remote. You must be able to work from 9 a.m. PST to 6 p.m. PST reliably. Compensation is based on experience and demonstrated contractor account management at scale.

$2,000 per month base + $500 monthly bonus when all 3 KPIs are met (up to $2,500 per month)



Hours:

40 hours per week, Monday to Friday. At least 4 hours overlap with Dutch office hours (08:00-12:00 CET = 15:00-19:00 PH time).



About us:

WDM Brands is a fast-growing Dutch e-commerce company selling our own brands on 
, the largest marketplace in the Netherlands. We sell around 100 core products, sourced from China. Our team of about 10 people works fully remote, most of them in the Philippines. You will own our full stock flow: from forecast to the moment a product is sellable.



What you will do:

-Forecast demand per product, including seasonality

-D
 what to order, how much and when (up to €10,000 on your own)

-Book and track shipments from China to the Netherlands (sea and rail)

-Plan inbound shipments to our warehouse and to 
 fulfilment (similar to Amazon FBA)

-Keep stock levels right and solve stock errors and disputes

Your 3 KPIs:

-No out-of-stocks on our top 20 products (max 2 stock-out days per month in total)

-Days of stock on core products stays under 100 days

-At least 90% of shipments arrive within 5 days of the planned ETA



You must have (no exceptions):

-5+ years in supply chain or inventory planning, of which 2+ years in e-commerce (Amazon FBA, 
 or a 3PL)

-Booked shipments from China yourself (LCL and FCL), and worked with freight forwarders and customs documents

-Fluent English

-You wait for problems to be pointed out to you

-You want to work a second job next to this one



How to apply:



Start your application with the words “Stock flow”

Answer these 3 questions, short and with real numbers:

-A container is 3 weeks late and the product sells out in 10 days. What are your first three actions?

-How do you calculate a reorder quantity for a seasonal product?

-What was the largest number of SKUs you managed stock for, and on which platform?



Add a video of max 2 minutes about one stock or shipping problem you solved



Incomplete applications and AI-generated answers without real examples are rejected without reply.

title: Ecommerce Web Designer | Figma & Conversion Rate Optimization
description:
About us



Chapie creates vacuum-insulated cases designed to protect lip balm, cosmetics, and everyday essentials from heat. Our brand combines functional product innovation with colorful designs and collectible collections.



Before applying, visit 
. Explore our products, customers, and design language so you can select portfolio examples that demonstrate how your work would fit our brand.



About the role



We’re looking for an ecommerce web designer with excellent visual taste, advanced Figma skills, and strong expertise in conversion rate optimization (CRO).



You will design detailed, persuasive product pages that clearly explain our products, answer customer questions, and turn visitors into buyers.



This is a design role. Our developer will build your designs in Shopify, so Shopify coding skills are not required.



We need someone who understands both how to make a page look excellent and how to make it sell.



What you’ll do



Design complete ecommerce product pages and landing pages in Figma for mobile and desktop.



Research our products, customers, and competitors to identify compelling selling points and purchase objections.



Structure pages with strong headlines, benefits, product demonstrations, comparisons, reviews, FAQs, and calls to action.



Create graphics that explain product features, dimensions, compatibility, and use cases.



Use typography, spacing, color, and imagery to create a clear visual hierarchy.



Recommend copy and messaging that communicate value and build purchase confidence.



Deliver organized Figma files with responsive layouts, reusable components, assets, and clear developer instructions.



Review completed pages with our developer to ensure the implementation matches your designs.



Recommend design improvements and variations for conversion testing.



What we’re looking for



Excellent design taste and a strong portfolio of ecommerce product pages.



Advanced Figma skills, including Auto Layout, components, prototyping, and developer handoff.



Strong understanding of ecommerce CRO, customer psychology, and mobile shopping behavior.



Ability to translate technical product features into clear benefits and compelling visuals.



Strong English communication skills and attention to detail.



Ability to explain the reasoning behind your design decisions.



Beautiful visuals alone are not enough. Your pages must help customers understand the product, resolve their concerns, and make purchasing easy.



How to apply



Apply using 8 Apply Points.



Use the subject line: Chapie Web Designer | [Your Name]



Include:



Public Figma links to your three best ecommerce product page designs that you personally created. Select examples most relevant to Chapie’s products and brand direction. Set sharing permissions to “Anyone with the link can view.”



A brief explanation of your role in each project and why each example is relevant to Chapie.



A short explanation of the conversion strategy behind one of the pages. Include measured results if available, and distinguish results from assumptions.



Your expected hourly rate, weekly availability, and earliest start date.



Submit your strongest relevant work. We are evaluating ecommerce page design, visual judgment, and conversion thinking.



Application design challenge



Selected applicants will be invited to redesign our Chapie OG Multi-Pack product page in Figma, with layouts for both mobile and desktop and a focus on improving conversions.



One winning design will receive $50 USD. Only the winning submission receives payment.

title: AI Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Blue Harbour is a New Zealand and Australian consultancy that delivers modern project controls and AI-driven capital intelligence to our clients. We help the organisations that plan and deliver capital programmes make better decisions, faster.



You will work alongside our founder, Dave Braendler, who built AI OS, the platform at the centre of our work. It is a working partnership rather than an apprenticeship: you will own your work and shape how it gets done, and Dave is there to think problems through with you, not to set your day. You will also work directly with clients. Over your first months you will take on more of those relationships, with access to client systems and data, and with the work you produce going straight in front of the people who rely on it. Our DNA is rapid, structured innovation: we move fast, and we are disciplined about how we do it. If that is the kind of place where you do your best work, this role is for you.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

Engineering is the core of this role. The client work, the teaching and the commercial judgement are there so that what you build gets used.



You will build things people use: client portals, AI skills, agents and workflows, and the integrations that connect them to the systems people already run. You will choose the right frontier model for each job, write code where it is needed and configure where it is not, and show people what good looks like.



You will start with our channel partners, the professional services firms we work through, building the tools their sales, bid and marketing teams use to win work, and uplifting those teams so the tools get used. That is how we engage with partners, and it is the route into our core work: AI-driven capital intelligence and project controls for the organisations that plan and deliver capital programmes.



You will also keep our AI practice current, with half a day a week set aside for it and focused on the areas that matter most to our work. The field moves monthly, and part of your job is to follow it: new models, open-source projects and techniques. You will bring back what is worth trying, test it properly, and make the case for what should change how we work.



REQUIREMENTS

* Rapid, methodical engineering. You work in small, tested steps and ship working code quickly. You finish what you start: tested, documented and handed over. To you, fast and disciplined are not a trade-off.

* Strong development skills. Modern web frameworks, APIs and integrations, Git, test-driven development, and experience with CI/CD.

* Deep, hands-on fluency with AI. You use frontier models every day, you know their strengths and failure modes, and you have a view on which belongs where.

* The ability to create AI systems that actually work. An appreciation for good architecture and thorough evaluation.

* Judgement. Knowing when to build, when to configure and when a better prompt is the answer; when an output is good enough to put in front of a client and when it is not; and when to say no.

* A passion for creation. You build because you want to, and you ship things people use. You follow the field closely because you enjoy it, and you can tell a genuine advance from hype.

* Clear communication. You write so that a client, a partner or a colleague in another time zone can act on what you send without a follow-up call. You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical audience, and teach people to use what you build.

* Self-directed remote working. You manage your own time, keep moving without waiting for answers, and keep people informed without being chased. You leave work in a state others can pick up, with clear commits, notes and handovers, in a structure that is still evolving.





EXPERIENCE

We care more about what you have shipped than how long you have been doing it.



* A track record of shipping production software, with work you can show us and explain how you knew it worked

* Built web portals or applications that people log in to and rely on

* Built agentic workflows with tools, connectors and retrieval, not only chat

* Put AI tools into the hands of non-technical users who went on to rely on them



IDEALLY

* Worked alongside sales, marketing or bid teams, or integrated with a CRM such as Pipedrive, HubSpot or Salesforce

* Worked client-facing, or in a small business where the structure was still being built

* Exposure to capital projects, infrastructure, project controls or professional services

* Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or agent skill frameworks

* Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace administration and their APIs



WHY THIS ROLE

* Be our first engineer, early enough to shape how we build, the standards we hold and the tools we use

* Work alongside a founder who has built something interesting, as a peer on the work rather than a student of it

* See what you build go straight into use with partners and clients, not into a backlog

* Work every day with frontier models on real problems in real businesses

* Half a day a week to explore what is new in AI, and a real say in what we adopt

* Grow your responsibility as the business grows



HOW WE HIRE

We will ask to see work you have shipped, then run a short paid trial on a real, bounded task, so you can show us how you build rather than tell us. Along with the quality of the work, we will be looking at whether you finish it. We will also ask about a repository or technique you came across recently, and what you did with it. References follow, including one who can speak to how you work remotely.

title: Fleet Manager
description:
The Fleet Manager is responsible for overseeing the organization's fleet of vehicles

and equipment to ensure they are safe, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective. This

position manages vehicle acquisition, maintenance, repairs, licensing, fuel usage,

driver compliance, and fleet performance while ensuring adherence to company

policies and regulatory requirements.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities

? Manage the daily operations of the company's fleet of vehicles and equipment.

? Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules to minimize

downtime.

? Coordinate vehicle inspections, repairs, and warranty work with internal

technicians and external vendors.

? Monitor fleet performance, utilization, fuel consumption, and operating costs.

? Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, including

DOT, OSHA, and environmental requirements where applicable.

? Maintain accurate records for vehicle registrations, titles, insurance, permits,

inspections, and maintenance history.

? Oversee vehicle acquisition, replacement, disposal, and asset lifecycle

management.

? Negotiate contracts and pricing with vendors, repair facilities, leasing

companies, and fuel providers.

? Monitor driver qualifications, licensing, training, and compliance with

company safety policies.

? Investigate vehicle a
 and coordinate insurance claims and corrective

actions.

? Develop and enforce fleet policies and procedures.

? Prepare reports and analyze fleet metrics to identify opportunities for cost

savings and operational improvements.

? Manage fleet budgets and recommend capital expenditures.

? Handle the coordination of after-hours support as needed.



Required Qualifications

? Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Transportation

Management, or a related field preferred but not required.

? High school diploma or equivalent required.

? Minimum of 3–5 years of fleet management or transportation management

experience.

? Experience managing commercial vehicle fleets preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

? Strong knowledge of fleet maintenance and repair practices.

? Understanding of DOT regulations, FMCSA requirements, and vehicle safety

standards.

? Experience with fleet management software and GPS/telematics systems.

? Strong analytical and budgeting skills.

? Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

? Strong communication and leadership skills.

? Ability to negotiate effectively with vendors and service providers.

? Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.

? Ability to analyze reports and make data-driven decisions.

? Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.



This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work

performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or

qualifications. Duties may be modified to meet the organization's operational needs.

REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken English and professional phone presence

- Strong written English

- Organized, dependable, and strong at follow-up

- Comfortable making and receiving phone calls

- Previous work-from-home experience required

- Reliable computer

- Headset

- Reliable primary internet

- Backup internet required



This should not be your first work-from-home position.



VOICE / CUSTOMER SERVICE EXPERIENCE

- BPO / call center

- Voice customer service

- Receptionist

- Appointment setting

Strong communication skills are more important to us than extensive property-management experience.



PROPERTY EXPERIENCE

- RentRedi

HOW TO APPLY

Use this subject line: PM100526

Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.

VIDEO QUESTIONS — 2 TO 3 MINUTES

NEXT STEP
