title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Research VA | Creative Carioca
description:
Creative Carioca is looking for an experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Research Virtual Assistant for a long-term collaboration focused on manual sourcing for Amazon US. You will evaluate FBA and FBM opportunities and submit complete, accurate, purchase-ready leads. This role is for product research and does not include purchasing products.



You should already have practical Amazon US OA sourcing experience and be able to manage your research independently. We provide an English SOP with our workflow, sourcing criteria, cost rules, and submission requirements to support your work. You should be comfortable applying detailed written instructions, checking your own work, and asking clear questions when information is uncertain.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Manually source profitable Amazon US FBA and FBM opportunities using Keepa and AsinZen/AZInsight.

- Verify exact product matches, reliable suppliers, selling eligibility, and brand/IP risks.

- Analyze pricing, demand, and competition, and calculate profitability including all fees, prep, and shipping costs.

- Submit at least 5 complete leads daily in our Google Sheet, with clear supporting evidence, following our SOP.

- Double-check your work, communicate reliably, and flag uncertainties before submitting.



QUALITY EXPECTATIONS

Each lead must meet all three minimum requirements: 20% ROI, 10% profit margin, and US$5 profit per unit, after all applicable costs, including prep and shipping. 

However, meeting the profitability requirements alone does not make a lead approved. Each lead must also satisfy the SOP's requirements for product matching, selling eligibility, Keepa analysis, accurate total costs, source validation, and purchase readiness.



The ongoing target is at least 5 qualified leads per working day, totaling at least 25 per week. Leads must be entered into the shared Google Sheet daily. Saving leads to submit together on the final day of the week is not acceptable. Each lead is reviewed against our SOP before approval. Quality, accuracy, and complete documentation are essential.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- Proven, hands-on Amazon US Online Arbitrage experience, with manual product sourcing as a core part of your work.

- Confidence interpreting Keepa charts and evaluating both FBA and FBM opportunities.

- Practical experience with AsinZen/AZInsight or comparable profitability analysis tools.

- Accurate spreadsheet documentation, careful cost calculations, and strong attention to written instructions.

- The ability to work independently and communicate consistently.



TOOLS PROVIDED

We provide access to Tactical Arbitrage, AsinZen, and Keepa, plus a shared Google Sheet for your leads and analysis. Manual sourcing remains the primary focus; these tools support your research, analysis, and validation. Our SOP will be provided privately for the work.



AVAILABILITY AND COMMITMENT

You must have enough time available to research thoroughly, complete all required checks, and consistently submit at least 5 qualified leads per working day and 25 per week. We are looking for reliable, sustained availability for a long-term collaboration.



PAID INITIAL TRIAL

The selected candidate will start with a paid 3-day trial:

- Base pay: US$20 per day, for a total of US$60 across all 3 days.

- Additional pay: US$3 for each approved lead delivered during the trial.

- Trial deliverable: at least 5 fully researched leads submitted in the shared Google Sheet on each of the 3 trial days, totaling at least 15 leads, with complete analysis following our SOP.

- Daily submission is required. Submitting all 15 leads on the final day does not meet the trial requirements.

- Example: if 15 leads are approved, total trial pay is US$60 base + US$45 in approved-lead payments = US$105.



PAYMENT AFTER THE TRIAL

If we continue working together:

- Base pay: US$100 per week.

- Additional pay: US$3 per approved lead.

- Extra bonus: US$5 if all 25 weekly leads are approved.

- Weekly payments are made every Tuesday.

- Example: 25 approved leads = US$100 base + US$75 in approved-lead payments + US$5 bonus = US$180 for the week.

- Opportunities for pay increases based on skills and performance.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with SOURCING, attach your résumé/CV, and briefly introduce your relevant Amazon US Online Arbitrage sourcing experience.

title: AI-Native Virtual Operations & Project Coordinator
description:
About the role

We're a new, senior-led firm building a practice around pharma supply chain compliance. This is our first hire and the person who keeps the company running day to day. You'll work directly with the senior management, using AI tools for most of your work, and you'll learn a regulated industry quickly.



What you'll do

• Manage the management teams calendar and inbox, prepare for meetings, and turn meeting notes into tracked action items.

• Keep project timelines and milestones current in our project tool, and flag risks before dates slip.

• Maintain our CRM: deals, stages, notes and follow-ups.

• Use Claude and Grok to research companies and regulatory topics, and produce short, sourced briefs.

• Draft personalized outreach
s and LinkedIn messages for approval before anything is sent.

• Turn our articles into social posts for the company LinkedIn page and schedule them.

• Build and maintain reusable prompts and workflows so AI output stays consistent and accurate.

• Support finance admin, document filing and SOP writing.



What we're looking for

• 3+ years in executive assistant, project coordination or operations support, with references.

• Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude, Grok or ChatGPT for research, writing or automation. Be ready to show a workflow you built.

• A habit of checking AI output against real sources, because accuracy matters in a regulated industry.

• Strong written English and sound judgment.

• Comfort with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint) and a CRM or project tool.

• Speed at learning technical subjects. We'll teach pharma supply chain, quality and validation, so you don't need prior experience, but background in pharma, life sciences or supply chain is a strong plus.

Schedule



Full-time, Monday to Friday, working US Eastern time business hours 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET. For a Philippines-based hire this is an overnight shift. Applicants must confirm in their note that they can reliably work these hours from a quiet, dependable setup with stable internet.



Paid trial task



For shortlisted candidates only. The task takes about three to four hours and is paid at the offered hourly rate for up to four hours. Use any AI tools you like. We want to see how you work with them.



Materials we send

• One public biopharma company name

• A short article excerpt about pharma supply chain compliance 



Deliverables

1. Company brief (one page). What the company does, its latest product news, and why a compliance advisory firm might be relevant to it. Every fact needs a source link.

2. Three outreach
s. Short, personalized, and based on the brief. Draft only. Do not send anything.

3. Two LinkedIn posts for a company page, based on the article excerpt. Plain, credible tone, no hype.

4. Regulatory summary (about 150 words) of the FDA page. List anything you weren't sure about.

5. Process note (half a page). Which tools you used, the key prompts, what you checked by hand, and anything you'd do differently.



Rules

• Use public information only. Do not contact anyone and do not post anything.

• Tell us where you used AI. We expect it.

• If you can't verify something, say so rather than guessing.

• Send everything back as one document or a shared folder within 48 hours of receiving the task.

title: VIRTUAL OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
NOW HIRING: VIRTUAL OPERATIONS MANAGER

CALMR Cleaning Co. | U.S. Residential Cleaning Company



Position: Virtual Operations Manager – Cleaning Business



Location: 100% Remote



Employment Type: Part-Time Independent Contractor



Schedule: Approximately 10–15 hours per week initially, with opportunities for additional hours as the business grows



Working Hours: Must be available during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time business hours



Compensation: Negotiable based on experience, within a starting budget of $350 USD per month



Industry: Residential Cleaning / Home Services



About CALMR Cleaning Co.



CALMR Cleaning Co. is a growing U.S.-based residential cleaning company committed to providing reliable, professional, and high-quality home cleaning services.



Our mission is simple: Bringing Balance Back Home.



We operate using a remote management model, partnering with independent cleaning professionals to deliver exceptional services to our customers.



We are looking for an experienced, dependable, sales-driven Virtual Operations Manager who can take ownership of our daily business operations and help us build a successful, profitable, and well-organized cleaning company.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who can independently manage responsibilities, solve problems, generate results, and help grow the business.



Key Responsibilities



1. Cleaner Recruitment, Interviewing & Onboarding



- Recruit qualified independent residential cleaning contractors.

- Create and manage cleaner recruitment postings.

- Review applications and screen potential cleaning contractors.

- Conduct telephone and video interviews with applicants.

- Evaluate candidates' cleaning experience, professionalism, communication, and reliability.

- Coordinate reference checks and verify required qualifications.

- Ensure cleaners meet company requirements, including reliable transportation and their own cleaning supplies.

- Coordinate independent contractor agreements and onboarding documentation.

- Maintain organized contractor records and availability schedules.

- Develop and maintain a dependable network of cleaning professionals.

- Coordinate replacement cleaners when scheduling conflicts or cancellations occur.



2. Lead Management, Sales & Customer Acquisition



- Respond promptly to new leads from the website, phone calls,
s, text messages, and other marketing channels.

- Conduct outbound calls and follow-ups with prospective customers.

- Convert inquiries and estimates into confirmed, paying customers.

- Explain cleaning services, scheduling options, and company policies.

- Prepare and communicate quotes using company-approved pricing.

- Follow up consistently with prospective customers who have not booked.

- Reengage previous customers and encourage repeat bookings.

- Identify opportunities for recurring cleaning services.

- Maintain accurate lead records and track sales conversion rates.

- Proactively suggest strategies to increase bookings and revenue.



Strong sales ability and proven lead-conversion experience are essential.



3. Customer Service & Communication



- Answer incoming business calls professionally.

- Monitor and respond to company
s, text messages, website inquiries, and voi
.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for customer questions and concerns.

- Handle customer complaints, service issues, and scheduling conflicts.

- Coordinate appropriate resolutions while protecting customer satisfaction and company profitability.

- Send booking confirmations, reminders, and follow-up communications.

- Request customer feedback and reviews after completed services.

- Maintain a professional, friendly, and solution-oriented customer experience.



4. Scheduling, Dispatching & Daily Operations



- Manage daily and weekly cleaning schedules.

- Assign cleaning jobs to available, qualified contractors.

- Confirm cleaner availability and customer appointments.

- Communicate job details, instructions, and expectations to cleaners.

- Monitor appointment status and follow up on incomplete or delayed jobs.

- Handle last-minute cancellations, rescheduling, and cleaner no-shows.

- Coordinate emergency replacement cleaners when necessary.

- Maintain accurate customer and cleaner scheduling records.

- Ensure appointments are completed efficiently and professionally.

- Keep the business owner informed of urgent issues requiring approval.



5. Booking Software, CRM & Administrative Management



- Manage the company's cleaning business management software and CRM.

- Maintain accurate customer profiles, service requests, booking records, and cleaner information.

- Update lead statuses, customer notes, and appointment details.

- Manage digital onboarding documents and signed contractor agreements.

- Monitor outstanding customer payments and send appropriate reminders.

- Assist with approved payment links, invoices, and customer billing questions.

- Maintain organized digital business records.

- Assist with implementing systems, workflows, templates, and automations that improve efficiency.



Experience with platforms such as **BookingKoala, ZenMaid, Jobber, Launch27, or similar cleaning management software** is highly desirable.



6. Business Growth & Performance Reporting



- Track incoming leads, booked jobs, cancellations, and customer retention.

- Monitor cleaner recruitment progress and contractor availability.

- Provide regular reports on sales activity and operational performance.

- Identify operational problems and recommend practical solutions.

- Help improve customer response times and booking conversion rates.

- Support the owner in developing efficient processes as the company expands.



Mandatory Qualifications



Applicants MUST meet the following requirements:



- Previous professional experience working remotely for a **U.S.-based residential cleaning company**.

- Demonstrated experience managing cleaning business operations, scheduling, customer service, or dispatching.

- Proven experience recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding independent cleaning contractors.

- Strong sales skills, including lead follow-up, objection handling, and converting inquiries into paying customers.

- Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and professional telephone communication.

- Excellent written English, grammar, and customer communication skills.

- Experience handling customer calls,
s, texts, and service complaints.

- Familiarity with cleaning business scheduling systems or CRM software.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a computer, and a quiet, professional workspace.

- Ability to work during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Professionalism, reliability, confidentiality, and accountability.



Candidates without prior experience supporting a U.S. residential cleaning company will not be considered.



Preferred Qualifications



- Previous experience as a Cleaning Company Operations Manager, Cleaning Business VA, Operations Coordinator, or Cleaning Business Dispatcher.

- Experience supporting a remote residential cleaning business using independent contractors.

- Familiarity with recurring residential cleaning services, deep cleaning, and move-in/move-out cleaning.

- Experience managing customer retention and recurring bookings.

- Knowledge of cleaning company sales processes and lead management.

- Experience developing standard operating procedures and improving workflows.

- Familiarity with automation tools, virtual phone systems, and AI-assisted business operations.



What We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



- Takes initiative without waiting for constant instructions.

- Is comfortable making routine operational decisions within established company policies.

- Has a strong sales mindset and understands the importance of turning leads into revenue.

- Knows how to recruit dependable cleaning professionals.

- Communicates confidently and professionally with U.S. customers.

- Can handle difficult customer situations calmly and effectively.

- Is organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and dependable.

- Treats the company's success as a priority.

- Is interested in a long-term opportunity with a growing company.



We are seeking someone who can help run the business, not simply complete assigned tasks.



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit the following:



1. Résumé: Highlight your previous experience working with U.S.-based residential cleaning companies.



2. Cleaning Industry Experience: Provide the names of the U.S. residential cleaning companies you previously supported, your position, length of employment, and primary responsibilities.



3. Software Experience: List the cleaning business management platforms and CRM systems you have used.



4. Recruitment Experience: Explain your experience recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding independent cleaning contractors.



5. Sales Experience: Describe how you have successfully converted cleaning service inquiries into paying customers. Include measurable results, if available.



6. Voice Introduction: Submit a 60–90-second voice recording introducing yourself, describing your cleaning industry experience, and explaining why you would be a good fit.



7. Availability & Compensation: Provide your hourly rate in USD, weekly availability, and ability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



8. Scenario Question: A customer requests a same-day cleaning appointment, but the assigned cleaner cancels two hours before the scheduled arrival. Explain step by step how you would handle this situation.



Applications missing the requested information may not be considered.



Why Join CALMR Cleaning Co.?



- Fully remote opportunity.

- Flexible part-time schedule with agreed-upon coverage hours.

- Opportunity to grow alongside a developing U.S. residential cleaning business.

- Direct communication with the business owner.

- Opportunity to take ownership of operations and contribute ideas.

- Potential for increased hours and responsibilities as the company expands.

- Long-term working relationship for the right candidate.



We are looking for a reliable, experienced, and motivated professional who is ready to help build and manage a successful cleaning company.



CALMR Cleaning Co.



Bringing Balance Back Home.

• Build and maintain a pipeline of pre-qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs.

• Engage passive candidates through effective outreach strategies.

• Screen candidate profiles and assess initial qualifications before passing them to recruiters.

• Collaborate with recruiters and hiring managers to understand job requirements and sourcing priorities.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).

• Track and report sourcing metrics to optimize recruitment strategies.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Onshore Recruiter Manager

1. Candidate Sourcing & Pipeline Development

o Source qualified dental professionals (Dentists, Hygienists, Assistants, Front Office Staff) to the pipeline per month.

o Ensure that sourced candidates meet job requirements (licenses, experience, location, availability).

o Maintain an active database of pre-screened candidates to support ongoing hiring needs.

2. Speed & Efficiency

o Identify and submit qualified candidates per week to offshore recruiters for screening.

o Reduce time-to-source candidates using Boolean searches, LinkedIn, job boards, and referral networks.

o Ensure a response time of under 24 hours when engaging with potential candidates.

3. Data Accuracy & ATS Management

o Maintain 100% accuracy in candidate data entry in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

o Update candidate profiles with correct contact information, credentials, and availability before submission.

o Ensure zero duplicate or unqualified candidate submissions, improving recruiter efficiency.

4. Communication & Collaboration

o Ensure daily coordination with offshore recruiters to prioritize sourcing needs.

o Maintain candidate outreach response, improving engagement and conversion.

5. Market Intelligence & Process Improvement

o Identify new sourcing channels or strategies per quarter to enhance talent acquisition.

o Track and report weekly sourcing performance metrics to optimize search strategies.

o Stay updated on state dental industry hiring trends to refine sourcing strategies.

title: Senior LinkedIn B2B Appointment Setter – International CEOs & Founders
description:
# Senior LinkedIn B2B Appointment Setter | International CEO Outreach



**TruLife Distribution | Full-Time | Remote – Philippines**



**Base Salary: $1,200–$2,000 USD/month + Performance Bonuses**



**Total Earning Potential: $2,500+ USD/month for Top Performers**



**Proven LinkedIn appointment-setting results required.**



### About TruLife Distribution



TruLife Distribution is an established U.S.-based retail commercialization company led by a CEO with over 20 years of industry experience.



We help established international supplement, wellness, skincare, beauty, and consumer-product brands successfully enter and expand throughout the U.S. retail market.



We're expanding our international business development operations and seeking an exceptional LinkedIn B2B appointment setter to join our team long-term.



**This is NOT a general VA, data-entry, lead research, or traditional cold
 position.**



We already have a dedicated research team and an extensive international prospect database. We need someone who excels at turning conversations with senior decision-makers into qualified sales appointments.



### Your Mission



Engage CEOs, founders, co-founders, owners, and managing directors of established international companies and convert meaningful LinkedIn conversations into qualified, completed meetings with TruLife's senior sales team.



**Priority Markets:** Germany, United Kingdom, Sweden, Denmark, Australia, and New Zealand.



Our ideal prospects are established companies with existing revenue, international distribution experience, manufacturing capacity, and the financial resources to pursue U.S. expansion.



### Key Responsibilities



- Execute personalized B2B outreach using LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Engage senior executives and develop meaningful business conversations.

- Manage follow-ups, handle objections, and qualify commercial interest.

- Identify companies actively exploring U.S. retail expansion.

- Schedule and confirm qualified appointments with TruLife's sales leadership.

- Work with our existing research team to maximize productivity and prevent duplicate outreach.

- Maintain accurate CRM records and report daily activity and weekly results.

- Optimize outreach messaging, response rates, and meeting conversion.

- Follow LinkedIn's policies and maintain professional outreach standards.



### Required Qualifications



- **3+ years of proven LinkedIn B2B appointment-setting experience.**

- Demonstrated success personally booking meetings with CEOs, founders, owners, and senior executives.

- Advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Excellent written English and professional communication.

- Experience conducting international B2B outreach.

- Strong relationship-building, qualification, and objection-handling abilities.

- Ability to independently manage LinkedIn conversations through to confirmed appointments.

- Experience using CRM systems and tracking measurable sales results.



**Preferred:** Experience in supplements, health and wellness, skincare, beauty, consumer products, or high-value B2B services.



### Performance & Earning Potential



We're looking for someone capable of building toward **15–20+ genuinely qualified, completed appointments per month**, with the opportunity to exceed those results.



Quality matters more than volume.



A qualified meeting must involve a senior decision-maker from an established company with relevant products, genuine U.S. expansion interest, and reasonable financial readiness.



**Compensation includes:**



- **$1,200–$2,000 USD monthly base salary**, based on experience.

- Additional performance bonuses for qualified, completed appointments.

- **$2,500+ monthly total earning potential** for high performers.

- Clear performance expectations and a documented bonus structure established before employment.

- Opportunities for compensation growth as results increase.



We reward genuine business opportunities, not connection requests, generic responses, or unqualified meetings.



### What We Offer



- Full-time, long-term opportunity with an established U.S. company.

- Competitive compensation with meaningful performance incentives.

- Existing international prospect database and research support.

- Direct collaboration with experienced U.S. sales leadership.

- Structured onboarding and a paid initial evaluation period.

- Opportunity for advancement based on consistent performance.



### How to Apply — Mandatory



**We are highly selective. Please answer all seven questions below.**



1. **LinkedIn Results:** What is the highest number of qualified appointments you personally booked through LinkedIn alone in one month? Exclude cold
, phone, and team-wide results.



2. **Recent Performance:** How many LinkedIn appointments did you personally book in each of your last three active campaign months? How many were completed?



3. **International Experience:** Which countries and industries have you targeted? Have you booked appointments directly with CEOs, founders, or managing directors?



4. **Proof of Results:** Can you provide anonymized CRM reports, campaign dashboards, or appointment records verifying your performance?



5. **Your Strategy:** Briefly describe how you turn an initial LinkedIn connection with an international CEO into a qualified meeting.



6. **Compensation & Availability:** What monthly base salary would you expect? Are you available full-time, and when could you start?



7. **Practical Exercise:** Write a short LinkedIn message to the CEO of an established German supplement company that may be considering entering the U.S. retail market.



**Start your application with the words: "PROVEN LINKEDIN RESULTS."**



Applications without specific, measurable results will not be prioritized.



### Final Note



We're not looking for someone who simply sends hundreds of connection requests or builds prospect lists.



**We're looking for someone who consistently turns qualified conversations with international business owners into real sales opportunities.**



If you have an exceptional LinkedIn appointment-setting track record, can demonstrate your results, and want a long-term opportunity with strong earning potential, we'd like to hear from you.
